clauses.zh: 族之总积升过段首二者总积之和，则不能段中每步族与族外皆与不过取。
clauses.en: If the total level of the family rises above the sum of the total levels of both at the start of the stretch, then it cannot be that the family and what is beyond it are gainless at every step of the stretch.

clauses.zh: 凡衡，族外诸所待各有一物以其所足之需待之，族与族外于一步与不过取，族步后之总积加族与族外之共取过与之量，多于族步前之总积加族外每一所待之积过其所足之需之量之和，则族外必有一待绝。
clauses.en: Under balance, if each condition beyond the family has a relatum depending on it with a need it meets, the family and what is beyond it are gainless at a step, and the total level of the family after the step plus the amount by which joint taking exceeds giving over the family and beyond is more than the total level of the family before the step plus the sum, over the conditions beyond, of the amount by which each level exceeds the need it meets, then some dependence beyond the family is broken.

clauses.zh: 全取，在场之一物于一步自一所待所取，不少于其步所与之全也。
clauses.en: Takes all is: a relatum taking part takes from a condition at a step no less than all that is given to it at that step.

clauses.zh: 凡所待每步所与不过 B，一物之所取连 n 步皆次步多于本步，而 n 多于 B，则于 n 步之末，此物若在场，即全取。
clauses.en: For every condition given at most B at each step, if what a relatum takes is larger at the next step than at this step for n steps in a row, and n is greater than B, then at the end of the n steps this relatum, if taking part, takes all.

clauses.zh: 凡衡，无一物能于自某步起之 L＋1 步皆在场而所取多于所与，L 为其始之积。
clauses.en: Under balance, no relatum can, for L + 1 steps from some step on, take part and take more than is given, where L is the starting level.

clauses.zh: 凡衡，唯运者与之，有待，与之者皆待之而需不下于 m：一物 n 步全取而他物于此 n 步皆在场而取之，始之积少于 n＋m，则自此凡以不下于 m 之需待之者皆不运，全取者若以此需待之亦然；
clauses.en: Under balance, where only the active give, the world is dependent, and every renewer of a condition depends on it with need not below m: if a relatum takes all for n steps while another relatum takes part and takes from the condition at each of these n steps, and the starting level is less than n + m, then from then on nothing that depends on the condition with need not below m is active, and so too for the one that takes all if it depends on it with such a need;

clauses.zh: 一物每步全取、每步以不下于 m 之需待之而每步运，则无他物能于自任一步起之 L＋1 步皆在场而取之，L 为彼步之积。
clauses.en: if a relatum takes all at every step, depends on the condition with need not below m at every step and is active at every step, then no other relatum can take part and take from it for L + 1 steps from any step, where L is the level at that step.

clauses.zh: 涸，积降至于零也。
clauses.en: Runs dry is: a level falls to zero.

clauses.zh: 凡变之每步，步后之积加此步所取不过步前之积，且积为正之步必有所取，则凡长不短于其始之积之程，终于零；
clauses.en: For every process in which at every step the level after the step plus what is taken at this step is at most the level before the step, and something is taken at every step at which the level is positive, every sequence of moves no shorter than its starting level ends at zero;

clauses.zh: 自零之步，一无所取。
clauses.en: from a step at zero, nothing is taken.

title: 常取之下的涸界
title_en: The run-dry boundary under a standing draw

clauses.zh: 一所待于每步先被常取 H 所取（不及 H 则取尽），后依所留 z 而与 g(z)（常与）。
clauses.en: A condition at each step is first taken from by the standing draw H (all of it, if it is less than H), then given g(z) according to what is left z (the standing giving).

clauses.zh: 凡 z 少于 y 时 g(z) 皆少于 H，g(0) 为零，则始于少于 H＋y 之积者，经其始积之步数而涸。
clauses.en: If g(z) is less than H whenever z is less than y, and g(0) is zero, then a level starting below H + y runs dry within as many steps as its starting level.

clauses.zh: 凡 z 不少于 y 而 z＋H 不过 hi 时 g(z) 皆不少于 H，且一步不使不过 hi 之积出于 hi，则始于 H＋y 至 hi 者，永不低于其始，不过 hi。
clauses.en: If g(z) is not less than H whenever z is not less than y and z + H is at most hi, and no step takes a level not above hi beyond hi, then a level starting from H + y up to hi never falls below its start and never exceeds hi.

clauses.zh: 二者俱而 H＋y 大于零，则始于不过 hi 之积者终涸，恰当其始少于 H＋y：H＋y 谓之涸界。
clauses.en: If both hold and H + y is greater than zero, then a level starting not above hi eventually runs dry exactly where its start is less than H + y: H + y is called the run-dry boundary.

clauses.zh: 凡 z 少于需 m 时 g(z) 为零，H 为正，y 为 g(z) 不少于 H 之最小 z，则 m 少于 y，恰当 g(m) 少于 H。
clauses.en: If g(z) is zero whenever z is less than the need m, H is positive, and y is the least z for which g(z) is not less than H, then m is less than y exactly where g(m) is less than H.

title: 常取之下行于何处不再改
title_en: Where a run changes no more under a standing draw

clauses.zh: 凡常与随所留而不降，一步不使不过 hi 之积出于 hi，则始于不过 hi 之积之行，自不过 hi 之某步起不再改，其积为常与之步所不改者。
clauses.en: If the standing giving does not decrease as what is left grows, and no step takes a level not above hi beyond hi, then a run starting from a level not above hi changes no more from some step not beyond hi, at a level that a step of the standing giving does not change.

clauses.zh: 有常与，自零与二、所留多于零则与零，不随所留而升，常取为一，一步不使不过二之积出于二，而自一之行每步往返于一与二之间，永无不再改之步。
clauses.en: There is a standing giving that gives two from zero and gives zero when what is left is more than zero, which does not increase with what is left, with standing draw one, in which no step takes a level not above two beyond two, and the run from one goes back and forth between one and two at every step and never reaches a step after which it changes no more.

clauses.zh: 凡所与读所留与前所与而定（记之为 A），A 随二者而升，一步使积与前所与皆不过 hi 者之次积不过 hi：则于每一不过 hi 之前所与 r，自不过 hi 之积 x 起之行，终在常取之下自某步起不再改，恰当 x 在一阈之下；
clauses.en: If what is given is fixed by reading what is left and the preceding giving (write it A), A increases with both, and a step from a level and a preceding giving both not above hi has its next level not above hi: then for every preceding giving r not above hi, the run from a level x not above hi ends up changing no more from some step on below the standing draw exactly where x is below a threshold;

clauses.zh: 此阈不随 r 之升而升。
clauses.en: this threshold does not increase as r increases.

clauses.zh: 所与只读所留（即常与 g）、g 随所留而升、在四·二十四之条件下、而不过 hi 之域及于涸界者，其阈于每一 r 皆为涸界 H＋y。
clauses.en: Where what is given reads only what is left (the standing giving g), g increases with what is left, the hypotheses of 4.24 hold, and the region not above hi reaches the run-dry boundary, the threshold is the run-dry boundary H + y for every r.

clauses.zh: 有一所与不随所留而升，守其域，而无一阈分其行。
clauses.en: There is a giving that does not increase with what is left, keeps to its region, and has no threshold dividing its runs.

clauses.zh: 复，状一步之后犹能至自身也：有一动自之至一状，自彼能至之。
clauses.en: Return is: a configuration can still reach itself after a step: there is a move from it to a configuration from which it can be reached.

clauses.zh: 于法，状复，恰当其行某正数步之后之状即此状。
clauses.en: Under a law, a configuration returns exactly where the configuration of its run after some positive number of steps is this configuration.

clauses.zh: 凡变，复者每步皆可得。
clauses.en: For every process, a configuration that returns can be had at every step.

clauses.zh: 同归，法使二异状一步而至一状也。
clauses.en: Confluence is: a law takes two different configurations in one step to one configuration.

clauses.zh: 凡二状同归，此后每步共一状，且不皆复。
clauses.en: For every two configurations in confluence, they share one configuration at every step afterwards, and they do not both return.

clauses.zh: 凡法，一状于某步不可得，则此后每步皆不可得；
clauses.en: For every law, if a configuration cannot be had at some step, then it cannot be had at any step afterwards;

clauses.zh: 状有一族尽之而法有同归，则不得凡状于 N 步皆可得（N 为此族之员数）。
clauses.en: if the configurations are exhausted by one family and the law has confluence, then not every configuration can be had at step N (N being the number of members of the family).

clauses.zh: 凡状有一族尽之，法无同归，恰当凡状皆复，恰当凡状每步皆可得；
clauses.en: Where the configurations are exhausted by one family, a law has no confluence exactly where every configuration returns, exactly where every configuration can be had at every step;

clauses.zh: 于此，有一以自然数计之量，沿行从不降而某步升，则法非无同归。
clauses.en: there, if an amount counted in natural numbers never falls along a run and rises at some step, then the law is not without confluence.

clauses.zh: 凡法无同归而有一状不复，则无族尽其状。
clauses.en: For every law without confluence that has a configuration that does not return, no family exhausts its configurations.

title: 体之同归由其余承之
title_en: Confluence of the part is taken up by the rest

clauses.zh: 凡法无同归，每状读为其体与其余，二状体同、其余亦同则为一状：k 个两两相异之状各行 n 步之后，其体皆在一族、其余皆在另一族，则二族之员数相乘不小于 k；
clauses.en: For every law without confluence, with each configuration read as its part and its rest, two configurations being one where both their parts and their rests are the same: if, after k pairwise distinct configurations each run n steps, their parts all lie in one family and their rests all lie in another, then the product of the numbers of members of the two families is not less than k;

clauses.zh: 故诸体同为一者，凡含诸其余之族，其员数不小于 k。
clauses.en: so if the parts are all one, every family containing the rests has at least k members.

clauses.zh: 凡法无同归，凡状一步之后其体皆为同一者 p，而有一状之体不为 p，则无族尽诸状。
clauses.en: For every law without confluence, if after one step the part of every configuration is the same p, and some configuration has a part other than p, then no family exhausts the configurations.

clauses.zh: 凡变，其一行之状皆在一族，有一量，每步之后其值加此步所减不过步前之值：有一步所减不在零之内，则此变非无同归。
clauses.en: For every process with a run whose configurations all lie in one family, and an amount whose value after each step plus what it loses at this step is at most its value before the step: if what it loses at some step is not within zero, then this process is not without confluence.

clauses.zh: 日新，自某步起每状异于其先之每状也。
clauses.en: Novelty is: from some step on every configuration differs from every configuration before it.

clauses.zh: 凡一族之总积自某步起不过一界，则自每步起此族之状有二步共之。
clauses.en: For every family whose total level from some step on does not exceed a bound, from every step on there are two steps that share a configuration of this family.

clauses.zh: 凡历自始日新，或有一以自然数计之量沿之每步皆升，则无族尽其所经。
clauses.en: For every history that has novelty from the start, or along which an amount counted in natural numbers rises at every step, no family exhausts what it passes through.

clauses.zh: 往，文至某步之前段也。
clauses.en: A prefix is the segment of a course before some step.

clauses.zh: 藏往，以今与往之对为状：今依法而行，前今入于往也。
clauses.en: Kept history takes as configuration the pair of present and prefix: the present runs by the law, and the previous present enters the prefix.

clauses.zh: 凡法，藏往则无同归、自始日新、不复，往空之状一步之后不可得，无族尽其行；
clauses.en: For every law, with kept history it has no confluence, has novelty from the start, does not return, a configuration with an empty prefix cannot be had after one step, and no family exhausts its run;

clauses.zh: 今复则往异；
clauses.en: if the present returns, the prefixes differ;

clauses.zh: 法之行所经之状有一族尽之，则自每步起有二步共一今而往异。
clauses.en: if the configurations a run of the law passes through are exhausted by one family, then from every step on there are two steps that share one present and differ in prefix.

clauses.zh: 常，变之每一可许之步皆守之域也：状在域中，所许之一步之果亦在域中。
clauses.en: An invariant is a region kept at every admissible step of a process: if a configuration is in the region, the outcome of an admissible step from it is in the region too.

clauses.zh: 一域为常，恰当每一动皆守之。
clauses.en: A region is invariant exactly where every move keeps it.

clauses.zh: 凡常，自域中能至者皆在域中。
clauses.en: For every invariant, everything reachable from the region is in the region.

clauses.zh: 凡行，自某步在一域中，其后所采之动皆守此域，则其后每步皆在域中；
clauses.en: For every run that is in a region at some step, if every move it takes afterwards keeps this region, then it is in the region at every step afterwards;

clauses.zh: 行自域中出，其出域之一步之动不守此域。
clauses.en: if a run leaves the region, the move at the step at which it leaves does not keep the region.

clauses.zh: 门，于变之动定然否之标也。
clauses.en: A gate is a decided label on the moves of a process.

clauses.zh: 凡非门之动皆反守一辞（步后之状然之，则步前之状亦然之），则凡终于此辞然之状之程，或始于其然之状，或可分为前段、一门之步与后段，而此门之步之后此辞然；
clauses.en: If every move that is not a gate reflects a claim (if the claim holds at the configuration after the step, it holds at the configuration before the step too), then every sequence of moves ending at a configuration where this claim holds either starts at a configuration where it holds, or can be divided into an earlier segment, a step through a gate and a later segment, with the claim holding after this step through the gate;

clauses.zh: 此不须定此辞然否。
clauses.en: this does not require that the claim be decided.

clauses.zh: 凡非门之动皆不改一量，则凡改此量之程含一门之动。
clauses.en: If every move that is not a gate leaves a quantity unchanged, then every sequence of moves that changes this quantity contains a move through a gate.

clauses.zh: 门以辞给之（每动之为门与否是一辞），而非门之动皆反守一辞：每动之门定然否，则凡终于此辞然之状之程，或始于其然之状，或含一门之动；
clauses.en: Where the gate is given by claims (whether each move is a gate is a claim) and every move that is not a gate reflects a claim: if whether each move is a gate is decided, then every sequence of moves ending at a configuration where the claim holds either starts at a configuration where it holds or contains a move through a gate;

clauses.zh: 不设门之定然否而于凡变求此律，恰当凡辞不可非则然。
clauses.en: requiring this for every process without supposing that the gate is decided holds exactly where every claim has double-negation stability.

clauses.zh: 闭，法所不出之域也：状在域中，其次状亦在域中。
clauses.en: An absorbing region is a region a law never leaves: if a configuration is in the region, its next configuration is in the region too.

clauses.zh: 法之闭，恰其变之常。
clauses.en: The absorbing regions of a law are exactly the invariants of its process.

clauses.zh: 凡状，自次步起其所能至者为一闭；
clauses.en: For every configuration, what it can reach from the next step on is an absorbing region;

clauses.zh: 复者之域为一闭；
clauses.en: the region of configurations that return is an absorbing region;

clauses.zh: n 步之后可得者为一闭。
clauses.en: what can be had after n steps is an absorbing region.

clauses.zh: 行入一闭，则其后每步皆在其中。
clauses.en: If a run enters an absorbing region, it is in it at every step afterwards.

clauses.zh: 入，状在一域之外，而其行至于域中也。
clauses.en: Drawn into is: a configuration is outside a region, and its run comes into the region.

clauses.zh: 势，自外入一闭之诸状也。
clauses.en: A basin is the configurations drawn into an absorbing region from outside it.

clauses.zh: 凡法，一状入某闭，恰当其不复；
clauses.en: For every law, a configuration is drawn into some absorbing region exactly where it does not return;

clauses.zh: 不复者，入其自次步起所能至之闭。
clauses.en: a configuration that does not return is drawn into the absorbing region of what it can reach from the next step on.

clauses.zh: n 步之后不可得之状，入 n 步之后可得之闭。
clauses.en: A configuration that cannot be had after n steps is drawn into the absorbing region of what can be had after n steps.

clauses.zh: 所归，其状皆复、而有状自外入之之闭也。
clauses.en: An attractor is an absorbing region all of whose configurations return and into which some configuration is drawn from outside.

clauses.zh: 有一族尽诸状，则凡行皆至于复者，凡不复之状皆入复者之闭：复者之域为一闭，不复者皆在其势。
clauses.en: If one family exhausts the configurations, then every run comes to configurations that return, and every configuration that does not return is drawn into the absorbing region of those that return: the region of returning configurations is an absorbing region, and those that do not return all lie in its basin.

clauses.zh: 有一族尽诸状、状之同异定然否，则法不同归任何二状，恰当无状入。
clauses.en: If one family exhausts the configurations and their sameness is decided, then the law brings no two configurations to confluence exactly where no configuration is drawn into anything.

clauses.zh: 诸状无穷之处，有法入而不同归：以后继为法，零入，而无二状同归。
clauses.en: Where the configurations are infinite, there is a law under which a configuration is drawn into an absorbing region and there is no confluence: with successor as the law, zero is drawn into one, and no two configurations are in confluence.

clauses.zh: 成闭，入而不复也。
clauses.en: Lock-in is: drawn into an absorbing region and not returning.

clauses.zh: 凡法，状在一闭之外，其行于某步入之，则自此以往无一步再为此状。
clauses.en: For every law, if a configuration is outside an absorbing region and its run enters it at some step, then from then on the run is never at this configuration again.

clauses.zh: 故（五·七）凡变，状在一常中，则自之不能至常外之状；
clauses.en: So (5.7) for every process, if a configuration is in an invariant, then from it no configuration outside the invariant can be reached;

clauses.zh: 沿一行，自某步在一常中，则其后之状无一即其在常外之某步之状。
clauses.en: along a run, if it is in an invariant from some step, then none of its later configurations is the configuration of any step at which it was outside the invariant.

clauses.zh: 或入，状在一域之外，而自之能至域中之状也；
clauses.en: Possibly drawn into is: a configuration is outside a region, and from it some configuration in the region can be reached;

clauses.zh: 必入，状在域外，而自之之每一行皆至于域中也。
clauses.en: necessarily drawn into is: a configuration is outside the region, and every run from it comes into the region.

clauses.zh: 凡变，一状必入某常，恰当其不复；
clauses.en: For every process, a configuration is necessarily drawn into some invariant exactly where it does not return;

clauses.zh: 一状或入某常，恰当自之能至一不能至此状之状。
clauses.en: a configuration is possibly drawn into some invariant exactly where from it a configuration can be reached from which it cannot be reached.

clauses.zh: 法下，或入与必入皆即入。
clauses.en: Under a law, possibly drawn into and necessarily drawn into are both drawn into.

clauses.zh: 有一变，其一状或入一常而不必入，且复。
clauses.en: There is a process with a configuration that is possibly drawn into an invariant, is not necessarily drawn into it, and returns.

clauses.zh: 机，于一状 s，其一步之后犹能至 s、另一步之后不能至 s 之状也。
clauses.en: A juncture, for a configuration s, is a configuration after one step from which s can still be reached and after another step from which s cannot be reached.

clauses.zh: 机之二步之果不同；
clauses.en: The outcomes of the two steps of a juncture differ;

clauses.zh: 机或入。
clauses.en: a juncture is possibly drawn into.

clauses.zh: 凡 s 复，自 s 能至一状 t 而 t 不能至 s，则不可非有一机 y：自 s 能至 y，y 一步至一状 z，z 能至 t 而不能至 s。
clauses.en: For every s that returns, if from s a configuration t can be reached and t cannot reach s, then it cannot be refuted that there is a juncture y: y can be reached from s, y goes in one step to a configuration z, and z can reach t and cannot reach s.

clauses.zh: 自 s 所能至之每状能否至 s 皆定然否，则可指出此机；
clauses.en: If, for every configuration reachable from s, whether it can reach s is decided, then this juncture can be pointed out;

clauses.zh: 有一族尽诸状、一状一步能否至一状皆定然否，亦然。
clauses.en: the same holds if one family exhausts the configurations and whether a configuration can reach another in one step is decided.

clauses.zh: 若于凡变皆能指出每一失去之机，则无穷可尽。
clauses.en: If for every process every juncture at which something is lost could be pointed out, then the limited principle of omniscience would hold.

clauses.zh: 一状多步，不必成机：有一变，其唯一之状于每一自然数各有一步，而此状非其机。
clauses.en: A configuration with many steps need not be a juncture: there is a process whose only configuration has one step for each natural number, and this configuration is not a juncture of it.

clauses.zh: 护闭，于一状 s，变之步其后犹能至 s 者也；
clauses.en: Keeping, for a configuration s, is the steps of a process after which s can still be reached;

clauses.zh: 变之他步，其后不能至 s，为成闭之步（行之，则此途上 s 不可再至；
clauses.en: the other steps of the process, after which s cannot be reached, are steps of lock-in (taking one, s cannot be reached again on this path;

clauses.zh: 此步在自 s 之途上，则 s 或入，五·十三）。
clauses.en: if this step is on a path from s, then s is possibly drawn into, 5.13).

clauses.zh: 机，恰护闭与成闭于此皆有步之状。
clauses.en: A juncture is exactly a configuration at which both keeping and lock-in have steps.

clauses.zh: 护闭守 s：自 s 经护闭能至之处，皆能经护闭至 s。
clauses.en: Keeping keeps s: everything reachable from s through keeping can reach s through keeping.

clauses.zh: 凡子变守 s，自 s 之途上所行皆护闭之步：护闭为守 s 之最大者。
clauses.en: For every sub-process that keeps s, the steps it takes on paths from s are all steps of keeping: keeping is the greatest that keeps s.

clauses.zh: s 复，则护闭于其自 s 之途上所去者，恰机处成闭之步。
clauses.en: If s returns, then what keeping removes on paths from s is exactly the steps of lock-in at junctures.

clauses.zh: 只行成闭之步，s 不复。
clauses.en: Taking only steps of lock-in, s does not return.

clauses.zh: 变守 s，则自 s 能至者皆非 s 之机。
clauses.en: If a process keeps s, then nothing reachable from s is a juncture for s.

clauses.zh: 久，域之兼自某步起每步皆运，而其体各亡或皆无运于相隔若干步之二步也。
clauses.en: Persistence through change is: a whole is active at every step from some step on, while each of its parts ends, or none of its parts is active at two steps some number of steps apart.

clauses.zh: 域之兼自某步起每步皆运：其体皆无运于相隔 d 步之二步，则其后任 d 相续之步不得皆无体作；
clauses.en: Let a whole be active at every step from some step on: if no part of it is active at two steps d steps apart, then afterwards no d consecutive steps can all be without some part arising;

clauses.zh: 其体各亡而有列，则不得自某步起无体作，于任一族之外亦不得自某步起无体作。
clauses.en: if each of its parts ends and they have a census, then it cannot be that no part arises from some step on, and it also cannot be that no part outside any given family arises from some step on.

clauses.zh: 其体各亡而有列，自某步起无体作，则域之兼亡。
clauses.en: If each of its parts ends, they have a census, and from some step on no part arises, then the whole ends.

clauses.zh: 火传，凡次步载样式者，或本步已载之，或受递于本步载之者也：样式唯经递而至于新载者。
clauses.en: Passing on is: whatever carries a pattern at the next step either already carries it at this step or has it passed to it by something that carries it at this step: a pattern reaches a new carrier only by passing.

clauses.zh: 若火传，则凡始载者皆受递于本步载之者。
clauses.en: If there is passing on, then whatever begins to carry the pattern has it passed to it by something that carries it at the step before.

title: 火传之久
title_en: Persistence through change by passing on

clauses.zh: 凡样式自某步起每步有载之者，而载者皆无载于相隔 d 步之二步，则其后任 d 相续之步不得皆无始载者。
clauses.en: If from some step on a pattern has at each step something that carries it, and no carrier carries it at two steps d steps apart, then afterwards no d successive steps can all be without a carrier that begins to carry it.

clauses.zh: 若火传：样式自某步起每步有载之者，而载者皆无载于相隔 d 步之二步，则自此任 d 相续之步必有一步有递；
clauses.en: Under passing on: if from some step on a pattern has at each step something that carries it, and no carrier carries it at two steps d steps apart, then from then on any d successive steps include a step at which the pattern passes to a carrier;

clauses.zh: 一步无载者，此后皆无载者；
clauses.en: If at one step nothing carries the pattern, then at every later step nothing carries it;

clauses.zh: 载者皆无载于相隔 d 步之二步，而自某步 T 起无递，则自 T＋d 起无载者。
clauses.en: If no carrier carries the pattern at two steps d steps apart, and from some step T on the pattern passes to nothing, then from T + d on nothing carries it.

clauses.zh: 恒持，凡于一步待此所待者，其待于此步皆持也。
clauses.en: Renewed: for every step, every dependence on this condition at that step is kept across that step.

clauses.zh: 终足，凡于一步待之者，其步之需皆于其后某步足也。
clauses.en: Restored: for every step, the need of every dependence on this condition at that step is met at some later step.

clauses.zh: 期，其步数之上界也：凡待皆于其后 p 步之内足，谓之以 p 为期而终足。
clauses.en: A return bound is an upper bound on a number of steps: if every dependence is met within p steps after its step, the condition is said to be restored with return bound p.

clauses.zh: 以零为期而终足，恰当无物待之。
clauses.en: Restored with return bound zero holds exactly where no relatum depends on the condition.

clauses.zh: 终不足，有一待者于一步待此所待，其后每步此所待之积皆在彼步之需之下也。
clauses.en: Consumed: some formation depends on this condition at a step, and at every later step the level of this condition is below the need of that step.

clauses.zh: 绝而终不足，有一待于一步绝，其后每步此所待之积皆在彼步之需之下也。
clauses.en: Broken for good: some dependence is broken at a step, and at every later step the level of this condition is below the need of that step.

clauses.zh: 凡绝而终不足者，终不足。
clauses.en: Every condition broken for good is consumed.

clauses.zh: 有一待网，其一所待终不足，而无一待于其上绝。
clauses.en: There is a web in which one condition is consumed and no dependence on it is broken.

clauses.zh: 凡所待恒持，则以一为期而终足；
clauses.en: Every renewed condition is restored with return bound one;

clauses.zh: 以 p 为期而终足者，以大于 p 者为期亦然，且终足；
clauses.en: A condition restored with return bound p is likewise restored with every return bound greater than p, and is restored;

clauses.zh: 终足者不终不足；
clauses.en: A restored condition is not consumed;

clauses.zh: 终不足，恰当有一待，其后无一步足彼步之需。
clauses.en: A condition is consumed exactly where there is a dependence whose need of its step no later step meets.

clauses.zh: 有一所待，以二为期而终足，不以一为期，亦不恒持；
clauses.en: There is a condition restored with return bound two, not with return bound one, and not renewed;

clauses.zh: 有一所待，终足而无一期。
clauses.en: There is a condition that is restored and has no return bound.

clauses.zh: 恒，物于每步或待或资之所待皆恒持也；
clauses.en: Renewing: every condition a relatum depends on or draws from at each step is renewed;

clauses.zh: 竭，物于某步资一终不足之所待也。
clauses.en: Consuming: a relatum at some step draws from a consumed condition.

clauses.zh: 凡恒者不竭，且每步皆见容。
clauses.en: Every renewing relatum is not consuming, and is admitted at every step.

clauses.zh: 有一物，不恒亦不竭。
clauses.en: There is a relatum that is neither renewing nor consuming.

title: 恒竭属行
title_en: Renewing and consuming belong to the run

clauses.zh: 有一变，自一状起有二行，资之者于二行每步皆运，于此行恒，于彼行竭，而待之者于彼行自第一步起不运。
clauses.en: There is a process with two runs from one configuration such that the relatum that draws from a condition is active at every step on both runs, is renewing on one run and consuming on the other, and the formation that depends on the condition is not active on the other run from the first step on.

clauses.zh: 在待之者唯见容则与之族中（一所待，待之者唯于见容之步与之 r，资之者唯于见容之步资之），需为正而始积不下于需：二资之者每步所取各不过 r，则各自资之皆恒；
clauses.en: In a family where giving waits on admission of the dependent (one condition; the formation that depends on it gives it r only at steps at which it is admitted, and the relata that draw from it draw only at steps at which that formation is admitted), with positive need and a starting level not below the need: if two relata that draw from the condition each take no more than r at each step, then each of them, drawing alone, is renewing;

clauses.zh: 二者合读为一共资之者，而每步共取过 r，则共资之者竭，自某步起共资之者与待之者皆不运。
clauses.en: If the two are read together as one joint drawer, and the joint taking exceeds r at each step, then the joint drawer is consuming, and from some step on neither the joint drawer nor the formation that depends on the condition is active.

clauses.zh: 有一变，凡有穷之界 h，有二行，其状与动于 h 前无异，其间每步此所待共取过与，资之者每事皆在恒之内（于其步运，而其或待或资之诸所待上每一待于此步皆持），而一行恒，一行竭。
clauses.en: There is a process such that for every finite bound h there are two runs whose configurations and moves do not differ before h, at every step between which this condition has joint excess, every event of the relatum that draws from it is within renewal (active at its step, and every dependence on each condition it depends on or draws from is kept across that step), and one run is renewing while the other is consuming.

clauses.zh: 故于此变，凡读定于前 h 步之往而含凡恒之行者，必含一竭之行；
clauses.en: So for this process, every reading fixed by the prefix of the first h steps that includes every renewing run must include a consuming run;

clauses.zh: 以出入相掩为读者，定于每步之往，而不认二行于界前之每次取。
clauses.en: The reading by taking within giving is fixed by the prefix at each step, and does not distinguish the two runs at any uptake before the bound.

clauses.zh: 剥，物于一步资一所待，步后其积既在一待于其步之需之下，又在此待自某步起不断而在、彼步曾足之需之下也。
clauses.en: Undermining: a relatum draws from a condition at a step, and after the step the level of the condition is both below the need of a dependence at that step and below a need this dependence met at some step from which it has stood without interruption.

clauses.zh: 凡资而其步绝一待者，剥也；
clauses.en: Every drawing at whose step a dependence is broken is undermining;

clauses.zh: 物一步在恒之内者不剥；
clauses.en: A relatum within renewal at a step does not undermine;

clauses.zh: 恒者每运之步皆在恒之内。
clauses.en: A renewing relatum is within renewal at every step at which it is active.

clauses.zh: 凡物于一步剥一所待，则有一待者于此步以正需待此所待，而二者此步之事交（二·十四）。
clauses.en: If a relatum undermines a condition at a step, then some formation has a bearing dependence on this condition at that step, and the events of the two at that step interact (2.14).

title: 沿相续之恒与竭
title_en: Renewing and consuming along the continuation relation

clauses.zh: 沿相续而恒，凡续之者其或待或资之所待皆恒持也；
clauses.en: Renewing along the continuation relation: every condition that anything continuing a relatum depends on or draws from is renewed;

clauses.zh: 沿相续而竭，有续之者资一终不足之所待也（续之者，逐步自步前运者至相续读为其续而步后运者，三·十一）。
clauses.en: Consuming along the continuation relation: something continuing a relatum draws from a consumed condition (what continues it: step by step, from what is active before the step to what the continuation relation reads as its continuation and is active after the step, 3.11).

clauses.zh: 沿相续而剥，物于一步资一所待，步后其积既在一待于其步之需之下，又在此待者沿相续所续之某者于其步曾足之需之下也（其间相续之每一步，前后皆待此所待）。
clauses.en: Undermining along the continuation relation: a relatum draws from a condition at a step, and after the step the level of the condition is both below the need of a dependence at that step and below a need that some formation this dependent formation continues along the continuation relation met at its step (at each step of the continuation relation between, the formations before and after both depend on this condition).

clauses.zh: 沿相续而恒，恰当本步其或待或资之所待皆恒持，而凡本步运、相续读为其续、次步运者皆沿相续而恒：恒入裂之每支。
clauses.en: A relatum is renewing along the continuation relation exactly where every condition it depends on or draws from at this step is renewed, and everything active at the next step that the continuation relation reads as its continuation is renewing along the continuation relation: renewing passes into each branch of a split.

clauses.zh: 沿相续而竭，恰当本步资一终不足之所待，或有本步运、相续读为其续、次步运者沿相续而竭：合者竭，则合入之每者皆竭。
clauses.en: A relatum is consuming along the continuation relation exactly where at this step it draws from a consumed condition, or something active at the next step that the continuation relation reads as its continuation is consuming along the continuation relation: if what a merge yields is consuming, each relatum merged into it is consuming.

clauses.zh: 改认而带其相续，续之者不改，沿相续而恒、沿相续而竭、沿相续而剥皆不改。
clauses.en: Under a re-identification that carries its continuation relation with it, what continues a relatum does not change, and renewing, consuming and undermining along the continuation relation do not change.

clauses.zh: 以存读运（三·十八），改认而跨步皆存者之名不改，则每步皆存者，其恒与竭皆不改。
clauses.en: Reading activity by persists (3.18), if a re-identification does not change the names of what persists across a step, then for what persists at every step, renewing and consuming do not change.

clauses.zh: 物每步运而唯自续者，自第零步沿相续而恒、沿相续而竭，即恒与竭；
clauses.en: For a relatum active at every step and continued only by itself, renewing and consuming along the continuation relation from step zero are renewing and consuming;

clauses.zh: 唯自续者，沿相续而剥即剥。
clauses.en: For what is continued only by itself, undermining along the continuation relation is undermining.

clauses.zh: 所容，一步诸积所容之待者也（容见二·一）。
clauses.en: The generative space is the formations that the levels at a step admit (for admission see 2.1).

clauses.zh: 凡于一步，积于每所待不低于他积，则容他积之所容。
clauses.en: For every step, if the levels at every condition are not lower than other levels, then they admit everything in the generative space of the other levels.

clauses.zh: 赅，一积之历于每步容他历之所容也。
clauses.en: Includes: one history of levels admits at every step what another history admits.

clauses.zh: 有所长，一历于某步容一他历所不容者也。
clauses.en: Exceeds: one history admits at some step something another history does not admit.

clauses.zh: 凡积之历自赅；
clauses.en: Every history of levels includes itself;

clauses.zh: 甲赅乙、乙赅丙，则甲赅丙；
clauses.en: If A includes B and B includes C, then A includes C;

clauses.zh: 赅他历者，不为他历所长。
clauses.en: A history that includes another is not exceeded by it.

title: 广、狭、相赅、互有所长
title_en: Widens, narrows, keeps the same, mixed

clauses.zh: 广，赅而有所长也；
clauses.en: Widens: includes and exceeds;

clauses.zh: 狭，为他历所广也；
clauses.en: Narrows: another history widens it;

clauses.zh: 相赅，互赅也；
clauses.en: Keeps the same: each includes the other;

clauses.zh: 互有所长，此有所长于彼、彼亦有所长于此也。
clauses.en: Mixed: this exceeds that, and that also exceeds this.

clauses.zh: 广不可逆而可传；
clauses.en: Widening cannot be reversed and is transitive;

clauses.zh: 广非相赅，广非互有所长，相赅非互有所长。
clauses.en: Widening is not keeping the same, widening is not mixed, and keeping the same is not mixed.

clauses.zh: 于一步，凡待一所待者，其待跨步犹在而需不减，而一积之历于步后容凡待之者：若有物于其步剥此所待，则此历有所长于待网之积；
clauses.en: At a step, if every dependence on a condition still stands across the step with its need not decreased, and a history of levels admits after the step every formation that depends on it: if some relatum undermines this condition at that step, then this history exceeds the levels of the web;

clauses.zh: 待网之积赅此历，则其步无物剥此所待。
clauses.en: If the levels of the web include this history, then no relatum undermines this condition at that step.

clauses.zh: 有宇焉：衡而耗，有待；
clauses.en: There is a world that balances, dissipates and is dependent;

clauses.zh: 一物唯待一所待，此所待恒持、自外来、出入相掩，其物每步运而见容，而于一步剥他物所待之所待，他物自第二步起不运。
clauses.en: one relatum depends on one condition only, this condition is renewed, fed from beyond and taking within giving, this relatum is active and admitted at every step, and at one step it undermines the condition another relatum depends on, and the other relatum is not active from the second step on.

clauses.zh: 偏去，体之员不取不与，而体外之取与如故也。
clauses.en: A part withheld: the members of the part take nothing and give nothing, while the taking and giving outside the part are as before.

clauses.zh: 偏去之积，自同一始积起，每步依偏去体之流之取与而变之积也；
clauses.en: The levels under a part withheld are the levels that, from one and the same starting level, change at each step by the taking and giving of the flow with the part withheld;

clauses.zh: 有之则唯一。
clauses.en: Where they exist, they are unique.

clauses.zh: 凡衡，每步每所待：积加体之累取，等偏去之积加体之累与。
clauses.en: Under every balance, at each step and each condition: the level plus the cumulative uptake of the part equals the level under the part withheld plus the cumulative replenishment of the part.

clauses.zh: 生，生成也，与退化相对。
clauses.en: Generation is generating, as opposed to degeneration.

clauses.zh: 体之成生，积之历广偏去此体之积之历也；
clauses.en: A part is generative where the history of levels widens the history of levels with this part withheld;

clauses.zh: 绝生，偏去此体之积之历广积之历也。
clauses.en: Degenerative: the history of levels with this part withheld widens the history of levels.

clauses.zh: 体之于所容，成生、绝生、相赅、互有所长，四者不相兼。
clauses.en: For the generative space, a part being generative, degenerative, keeping the same and mixed are four that do not overlap.

clauses.zh: 余地，偏去体之积过一需之量也。
clauses.en: The margin is the amount by which the level with a part withheld exceeds a need.

clauses.zh: 凡衡，一待者于一步见容，恰当于其每所待，需加体之累取不过偏去之积加体之累与。
clauses.en: Under every balance, a formation is admitted at a step exactly where at each of its conditions the need plus the cumulative uptake of the part is no more than the level with the part withheld plus the cumulative replenishment of the part.

clauses.zh: 衡只须在此待者之所待、在此步之前。
clauses.en: The balance is needed only at the conditions of this formation and before this step.

clauses.zh: 阖，偏去体之积容之而积不容之也；
clauses.en: Closing off: the levels with a part withheld admit a formation and the levels do not admit it;

clauses.zh: 闢，积容之而偏去体之积不容之也。
clauses.en: Opening: the levels admit a formation and the levels with the part withheld do not admit it.

clauses.zh: 凡衡：体至一步，于一待者之每所待累取不过累与，则偏去之积容此待者，积即容之，故阖须取过与；
clauses.en: Under every balance: if up to a step the cumulative uptake of the part at each condition of a formation is no more than its cumulative replenishment, then where the levels with the part withheld admit this formation, the levels admit it; so closing off needs taking beyond giving;

clauses.zh: 累与不过累取，则积容此待者，偏去之积即容之，故闢须与过取；
clauses.en: If the cumulative replenishment is no more than the cumulative uptake, then where the levels admit this formation, the levels with the part withheld admit it; so opening needs giving beyond taking;

clauses.zh: 体每步于每所待，与不少于取，则积之历赅偏去之积之历，无所阖；
clauses.en: If at each step and each condition the part gives no less than it takes, then the history of levels includes the history of levels with the part withheld, and nothing is closed off;

clauses.zh: 与不多于取，则偏去之积之历赅积之历，无所闢；
clauses.en: If it gives no more than it takes, then the history of levels with the part withheld includes the history of levels, and nothing is opened;

clauses.zh: 所与恰等所取，则相赅。
clauses.en: If what is given exactly equals what is taken, the two histories keep the same.

clauses.zh: 凡衡，积之历广偏去体之积之历，恰当：凡偏去之积所容者，于其每所待，需加体之累取皆不过偏去之积加体之累与；
clauses.en: Under every balance, the history of levels widens the history of levels with a part withheld exactly where: for every formation the levels with the part withheld admit, at each of its conditions the need plus the cumulative uptake of the part is no more than the level with the part withheld plus the cumulative replenishment of the part;

clauses.zh: 且于某步，有一偏去之积所不容之待者，于其每所待，需加体之累取不过偏去之积加体之累与。
clauses.en: and at some step there is a formation the levels with the part withheld do not admit for which, at each of its conditions, the need plus the cumulative uptake of the part is no more than the level with the part withheld plus the cumulative replenishment of the part.

clauses.zh: 衡只须在每一待者之所待、在其步之前。
clauses.en: The balance is needed only at the conditions of each formation and before its step.

clauses.zh: 益，一族之总积跨一步而升也。
clauses.en: Gain: the total level of a family rises across a step.

clauses.zh: 凡一族自 T 至 T＋N 诸步其状两两相异，N 为 T 时总积之内之状数，则 T 与 T＋N 之间有一步，跨之而益。
clauses.en: For every family, if its configurations at the steps from T to T + N are pairwise different, where N is the number of configurations within the total level at T, then between T and T + N there is a step across which it gains.

clauses.zh: 凡一族自某步起日新，则屡有益；
clauses.en: If a family has novelty from some step on, then gain recurs;

clauses.zh: 于任一界，其总积屡过之。
clauses.en: for every bound, the total level being above it recurs.

clauses.zh: 益之者，跨一步在场、与一族多于其所取于族者也。
clauses.en: A net giver: across a step it takes part, and gives to a family more than it takes from the family.

clauses.zh: 凡一族跨一步而益，计入其余，则有益之者：或其余，或一在场之待者。
clauses.en: If a family gains across a step, then, counting the rest of the whole, there is a net giver: either the rest of the whole or a formation taking part.

clauses.zh: 其余为益之者，恰当于族之诸所待，步后之积加共取过步前之积加共与之量，其和多于步前之积加共与过步后之积加共取之量之和。
clauses.en: The rest of the whole is a net giver exactly where, over the conditions of the family, the sum of the amounts by which the level after the step plus the joint taking exceeds the level before the step plus the joint replenishment is more than the sum of the amounts by which the level before the step plus the joint replenishment exceeds the level after the step plus the joint taking.

clauses.zh: 流于其族跨此步衡，则其余非益之者。
clauses.en: If the flow balances on the family across this step, the rest of the whole is not a net giver.

clauses.zh: 凡与不过取：员各异之族跨一步而益，则其余为其益之者，或族于其步不封；
clauses.en: Under every gainless flow: if a family with distinct members gains across a step, then the rest of the whole is its net giver, or the family is not closed at that step;

clauses.zh: 一族自某步起日新，则凡含其员而员各异之族，屡有一步，或其余为其益之者，或不封；
clauses.en: If a family has novelty from some step on, then for every family with distinct members that contains its members, it recurs that at some step either the rest of the whole is its net giver or the family is not closed;

clauses.zh: 自 T 起，无尽之诸待者各于一步初见容（自 T 以来首见容），后者之步皆晚于前者，各待者之待与需不变而所待皆在一员各异之族中：则此族屡有一步，或其余为其益之者，或不封。
clauses.en: If from T on endlessly many formations are each first admitted at a step (admitted for the first time since T), each later one at a later step, each with its dependence and need unchanged and all of its conditions in one family with distinct members: then for this family it recurs that at some step either the rest of the whole is its net giver or the family is not closed.

clauses.zh: 凡兼，其所待尽在一族而族之员各异，与不过取，自 T 步起其余不为其益之者：则自 T 起每步之后皆有二步共一状，自 T 起非日新。
clauses.en: For every whole of the unfolding whose conditions all lie in one family with distinct members, under a gainless flow, if from step T on the rest of the whole is not its net giver: then after every step from T on there are two steps with one configuration, and from T on there is no novelty.

clauses.zh: 凡衡，唯运者取，且唯取于其所资：体之员所资之所待皆恒持，则积之历赅偏去体之积之历，而不为其所广。
clauses.en: Under every balance in which only what is active takes, and takes only from what it draws from: if the conditions the members of a part draw from are all renewed, then the history of levels includes the history of levels with the part withheld, and is not widened by it.

clauses.zh: 凡衡，体每步于每所待与不多于取；
clauses.en: Under every balance in which at each step and each condition the part gives no more than it takes;

clauses.zh: 一待者于 T 步待一所待，其后此所待之积永不及其 T 时之需，而偏去之积于其后某步容此待者，其时此待犹在而需不小于 T 时：则偏去之积之历广积之历。
clauses.en: if a formation depends on a condition at step T, the level of this condition afterwards never reaches its need at T, and the levels with the part withheld admit this formation at some later step at which this dependence still stands with need not less than at T: then the history of levels with the part withheld widens the history of levels.

clauses.zh: 凡衡，唯运者取，且唯取于其所资，唯运者与之：体之员无一于始步运，亦无一作，则积之历与偏去之积之历相赅。
clauses.en: Under every balance in which only what is active takes, and takes only from what it draws from, and only what is active gives: if no member of the part is active at the first step and none arises, then the history of levels and the history of levels with the part withheld keep the same.

clauses.zh: 以一读读此宇之待者于彼宇：凡此宇之积之历所容者，读之皆为彼宇之积之历所容，曰沿读而赅；
clauses.en: With a reading that reads the formations of this world into that world: if everything the history of levels of this world admits is, as read, admitted by the history of levels of that world, this is called including along the reading;

clauses.zh: 彼历于某步容一待者，而凡读为之者此历于其步皆不容，曰沿读而有所长；
clauses.en: if that history admits a formation at some step that this history admits at that step under no formation read as it, this is called exceeding along the reading;

clauses.zh: 二者皆然，曰沿读而广。
clauses.en: where both hold, this is called widening along the reading.

clauses.zh: 读为自身，沿读而广即广。
clauses.en: Where the reading reads each formation as itself, widening along the reading is widening.

clauses.zh: 凡宇增新待者与新所待，旧待者之待与需不改，旧所待之积如故：则以每一旧待者读为长成之宇中之其自身，长成之宇沿此读而广，恰当某步容一新待者；
clauses.en: For every world that grows by new formations and new conditions, with the dependences and needs of the old formations unchanged and the levels of the old conditions as before: under the reading of each old formation as itself in the grown world, the grown world widens along this reading exactly where at some step it admits a new formation;

clauses.zh: 而以其旧所待之积只就旧待者较之，不广亦不狭。
clauses.en: and compared only on the old formations by the levels of their old conditions, it neither widens nor narrows.

clauses.zh: 自 T 步至其后 U 步，沿一相续：凡 T 步所容者，皆有相续之链续至 U 步所容之一者，曰沿续而赅；
clauses.en: From step T to a later step U, along a continuation relation: if everything admitted at step T has a chain of the continuation relation continuing it to something admitted at step U, this is called including along continuation;

clauses.zh: U 步所容有一者，凡以链续至之者 T 步皆不容，曰沿续而有所长；
clauses.en: if something admitted at step U is such that nothing continued to it by a chain is admitted at step T, this is called exceeding along continuation;

clauses.zh: 二者皆然，曰沿续而广。
clauses.en: where both hold, this is called widening along continuation.

clauses.zh: 各续其自身（T 不后于 U），则沿续而赅、沿续而有所长，即以名之赅与有所长；
clauses.en: Where each continues only itself (T not later than U), including and exceeding along continuation are includes and exceeds by name;

clauses.zh: 凡改认而携此相续者，不改沿续而广；
clauses.en: Every re-identification that carries this continuation relation with it does not change widening along continuation;

clauses.zh: 相续之链愈多，赅愈易，有所长愈难。
clauses.en: The more chains the continuation relation has, the easier including is and the harder exceeding is.

clauses.zh: 讀（AI，D1、D5）：生生，生而所生又生也：所成者保、补、递、创后生之所待与生者；
clauses.en: Reading (AI, D1, D5): continuing generation is generation whose generated in turn generates: what comes to be keeps, supplements, passes on and creates the conditions of later generation and what generates;

clauses.zh: 其向以广较之，而广之所记不尽生生（六·十四、六·十五）。
clauses.en: its direction is compared by widening, and what widening records does not exhaust continuing generation (6.14, 6.15).

clauses.zh: 域外有失，于一步，域外有一物，他积容之而此积不容也。
clauses.en: Losing beyond a region: at a step, there is a relatum beyond the region that other levels admit and these levels do not admit.

clauses.zh: 一历赅他历，恰当每步于每域之内，皆容他历之所容。
clauses.en: One history includes another exactly where at every step, within every region, it admits what the other history admits.

clauses.zh: 于一步：于一域内赅者，于其内每域亦赅；
clauses.en: At a step: what includes within a region includes within every region inside it;

clauses.zh: 域外有失者，于其内每域之外亦有失；
clauses.en: What loses beyond a region also loses beyond every region inside it;

clauses.zh: 兼之外无失。
clauses.en: Nothing is lost beyond the whole of the unfolding.

title: 广为诸轻重之所共
title_en: Widening is what every weighting shares

clauses.zh: 于一族之事，二历所容之事皆在族中，容皆定然否：一历广他历，恰当凡正轻重，皆以此历之轻重计数多于他历；
clauses.en: For the events of a family, where the events both histories admit all lie in the family and admission is decided: one history widens another exactly where for every positive weighting this history counts more under the weighting than the other;

clauses.zh: 凡一类之序，含诸正轻重之序，而其每序皆上每一广者于其所广者：一历广他历，恰当此类之每序皆上此历于他历，可加与否皆然。
clauses.en: For every class of orders of alternatives that contains the orders of the positive weightings and each of whose orders ranks every widening history above the history it widens: one history widens another exactly where every order of this class ranks this history above the other, whether the orders are additive or not.

clauses.zh: 于所列之事：互有所长者，有正轻重上此，亦有上彼者；
clauses.en: Over listed events: for mixed histories, some positive weighting ranks this one above, and some ranks that one above;

clauses.zh: 此赅彼而所多之事其重皆零，则二者之轻重计数等；
clauses.en: If this includes that and every event in which it has more has weight zero, the two count equally under the weighting;

clauses.zh: 每事同一正重，以所容之数为序。
clauses.en: With one and the same positive weight for every event, the order ranks by the number of events admitted.

clauses.zh: 象（一·三）予一者之值，谓之其像。
clauses.en: The value a model (1.3) gives an item is called its image.

clauses.zh: 类，配所论之每一者一值，而并值同者也；
clauses.en: A lumping assigns each item under consideration one value, and puts together those with the same value;

clauses.zh: 一者所得之值，谓之其类。
clauses.en: The value an item receives is called its class.

clauses.zh: 一象随类而同，类同之二者其像皆同也。
clauses.en: A model is same by class for a lumping where any two items of the same class have the same image.

clauses.zh: 凡象随一类而同，则亦随凡更细之类而同：更细之类所并者，此类皆并之。
clauses.en: If a model is same by class for a lumping, it is also same by class for every finer lumping: what the finer lumping puts together, this lumping puts together.

clauses.zh: 类并一切者，随之而同之象，恰其像处处皆同。
clauses.en: For a lumping that puts everything together, a model same by class for it is exactly a model whose image is the same everywhere.

clauses.zh: 理，于一变，凡类同之二状以同一动之果亦类同之类也。
clauses.en: A law-carrying lumping, for a process, is a lumping under which any two configurations of the same class have outcomes of the same class under one and the same move.

clauses.zh: 凡变与类，有一法行于其类之上，而变之每步经此类皆为此法所许，恰当此类于此变为理；
clauses.en: For every process and lumping, there is a law on the classes of the lumping that allows every step of the process through the lumping, exactly where this lumping is a law-carrying lumping for this process.

clauses.zh: 以其类代状之变为法，亦恰当此。
clauses.en: That the process with classes in place of configurations is a law also holds exactly there.

clauses.zh: 以其类代状之变，许变经此类之每步；
clauses.en: The process with classes in place of configurations allows every step of the process through the lumping;

clauses.zh: 凡许变经此类之每步者，皆许以其类代状之变之每步。
clauses.en: Everything that allows every step of the process through the lumping allows every step of the process with classes in place of configurations.

clauses.zh: 凡法，每状唯一动、恰有一次状者，一类于此法为理，恰当次状之类随此类而同。
clauses.en: For every law with exactly one move and exactly one next configuration at each configuration, a lumping is a law-carrying lumping for this law exactly where the class of the next configuration is same by class for this lumping.

clauses.zh: 推类，以所见之值定与之同类而未见者之值也。
clauses.en: Generalization fixes, from the values in the data, the values of what is of the same class as the data and is not in them.

clauses.zh: 所见为一族，类之同异定然否，象之值有相异之二：于随此类而同之诸象，所见之值定一者 x 之值，恰当所见中有与 x 同类者。
clauses.en: Where the data are a family, sameness and difference of class are decided, and the model takes two different values: over the models same by class for this lumping, the values in the data fix the value of an item x exactly where the data contain something of the same class as x.

clauses.zh: 所论者之同异定然否，象之值有相异之二：于凡象，所见之值不定任一未见者之值。
clauses.en: Where sameness and difference of the items under consideration are decided and the model takes two different values: over every model, the values in the data do not fix the value of any item not in the data.

clauses.zh: g 随一类而同，于所见与 f 同值，则于与所见之 d 同类之 x，g 之值为 f 之值，恰当 f 于 d 与 x 同值。
clauses.en: If g is same by class for a lumping and has the same values as f on the data, then for x of the same class as d in the data, the value of g is the value of f exactly where f has the same value at d and at x.

clauses.zh: 凡辞由原子以真、伪、且、或、则、凡、有构成者，二读于每原子所配之辞互推，则所得之辞互推，无设。
clauses.en: For every claim built from atoms by true, false, and, or, implies, every and some: if two readings assign to each atom claims that imply each other, then the resulting claims imply each other, with no supposition.

clauses.zh: 辞之读，于凡互推之二辞皆取同一值，谓之随互推而同。
clauses.en: A reading of claims that gives one and the same value to any two claims that imply each other is called same under mutual implication.

clauses.zh: 凡辞至辞之读皆随互推而同，恰当互推之辞即为一；
clauses.en: Every reading from claims to claims is same under mutual implication exactly where claims that imply each other are one;

clauses.zh: 以名读随互推而同，亦恰当此；
clauses.en: That the reading by name is same under mutual implication also holds exactly there;

clauses.zh: 以名读随之，则凡辞之读皆随之。
clauses.en: If the reading by name is so, then every reading of claims is so.

clauses.zh: 以关系所构之读，不待此而守互推：所得为互推，不为一。
clauses.en: A reading built from relations keeps mutual implication without needing this: what results implies each other, and is not one.

title: 与象可换序之法
title_en: Laws that commute with a model

clauses.zh: 法与一象可换序，于每一状先取其像而后进一步，与先进一步而后取其像，所得之状同也。
clauses.en: A law commutes with a model where, at every configuration, taking its image and then advancing one step, and advancing one step and then taking its image, give the same configuration.

clauses.zh: 象移每一状，则凡与之可换序之法，自一状与自其像之二行，于同一步永不在同一状；
clauses.en: If a model moves every configuration, then for every law that commutes with it, the two runs from a configuration and from its image are never at the same configuration at the same step;

clauses.zh: 亦无一步使凡行皆在一状；
clauses.en: nor is there a step at which every run is at one configuration;

clauses.zh: 故凡于某步使此二行同在一状之法，皆不与此象可换序。
clauses.en: so every law that at some step brings these two runs to one configuration does not commute with this model.

clauses.zh: 法与一象可换序，则自象所不移之状起之行，其每步之状象皆不移；
clauses.en: If a law commutes with a model, then on a run from a configuration the model does not move, the model does not move the configuration at any step;

clauses.zh: 一类并每一状与其像而不并他者，则此类于此法为理。
clauses.en: A lumping that puts each configuration together with its image and with nothing else is a law-carrying lumping for this law.

clauses.zh: 未定，真伪之外第三值，于所知在真伪之下，修正所未定者也。
clauses.en: Undecided is a third value besides true and false, below true and false in what is known, which revision has not decided.

clauses.zh: 凡 N 辞，各言一以非、且、或合诸辞与真伪而成之式，只相言，自皆未定而修正，自第 N 步起不再改，第 N 步之状为此 N 辞之最小之静；
clauses.en: For N claims, each stating a formula built from the claims and true and false by not, and, or, speaking only of one another, revised starting from all undecided: from step N on they change no more, and the configuration at step N is the least stillness of these N claims;

clauses.zh: 首辞言真、后辞各非其前，则其前 N+1 辞自第 N 步至次步犹有改。
clauses.en: If the first claim states true and each later claim negates the one before it, then the first N+1 claims still change from step N to the next step.

clauses.zh: 诸辞所言之式皆无真伪之项，则修正之每步，诸辞皆未定。
clauses.en: If the formulas the claims state contain no term true or false, then at every step of revision every claim is undecided.

clauses.zh: N 辞只相言而二值修正于此无静，则三值修正之每一静皆留一辞未定：自非之辞，二值修正每步皆改，三值修正每步皆未定。
clauses.en: If N claims speak only of one another and two-valued revision has no stillness on them, then every stillness of three-valued revision leaves a claim undecided: for a claim that negates itself, two-valued revision changes at every step and three-valued revision is undecided at every step.

clauses.zh: 先后，诸取与之次也；
clauses.en: The order of steps is the sequence of takings and givings;

clauses.zh: 一物之先后，触此物之诸取与之次也。
clauses.en: The order of steps of a relatum is the sequence of the takings and givings that touch this relatum.

clauses.zh: 交错，合诸物之先后为一先后也：于其中，触每一物之诸取与，其次皆如此物之先后。
clauses.en: An interleaving combines the orders of steps of the relata into one order of steps: in it, the takings and givings that touch each relatum follow the order of steps of that relatum.

title: 不共触一物者先后可易
title_en: Takings and givings that touch no relatum in common can exchange their order of steps

clauses.zh: 凡取与不改所不触，所触之改唯依所触：二取与不共触一物，则先后相易而其后之状同。
clauses.en: If takings and givings change nothing they do not touch, and change what they touch only according to what they touch: where two takings and givings touch no relatum in common, exchanging their order of steps leaves the same configuration after.

clauses.zh: 诸物有一族尽之，则二取与之族使每物之先后皆同者，自同一状起终于同一状，每物于其每一取与之后之值亦同，其次亦同；
clauses.en: If one family contains all the relata, then two families of takings and givings that give every relatum the same order of steps, starting from one and the same configuration, end at one and the same configuration, and each relatum has the same value after each of its takings and givings, in the same sequence;

clauses.zh: 故同一诸先后之二交错，自同一状起终于同一状。
clauses.en: So two interleavings of the same orders of steps, starting from one and the same configuration, end at one and the same configuration.

title: 诸物之先后何时定其交错
title_en: When the orders of steps of the relata fix their interleaving

clauses.zh: 凡取与不改所不触，所触之改唯依所触，诸物有一族尽之：诸物之先后定其交错，恰当每一取与皆至少触一物，且每二取与或同一、或共触一物。
clauses.en: If takings and givings change nothing they do not touch, change what they touch only according to what they touch, and one family contains all the relata: the orders of steps of the relata fix their interleaving exactly where every taking and giving touches at least one relatum, and every two takings and givings are either the same or touch a relatum in common.

clauses.zh: 取与之同异定然否，则配每物以一先后，有交错合之，恰当以诸先后所含取与之总数为步数调度之而能完。
clauses.en: Where sameness of takings and givings is decided, an assignment of an order of steps to each relatum has an interleaving combining them exactly where scheduling them in a number of steps equal to the total number of takings and givings the orders contain can be completed.

clauses.zh: 凡取与不改所不触，所触之改唯依所触，物之值以自然数计，诸物之同异定然否，诸物有一族尽之：一交错所成之宇，此族之员各异，则步步皆衡；
clauses.en: If takings and givings change nothing they do not touch, change what they touch only according to what they touch, values of relata are counted in natural numbers, sameness of relata is decided, and one family contains all the relata: in the world an interleaving forms, if the members of this family are distinct, there is balance at every step;

clauses.zh: 二不共触一物之取与相邻而易其先后，二宇之积唯于其间一步或异。
clauses.en: If two adjacent takings and givings that touch no relatum in common exchange their order of steps, the levels of the two worlds differ at most at the one step between them.

clauses.zh: 同一诸先后之二交错所成之二宇：一物之积有某性，于此宇有一步有之，恰当于彼宇有一步有之；
clauses.en: For the two worlds formed by two interleavings of the same orders of steps: a property of the level of a relatum holds at some step in this world exactly where it holds at some step in that world;

clauses.zh: 于此宇步步有之，恰当于彼宇步步有之。
clauses.en: it holds at every step in this world exactly where it holds at every step in that world.

clauses.zh: 又有步之重排，使只读一步之取与所触诸物之关系者，于此宇此步及其次步，与彼宇所排之步及其次步同然；
clauses.en: There is moreover a renumbering of steps such that what reads only the relations among the relata touched by the taking and giving of one step holds alike at this step and its next step in this world and at the renumbered step and its next step in that world;

clauses.zh: 二交错之取与皆至少触一物，则此重排于其长之内为诸步之一一重排，以彼向之重排为逆。
clauses.en: If every taking and giving of the two interleavings touches at least one relatum, this renumbering is a one-to-one renumbering of the steps within their length, with the renumbering in the other direction as its inverse.

clauses.zh: 读其所不触诸物之关系，则可随交错而异：有二物，同一诸先后之二交错所成之二宇，一宇有一步甲之积少于乙，另一宇无一步如此。
clauses.en: Reading the relations among relata they do not touch can differ with the interleaving: there are two relata, A and B, and two worlds formed by two interleavings of the same orders of steps, such that in one world at some step the level of A is less than that of B, and in the other world at no step.

title: 显者唯变化之先后
title_en: What shows is only the order of steps of becoming

clauses.zh: 旷步，读步之中重读其前所读之步者也：读自初步起，每步或重读其前所读之步，或读其次步，步步皆被读。
clauses.en: An idle step is a step of a reading of steps that reads again the step read before it: the reading starts from the first step, each step either reads again the step read before it or reads the next step, and every step is read.

clauses.zh: 宇之诸物之同异定然否，以插入旷步之读读之：每步在场者各异，则衡、耗、唯运者与之、唯运者取且唯取于其所资、有待、有形，皆恰当原宇有之而有之，任一段之所取、所与皆如所读之段；
clauses.en: Where sameness and difference of the relata of a world are decided, read the world with a reading that inserts idle steps: if what takes part at each step is distinct, then balance, dissipation, giving only by what is active, taking only by what is active and only from what it draws from, dependent and embodied each hold of the read world exactly where they hold of the original world, and the uptake and replenishment over any stretch are as over the stretch read;

clauses.zh: 任一量之升降及其升降之步数，皆如所读之段；
clauses.en: The rises and falls of any amount and the number of steps at which it rises or falls are as over the stretch read;

clauses.zh: 屡作、屡已、屡有一物之积升降，亦恰当原宇如此而如此。
clauses.en: Arising recurs, ceasing recurs, and a rise or fall of the level of a relatum recurs, each exactly where it does so in the original world.

clauses.zh: 宇于诸旷步无物在场、诸物不移，且每一所读之步皆给出读之之非旷步，则去旷步之宇，衡、耗、唯运者与之、唯运者取且唯取于其所资、有待、有形，皆恰当原宇有之而有之；
clauses.en: If at the idle steps nothing in the world takes part and no relatum changes, and every step read gives the step that is not idle and reads it, then for the world with the idle steps removed, balance, dissipation, giving only by what is active, taking only by what is active and only from what it draws from, dependent and embodied each hold exactly where they hold of the original world;

clauses.zh: 任一段之所取、所与、一族总积之升降及其升降之步数亦同。
clauses.en: The uptake and replenishment over any stretch, the rises and falls of the total level of a family, and the number of steps at which they rise or fall, are also the same.

clauses.zh: 然每步所计者随读之单位而异：以屡有旷步之读读之，则无流多而无已；
clauses.en: But what each step counts differs with the unit of the reading: read with a reading in which idle steps recur, no flow is more without end;

clauses.zh: 有一流多而无已，每步读二次则不然；
clauses.en: There is a flow that is more without end, and read twice at each step it is not;

clauses.zh: 有一待网，以始为一之蓄蓄之，每步读二次，则凡蓄之者其始不少于二。
clauses.en: There is a web that a reserve starting at one carries, and read twice at each step, every reserve that carries it starts at no less than two.

clauses.zh: 一步之所触，其步之取与所触诸物也。
clauses.en: What a step touches is the relata touched by the taking and giving of that step.

clauses.zh: 所触给定而含其取与（不触之物于其步不在场，跨步不移），则于有穷之一段，易相邻而不相连（相连：二取与共触一物，或一取与所触之物于其步之始或终待另一取与所触之物）之取与所能至之步之重排，恰为保持相连取与之先后者。
clauses.en: Where what is touched is given and includes its taking and giving (a relatum not touched does not take part at that step and does not change across it), then over a finite stretch, the renumberings of steps that can be reached by exchanging adjacent takings and givings that are not linked (linked: the two touch a relatum in common, or a relatum one touches depends at the start or end of its step on a relatum the other touches) are exactly those that keep the order of steps of linked takings and givings.

clauses.zh: 每步之律：有取于族者，则取者至少有一，其数不过取于族之总；
clauses.en: The law of every step: if something is taken from a family, then there is at least one taker, and the number of takers is no more than the total taken from the family;

clauses.zh: 有取于族或与于族者，则其步有在场者有所取与。
clauses.en: if something is taken from or given to a family, then at that step some relatum taking part takes or gives.

clauses.zh: 一步之式，一步于一族所示者也：诸员步前步后之积，取于每员与与于每员者，取者之数，与其步有无在场者有所取与。
clauses.en: The form of one step is what a step shows of a family: the levels of the members before and after the step, what is taken from and given to each member, the number of takers, and whether at that step some relatum taking part takes or gives.

clauses.zh: 凡一步之式，有宇于某步于某族示之（其步在场者各异），恰当其守每步之律：一步所示之律，尽于每步之律。
clauses.en: Every form of one step is shown by some world at some step on some family (with distinct relata taking part at that step) exactly where it keeps the law of every step: the laws one step shows are exhausted by the law of every step.

clauses.zh: 于其步衡之族示之者，恰当其又每员皆衡。
clauses.en: It is shown by a family that balances at that step exactly where, in addition, each member balances.

clauses.zh: 通，自一状有行也：自此状起，步步有其变所许之移，无穷而行。
clauses.en: Goes on: there is a run from a configuration: from this configuration on, at every step there is a transition its process allows, running without end.

clauses.zh: 凡自一状能至一复之状，则此状通。
clauses.en: If a configuration that returns can be reached from a configuration, then that configuration goes on.

clauses.zh: 诸状有一族尽之，则一状通，恰当自此状有一历程，其步数如族之长；
clauses.en: If one family contains all the configurations, then a configuration goes on exactly where there is a history from it whose number of steps is the length of the family;

clauses.zh: 恰当自此状能至一复之状。
clauses.en: exactly where a configuration that returns can be reached from it.

clauses.zh: 涯，有穷之界也：二行至涯而同，谓其状至涯（含）皆同，其动于涯前皆同。
clauses.en: A horizon is a finite bound: two runs agree up to a horizon where their configurations are the same up to the horizon (inclusive) and their moves are the same before the horizon.

clauses.zh: 时，一步所由以取者之一也：以轻重计步，一步（自一状以一动至一状）之重为 k，则此步有 k 时，每时自定其果。
clauses.en: A situation is one of the ways by which a step is taken: counting steps by a weighting, if the weight of a step (from a configuration by a move to a configuration) is k, then this step has k situations, each fixing its own outcome.

title: 轻重即时之数
title_en: Weighting is the number of situations

clauses.zh: 凡以轻重计诸步：以时为动，其变为法；
clauses.en: For every counting of steps by a weighting: with situations as moves, the process is a law;

clauses.zh: 此法取一步，恰当此步之重为正。
clauses.en: this law takes a step exactly where the weight of this step is positive.

clauses.zh: 诸动、诸状各有一族尽之，则于 n 步诸时之历程上求任一读之和，等于于 n 步诸历程上各以其重（其诸步之重相乘）计之而求和；
clauses.en: If one family contains all the moves and one all the configurations, then the sum of any reading over the histories of situations of n steps equals the sum over the histories of n steps, each counted by its weight (the product of the weights of its steps);

clauses.zh: 诸动、诸状之同异定然否而于其族中各一，则取一历程之时之历程，其数即此历程之重。
clauses.en: If sameness and difference of moves and of configurations are decided and each occurs once in its family, then the number of histories of situations that take a given history is the weight of this history.

clauses.zh: 凡配诸步以重（诸选之重相加，相继之步之重相乘，加与乘各守其律），诸动、诸状各有一族尽之：于 n 步诸历程，各以其重（其诸步之重依次相乘，乘以终状之所读）而求和，恰为逐步而算之所得：自一状，以一步诸移之重各乘其后之所得而相加，算 n 步。
clauses.en: For every assignment of weights to steps (weights of alternatives added, weights of successive steps multiplied, addition and multiplication each keeping its laws), where one family contains all the moves and one all the configurations: the sum over the histories of n steps, each counted by its weight (the weights of its steps multiplied in order, multiplied by what the final configuration reads), is exactly what is computed step by step: from a configuration, multiply the weight of each transition of one step by what follows it and add, computing n steps.

clauses.zh: 以一读归诸状为类，每类有一状为其代表：于凡 n，凡依类而定之所读，n 步之后之所得皆随类而同，恰当凡依类而定之所读，一步之后之所得皆随类而同。
clauses.en: With a reading that sorts the configurations into classes, each class having one configuration as its representative: for every n, what results after n steps is same by class for every reading fixed by class, exactly where what results after one step is same by class for every reading fixed by class.

clauses.zh: 变通，规读其所处之状而变也：状与规之行，状每步依此步之规而移，规唯于时稽之步依此步之状与规而改，余步如故。
clauses.en: Rule switching is change by a rule that reads the configuration it is in: in a run of configuration and rule, the configuration changes at each step according to the rule of that step, and the rule changes only at reading steps, according to the configuration and rule of that step, and at the other steps is as before.

clauses.zh: 时稽，规读状之步也。
clauses.en: A reading step is a step at which the rule reads the configuration.

clauses.zh: 快层，状每步依规而移之层也。
clauses.en: The fast layer is the layer in which the configuration changes at each step according to the rule.

title: 规唯于时稽得状之异
title_en: The rule meets differences of configuration only at reading steps

clauses.zh: 凡状与规之行：r 步之前无时稽之步，则迄于 r 步（含），自同一规起之二行，不论其状，其规步步皆同；
clauses.en: For every run of configuration and rule: if there is no reading step before step r, then up to step r (inclusive), two runs starting from one and the same rule have the same rule at every step, whatever their configurations;

clauses.zh: 时稽之步之次，规依此步之状与规而定。
clauses.en: At the step after a reading step, the rule is fixed by the configuration and rule of that step.

clauses.zh: 规终不时稽，则规步步如初，状之异皆不及于规；
clauses.en: If the rule never reads, then the rule is at every step as at first, and no difference of configuration reaches the rule;

clauses.zh: 持此规之法于 n 步不可得之状，自 n 步起永不再为自此规起之行之状；
clauses.en: A configuration that cannot be had at step n under the law that holds this rule fixed is, from step n on, never again a configuration of a run starting from this rule;

clauses.zh: 诸状有一族尽之而持此规之法有同归，则自族长之步起，于每步，非凡状皆为自此规起之某行于其步之状。
clauses.en: If one family contains all the configurations and the law that holds this rule fixed has confluence, then from the step equal to the length of the family on, at every step, not every configuration is the configuration at that step of some run starting from this rule.

clauses.zh: 有状与规之行焉：二固定之规，持之之法各自第一步起永不至一状；
clauses.en: There is a run of configuration and rule in which, for two fixed rules, the law that holds each one fixed never reaches a certain configuration from the first step on;

clauses.zh: 规每步读状而改之行，屡至此二状。
clauses.en: and for the run in which the rule reads the configuration at each step and changes, reaching these two configurations recurs.

title: 卦爻、刚柔、位与二体
title_en: Hexagram, hexagram line, line value, place and halves

clauses.zh: 爻，卦之一位及其值也；
clauses.en: A hexagram line is a place of a hexagram with its value;

clauses.zh: 刚柔，爻之二值也：刚，不断之爻；
clauses.en: Line values are the two values of a hexagram line: firm, an undivided line;

clauses.zh: 柔，断之爻。
clauses.en: yielding, a divided line.

clauses.zh: 卦，六爻自下而上之一状也，凡六十四。
clauses.en: A hexagram is a configuration of six hexagram lines from the bottom up, sixty-four in all.

clauses.zh: 位，爻之所处也，自初至上凡六。
clauses.en: A place is where a hexagram line stands, six in all from the first to the top.

clauses.zh: 二体，卦之两半也：下体自初至三，上体自四至上；
clauses.en: The halves are the two halves of a hexagram: the lower half from the first to the third, the upper half from the fourth to the top;

clauses.zh: 每位为一体之一高，高有下、中、上。
clauses.en: Each place is one height of a half, and the heights are low, middle and high.

clauses.zh: 互卦之法下，二步之后，三、四爻皆刚者至乾，皆柔者至坤，相异者入既济、未济迭至之所归；
clauses.en: Under the law of the mutual hexagram, after two steps, the hexagrams whose third and fourth lines are both firm reach Qian, those whose third and fourth lines are both yielding reach Kun, and those whose third and fourth lines differ are drawn into the attractor in which Jiji and Weiji alternate;

clauses.zh: 于六十四卦，各十六、十六、三十二。
clauses.en: Among the sixty-four hexagrams, these number sixteen, sixteen and thirty-two.

title: 正、中位、相应、比、承、乘
title_en: In phase, central place, line correspondence, adjacency, rising seam and riding seam

clauses.zh: 位之奇偶：初、三、五为奇，二、四、上为偶。
clauses.en: The parity of places: the first, third and fifth are odd; the second, fourth and top are even.

clauses.zh: 正，爻值合其位之奇偶也：刚居奇位，柔居偶位。
clauses.en: In phase: the value of a hexagram line agrees with the parity of its place: firm in an odd place, yielding in an even place.

clauses.zh: 中位，二与五也，二体之中高。
clauses.en: The central places are the second and the fifth, the middle height of the halves.

clauses.zh: 相应，二体同高之二爻异值也。
clauses.en: Line correspondence: the two hexagram lines at the same height of the halves have different values.

clauses.zh: 际，相邻二位之间也，凡五。
clauses.en: A seam is between two adjacent places, five in all.

clauses.zh: 比，一际之二爻异值也；
clauses.en: Adjacency: the two hexagram lines of a seam have different values;

clauses.zh: 下柔上刚为承，下刚上柔为乘。
clauses.en: Yielding below and firm above is a rising seam; firm below and yielding above is a riding seam.

title: 位之关系皆于境而读
title_en: Relations of place are all read in context

clauses.zh: 凡位之关系，逐其所在（位、高、际）而读，皆于境而读：诸处所示并行不悖而为全卦之一读，恰当每处所示皆同。
clauses.en: Every relation of place, read site by site (place, height, seam), is read in context: what the sites show has gluing into one reading of the whole hexagram exactly where what each site shows agrees.

clauses.zh: 以二体为二境，各示其三高之爻：二体并行不悖，恰当无一高相应；
clauses.en: Taking the halves as two contexts, each showing the hexagram lines of its three heights: the two halves have gluing exactly where no height has line correspondence;

clauses.zh: 泰有高相应，故于任一变，不依境之系辞皆不合于二体之所示，带境之系辞则合之。
clauses.en: Tai has a height with line correspondence, so for any process, no context-free frame agrees with what the halves show, while a frame that carries contexts agrees with it;

clauses.zh: 诸位之正并行不悖，恰在既济、未济；
clauses.en: The in-phase readings of the places have gluing exactly at Jiji and Weiji;

clauses.zh: 诸高之相应并行不悖，恰在三高皆相应或皆不相应；
clauses.en: The line correspondences of the heights have gluing exactly where all three heights have line correspondence or none has;

clauses.zh: 诸际之比并行不悖，恰在乾、坤、既济、未济。
clauses.en: The adjacencies of the seams have gluing exactly at Qian, Kun, Jiji and Weiji.

clauses.zh: 消长环每一步，下五爻各上一位，上爻出而反其刚柔为初爻；
clauses.en: At each step of the waxing-waning ring, the lower five hexagram lines each go up one place, and the top line leaves and, with its line value reversed, becomes the first line;

clauses.zh: 上一位之爻其正必反，为初爻者其正如故，故正之数，次步与此步奇偶不同。
clauses.en: A line that goes up one place must reverse whether it is in phase, and the line that becomes the first line is in phase or not as before; so the number of lines in phase at the next step differs in parity from that at this step.

clauses.zh: 次步之三高相应，随此步之三高相应而同；
clauses.en: The line correspondences of the three heights at the next step are determined by the line correspondences of the three heights at this step;

clauses.zh: 次步之正之数，则不随此步之正之数而同。
clauses.en: the number of lines in phase at the next step is not determined by the number of lines in phase at this step.

title: 相应由正而定
title_en: Line correspondence is fixed by in phase

clauses.zh: 凡卦：一高之二爻相应，恰当二爻同正或同不正；
clauses.en: For every hexagram: the two hexagram lines of a height have line correspondence exactly where both are in phase or both are not in phase;

clauses.zh: 六爻皆不正，则三高皆相应。
clauses.en: If none of the six hexagram lines is in phase, then all three heights have line correspondence.

clauses.zh: 自下而上，承之数加初爻之刚，等于乘之数加上爻之刚（刚计一，柔计零）。
clauses.en: From the bottom up, the number of rising seams plus the firmness of the first line equals the number of riding seams plus the firmness of the top line (firm counting one, yielding zero).

clauses.zh: 取其错，则每位之正皆反，每高之相应、每际之比皆如故，承乘互换；
clauses.en: Taking its complement, every place reverses whether it is in phase, the line correspondence of every height and the adjacency of every seam stay as before, and rising and riding seams exchange;

clauses.zh: 取其覆，则正皆反于对位，相应守于对高，承乘互换于对际。
clauses.en: Taking its turning over, being in phase reverses at the opposite place, line correspondence is kept at the opposite height, and rising and riding seams exchange at the opposite seam.

clauses.zh: 消长环与错可换序；
clauses.en: The waxing-waning ring commutes with the complement;

clauses.zh: 故自一卦与自其错起之二消长环之行，无一步同卦。
clauses.en: so the two runs of the waxing-waning ring from a hexagram and from its complement are at no step the same hexagram.

title: 位分与当位
title_en: Fixed phase and holds its place

clauses.zh: 位分，唯二至五有定之奇偶也：初、上无之。
clauses.en: Fixed phase: only the second to fifth places have a fixed parity; the first and top have none.

clauses.zh: 当位，爻正于有位分之位也。
clauses.en: Holds its place: a hexagram line is in phase at a place that has fixed phase.

title: 初上无位
title_en: The first and top have no place

clauses.zh: 二爻于一位异值，则无论此位何奇偶，必有一爻正。
clauses.en: If two hexagram lines have different values at one place, then whatever the parity of this place, one of the two lines is in phase.

clauses.zh: 需之上爻柔，乾之上爻刚，而需之《小象》谓之不当位，乾之《文言》谓之无位；
clauses.en: The top line of Xu is yielding and the top line of Qian is firm, yet the Xiao Xiang of Xu says it does not hold its place, and the Wenyan of Qian says it has no place;

clauses.zh: 故上位无一奇偶能合二言。
clauses.en: so no parity of the top place can agree with both statements.

clauses.zh: 《小象》言位之句收为一族（需上六不在其中），皆在二至五；
clauses.en: The sentences of the Xiao Xiang that speak of place are collected into a family (the top six of Xu not among them), and all lie in the second to fifth places;

clauses.zh: 以位分读之，族中诸句与需上六、乾上九二言皆然。
clauses.en: Read by fixed phase, the sentences of the family and the two statements on the top six of Xu and the top nine of Qian all hold.

clauses.zh: 二至五之正并行不悖，恰当其四爻皆当位或皆不当位，凡八卦。
clauses.en: The in-phase readings of the second to fifth places have gluing exactly where their four hexagram lines all hold their place or none does, eight hexagrams in all.

clauses.zh: 反初爻或上爻之刚柔，二至五之正皆如故，而其高之相应、其际之比皆反。
clauses.en: Reversing the line value of the first or the top line leaves whether each of the second to fifth is in phase as before, while the line correspondence of its height and the adjacency of its seam reverse.

clauses.zh: 消长环一步之后，二之正由初爻定，而初无位分；
clauses.en: After one step of the waxing-waning ring, whether the second is in phase is fixed by the first line, and the first has no fixed phase;

clauses.zh: 故次步二至五之正，不随此步二至五之正而同。
clauses.en: so whether the second to fifth are in phase at the next step is not determined by whether the second to fifth are in phase at this step.

clauses.zh: 独异，一爻与他五爻皆异值也。
clauses.en: Sole line: a hexagram line whose value differs from that of each of the other five lines.

clauses.zh: 一爻独异，恰当卦中与之同值者唯此一爻：此爻刚而卦唯一刚爻，或此爻柔而卦有五刚爻；
clauses.en: A hexagram line is a sole line exactly where it is the only line in the hexagram with its value: the line is firm and the hexagram has only one firm line, or the line is yielding and the hexagram has five firm lines;

clauses.zh: 卦有独异之爻，恰当卦有一刚爻或五刚爻；
clauses.en: A hexagram has a sole line exactly where it has one firm line or five firm lines;

clauses.zh: 一卦独异之爻至多其一；
clauses.en: A hexagram has at most one sole line;

clauses.zh: 一爻独异，恰当反此爻之刚柔则六爻皆同，凡十二卦。
clauses.en: A hexagram line is a sole line exactly where reversing its line value makes all six lines the same, twelve hexagrams in all.

clauses.zh: 卦有独异之爻，消长环一步之后则无；
clauses.en: If a hexagram has a sole line, then after one step of the waxing-waning ring it has none;

clauses.zh: 独异之爻居上者，次步出而六爻皆同，再次步初爻独异。
clauses.en: If the sole line is at the top, at the next step it leaves and all six lines are the same, and at the step after that the first line is a sole line.

title: 《象》《彖》之言位
title_en: What the Xiang and the Tuan say of place

clauses.zh: 《小象》明言位之句收为一族（需上六不在其中），皆合其爻之正；
clauses.en: The sentences of the Xiao Xiang that speak explicitly of place are collected into a family (the top six of Xu not among them), and all agree with whether their line is in phase;

clauses.zh: 言中正之句收为一族（艮六五不在其中），皆中位之爻而正；
clauses.en: The sentences that speak of central and correct are collected into a family (the six in the fifth place of Gen not among them), and all are of lines in a central place and in phase;

clauses.zh: 言柔乘刚之句收为一族，皆其爻下之际为乘。
clauses.en: The sentences that speak of the yielding riding the firm are collected into a family, and in all of them the seam below their line is a riding seam.

clauses.zh: 《彖》言“刚中而应”之卦收为一族，皆中位有刚爻而中高相应。
clauses.en: The hexagrams of which the Tuan says "the firm is central and responded to" are collected into a family, and all have a firm line in a central place and line correspondence at the middle height.

title: 《序卦》之次为法之行
title_en: The sequence of the Xugua as a run of a law

clauses.zh: 凡法于一族中末员以外每员之果皆其后一员，又与一自逆之象（其像之像即其本）可换序，则族中一员之后为其像、像之后为 t 者，t 即此员。
clauses.en: For every law under which, in a family, the outcome of each member other than the last is the member after it, and which commutes with a model that is its own inverse (the image of its image is the item itself): if in the family a member is followed by its image and the image by t, then t is this member.

clauses.zh: 《序卦》之次，自乾始，六十四卦依次各一；
clauses.en: The sequence of the Xugua starts from Qian and has each of the sixty-four hexagrams once, in order;

clauses.zh: 凡法自乾之行依此次者，皆不与错、覆、错其覆三象之任一可换序：次中乾后为坤（坤是乾之错，亦是乾之错其覆）而坤后为屯，屯后为蒙（蒙是屯之覆）而蒙后为需，皆不返其前卦。
clauses.en: Every law whose run from Qian follows this sequence commutes with none of the three models complement, turning over, and complement of the turning over: in the sequence Qian is followed by Kun (Kun is the complement of Qian, and also the complement of its turning over) and Kun by Zhun, and Zhun is followed by Meng (Meng is the turning over of Zhun) and Meng by Xu, and neither returns to the hexagram before it.

clauses.zh: 有法自乾之行依此次。
clauses.en: There is a law whose run from Qian follows this sequence.

clauses.zh: 感，所待入于待者也：待者于某步待一所待，则此所待以其需之阈感入之；
clauses.en: Couples into: a condition goes into a formation: if a formation depends on a condition at some step, then this condition couples into it by the threshold of its need;

clauses.zh: 或另以其积感入之，此另给，不随步而变。
clauses.en: or, given separately, it couples into it by its level; this is given separately and does not change with the step.

clauses.zh: 感有向，自所待入于待者。
clauses.en: Coupling has a direction, from the condition into the formation.

title: 择、择者与缘感而择
title_en: Selection, selector and selection through couplings

clauses.zh: 择，凡关于积之历之辞也：何者留，何者受赏，何者遗后更多。
