clauses.en: Selection is any claim about histories of levels: what remains, what is rewarded, what leaves more after it.

clauses.zh: 二积之历于一步缘一待者之感无异，谓此步之积或皆容之或皆不容之，且凡以积感入之之所待，其积相同。
clauses.en: Two histories of levels are alike through the couplings of a formation at a step where the levels of this step both admit it or both do not admit it, and every condition that couples into it by its level has the same level in both.

clauses.zh: 缘感而择，凡二历缘择者之感至某步无异者，择之皆同也。
clauses.en: Selection through couplings: any two histories alike through the couplings of the selector up to some step are treated the same by the selection.

clauses.zh: 择者，择所缘之感所属之待者也。
clauses.en: The selector is the formation to which the couplings that a selection goes through belong.

clauses.zh: 讀（AI，D45）：识，一待者自身之后程，随其感所作之类而定也。
clauses.en: Reading (AI, D45): own course through couplings is the further course of a formation itself, fixed by the lumping that its couplings make.

clauses.zh: 所待之同异定然否：凡一所待唯以阈感入一待者，他感入之所待于一步之积皆同，而此所待之二积于此步或皆足其需、或皆不足，则二历于此步缘其感无异。
clauses.en: Where sameness and difference of conditions are decided: if a condition couples into a formation only by threshold, the other conditions coupling into it have the same levels at a step, and the two levels of this condition at this step both meet its need or both do not, then the two histories are alike through its couplings at this step.

clauses.zh: 凡以积感入者增，缘其增者至某步无异之二历，缘其未增者亦无异。
clauses.en: If what couples in by level is enlarged, two histories alike up to some step through the enlarged couplings are also alike through the couplings before enlargement.

clauses.zh: 知几，所待以积感入待者，其积之异当步即为待者之感所分也。
clauses.en: Coupling read early: a condition couples into a formation by its level, and a difference in its level is separated by the couplings of the formation at that very step.

clauses.zh: 凡所待以积感入待者，二积之历于某步其积异，则二历于此步缘待者之感有异。
clauses.en: Wherever a condition couples into a formation by its level, if two histories of levels differ in its level at some step, then the two histories are not alike through the couplings of the formation at that step.

clauses.zh: 特征，配每一状以一值者也。
clauses.en: A feature assigns each configuration one value.

clauses.zh: 凡经一类读一特征，所读皆单值，恰当特征随其类而同。
clauses.en: For every reading of a feature through a lumping, what is read is single-valued exactly where the feature is same by class for its lumping.

clauses.zh: 凡一族之状，值有一所给者：有只读其类而于每一员皆出其特征者，恰当特征于族中随其类而同；
clauses.en: For every family of configurations, with some value given: there is a reading that reads only the class and gives the feature of each member, exactly where the feature is same by class on the family;

clauses.zh: 类并族中特征异之二员，则无之。
clauses.en: If the lumping puts together two members of the family with different features, there is no such reading.

clauses.zh: c 之上游，有感之链自之至于 c 之所待也；
clauses.en: Upstream of c are the conditions from which a chain of couplings leads to c;

clauses.zh: c 之下游，自 c 有感之链至之之所待也（链长可为零）。
clauses.en: Downstream of c are the conditions to which a chain of couplings leads from c (the chain may have length zero).

clauses.zh: 闻见，自所闻见者出之读之路也：路长为零者亲见，余者传受。
clauses.en: Observation is a route of readings starting from what is observed: a route of length zero is direct witness, the others are received by passing on.

clauses.zh: 凡法于每一所待各读其所标之积，所标者皆在一族之中；
clauses.en: For every law that reads, at each condition, the levels it marks, all the marked conditions lying in one family;

clauses.zh: 二流皆衡，在场之待者同，体之动同，体外之待者皆依此法，始时唯一所待之积异：则每一步，凡不在此所待之下游者（以至此步既成之读计），二流之积皆同。
clauses.en: if two flows both balance, the formations taking part are the same, the moves of the part are the same, the formations outside the part all follow this law, and at the start only the level of one condition differs: then at each step, for every condition not downstream of this condition (counting by the routes of reading formed by this step), the levels of the two flows are the same.

clauses.zh: 至次步既成之读之路，即至此步既成之路，与经此步之一感而接者。
clauses.en: The routes of reading formed by the next step are exactly the routes formed by this step together with those extended by a coupling at this step.

clauses.zh: 凡至次步新成之路，必经此步之一感。
clauses.en: Every route newly formed by the next step goes through a coupling at this step.

clauses.zh: 有例：一待者自某步起每步以一所待之积加于另一所待（所记者），并于所记者不少于某数时每步自前者取一；
clauses.en: An example: from some step on, a formation adds at each step the level of one condition to another condition (the recorded one), and at each step at which the recorded one is not less than a certain number, takes one from the former;

clauses.zh: 于此步，自前者至所记者之路成；
clauses.en: at this step, the route from the former to the recorded one forms;

clauses.zh: 二流唯于前者之积相差，则至此步所记者皆同，跨此步而所记者差出前者之差。
clauses.en: if two flows differ only in the level of the former, then up to this step the recorded ones are the same, and across this step the recorded ones come to differ by the gap of the former.

clauses.zh: 至期所及，期内之某步，源之所能及有一物于其步感入读者也。
clauses.en: Reached by in time: at some step within the time limit, some relatum the source can reach couples into what reads at that step.

clauses.zh: 源之所能及，唯由下三者而成：既及之物，次步犹及；
clauses.en: What the source can reach is formed only by the following three: a relatum already reached is still reached at the next step;

clauses.zh: 源于一步触一物，次步及之；
clauses.en: if the source touches a relatum at a step, the relatum is reached at the next step;

clauses.zh: 一物于某步既及而于其步感入一待者，此待者于其步或此后某步触一物，次步及之。
clauses.en: if a relatum is already reached at some step and at that step couples into a formation, and this formation at that step or some later step touches a relatum, that relatum is reached at the next step.

title: 未及则答同
title_en: Not reached, the answers are the same

clauses.zh: 凡二历程：起之积皆同；
clauses.en: For every two histories: their starting levels are the same;

clauses.zh: 期前步步皆衡，在场者皆同；
clauses.en: before the time limit there is balance at every step, and what takes part is the same;

clauses.zh: 源之外，期前每一待者，缘其感至此步无异者，所取所与皆同；
clauses.en: apart from the source, every formation before the time limit takes and gives the same wherever the two histories are alike through its couplings up to that step;

clauses.zh: 答唯缘读者至期之感而读。
clauses.en: the answer is read only through the couplings of what reads up to the time limit.

clauses.zh: 则凡物于期内一步未为源之所能及，其于此步之积皆同；
clauses.en: Then every relatum not yet reached by the source at a step within the time limit has the same level at that step;

clauses.zh: 源至期未及于读者，则二历缘读者之感至期无异，二答亦同。
clauses.en: if the source has not reached what reads by the time limit, the two histories are alike through the couplings of what reads up to the time limit, and the two answers are the same.

clauses.zh: 故二答异，则至期所及不可非；
clauses.en: So if the two answers differ, then reached by in time cannot be refuted;

clauses.zh: 至期所及定然否，则有之。
clauses.en: if reached by in time is decided, then it holds.

clauses.zh: 察，一待者之取与于某步，非独由他所待至此步之积而定，谓之察于此所待也。
clauses.en: Sensitive: the taking and giving of a formation at some step is not fixed by the levels of the other conditions up to that step alone; the formation is then called sensitive to this condition.

clauses.zh: 所待之同异定然否：凡取与之法于每步、每待者、每历所读之所待皆在一族之中，则于体外每一待者，二历至某步每步容否皆同、其所察之所待之积皆同者，此法于此步给之取与皆同；
clauses.en: Where sameness and difference of conditions are decided: for every law of taking and giving under which the conditions read at each step, for each formation and each history, all lie in one family, for each formation outside the part, if two histories agree up to some step on admission at every step and on the levels of the conditions it is sensitive to, then the law gives the same taking and giving at this step;

clauses.zh: 凡一以积感入之关系，以之代所察而前句仍然者，于体外每一待者所察之每一所待，其感入此待者，不可非。
clauses.en: For every relation of coupling by level that, put in place of sensitivity, keeps the previous sentence true, that each condition a formation outside the part is sensitive to couples into this formation cannot be refuted.

clauses.zh: 无穷可定其皆否，恰当：凡变之行，其上逐步所读之然否，或步步不然，或非步步不然。
clauses.en: The weak limited principle of omniscience holds exactly where: for every run of a process, what is read step by step along it as holding or not either fails at every step, or it is not the case that it fails at every step.

clauses.zh: 所待以自然数编号：有一唯读既立者之取与之法与一待者，二历于此待者所察之所待至某步皆同，而此法给此待者之取与于此步仍异，恰当有一象，于凡逐步之然否皆定其是否步步不然；
clauses.en: With conditions numbered by natural numbers: there are a law of taking and giving that reads only what is already settled and a formation such that two histories agree up to some step on the conditions this formation is sensitive to while the taking and giving the law gives this formation at this step still differ, exactly where there is a model that fixes, for every step-by-step sequence of holding or not, whether it fails at every step;

clauses.zh: 有此象，则无穷可定其皆否。
clauses.en: If there is such a model, then the weak limited principle of omniscience holds.

clauses.zh: 验，凡如一辞之积之历，无一缘一待者之感至某步与所然无异，则此辞于此待者此步见去也。
clauses.en: Testing: if no history of levels that satisfies a claim is alike with what holds through the couplings of a formation up to some step, then this claim is excluded for this formation at this step.

clauses.zh: 辞之见去，唯经感入之异：如此辞之一历缘其感至此步与所然无异，则此辞于此不见去。
clauses.en: A claim is excluded only through differences that couple in: if a history satisfying this claim is alike with what holds through its couplings up to this step, then this claim is not excluded here.

clauses.zh: 所然所如之辞不见去；
clauses.en: A claim that what holds satisfies is not excluded;

clauses.zh: 见去则其后每步皆见去；
clauses.en: once excluded, it is excluded at every later step;

clauses.zh: 以积感入者增，见去者仍见去。
clauses.en: If what couples in by level is enlarged, what is excluded is still excluded.

clauses.zh: 二历，凡缘一待者之感至某步而择者皆择之同，恰当二历缘其感至此步无异；
clauses.en: Every selection through the couplings of a formation up to some step selects two histories alike exactly where the two histories are alike through its couplings up to this step;

clauses.zh: 二历缘其感至此步有异，则有缘其感之择于此然而于彼不然。
clauses.en: If two histories are not alike through its couplings up to this step, then some selection through its couplings holds of this one and not of that one.

clauses.zh: 此步与此前任一步此待者之容，为缘其感至此步之择。
clauses.en: The admission of this formation at this step and at any step before it is a selection through its couplings up to this step.

clauses.zh: 缘择者之感之择，于一历下在择者处见去，恰当其于此历不然。
clauses.en: A selection through the couplings of a selector is excluded at the selector under a history exactly where it does not hold of this history.

clauses.zh: 以积感入者增，缘感之择仍缘感。
clauses.en: If what couples in by level is enlarged, a selection through couplings is still through couplings.

clauses.zh: 感读作值时，二历缘其感至某步无异，恰当其自身之文至此步之往同；
clauses.en: Where couplings are read as values, two histories are alike through its couplings up to some step exactly where the prefixes of its own course up to this step are the same;

clauses.zh: 缘其感之择，恰是依此往之择；
clauses.en: a selection through its couplings is exactly a selection by this prefix;

clauses.zh: 其自身之文于二历下各不过 N、N′ 状，则二历缘其感于 N＋N′－1 步之前无异者，永无异。
clauses.en: If under the two histories its own course has no more than N and N′ configurations respectively, then two histories alike through its couplings before step N + N′ − 1 are alike at every step.

clauses.zh: 所待之同异定然否：无所许之历，则有穷之往不去其后：于任一步，“一所待终至于零”与“此步之后每步皆在零上”二辞，于任何待者、任何以积感入之关系，皆不见去。
clauses.en: Where sameness and difference of conditions are decided: without admitted histories, a finite prefix does not exclude what comes after: at any step, the two claims "some condition eventually reaches zero" and "after this step it is above zero at every step" are not excluded for any formation under any relation of coupling by level.

clauses.zh: 于所许之历内见去者，即去“在所许之历中且如此辞”之辞。
clauses.en: Being excluded within the admitted histories is exactly the exclusion of the claim "lies in the admitted histories and satisfies this claim".

clauses.zh: 有例：所许之历不含所然，所然所如之一辞于首步见去，而感入者于次步去此所许之历。
clauses.en: An example: the admitted histories do not contain what holds, a claim that what holds satisfies is excluded at the first step, and what couples in excludes these admitted histories at the next step.

clauses.zh: 以一流之衡之积之历为所许之历，所然在其中，一所待以积感入一待者，则“此所待终至于零”之伪辞于首步见去。
clauses.en: Taking the histories of levels of a flow under balance as the admitted histories, with what holds among them, and a condition coupling into a formation by its level, the false claim "this condition eventually reaches zero" is excluded at the first step.

clauses.zh: 验系乎待者。
clauses.en: Testing is relative to the formation.

clauses.zh: 有例：一辞于一待者无步见去，于他待者第三步见去。
clauses.en: An example: a claim is excluded at no step for one formation, and is excluded at the third step for another formation.

clauses.zh: 有例：一辞于二待者各不见去，合二者之感而验之，则见去。
clauses.en: An example: a claim is not excluded for either of two formations, and is excluded when tested by the couplings of the two together.

clauses.zh: 断，于所断之状，以一可许之对终之也。
clauses.en: A judgment process ends, at the configuration judged, with an answer that can be allowed.

clauses.zh: 对为断之共对，恰当其于所疑之每状皆可许；
clauses.en: An answer is a common answer of the judgment process exactly where it can be allowed at every configuration in doubt;

clauses.zh: 所疑愈狭，共对仍为共对。
clauses.en: If what is in doubt narrows, a common answer is still a common answer.

clauses.zh: 缘一待者之感而断，以缘其感与所然无异之诸历为所疑，则其共对即于此每一历皆可许之对。
clauses.en: For a judgment process through the couplings of a formation, taking as what is in doubt the histories alike with what holds through its couplings, its common answer is exactly an answer that can be allowed at every one of these histories.

clauses.zh: 知之所至，一策自所疑之状实行之所达也。
clauses.en: The scope of knowing is what an inquiry tree, actually executed from the configurations in doubt, reaches.

clauses.zh: 凡知之所至，皆自一所疑之状经变之实路而达。
clauses.en: Everything in the scope of knowing is reached from a configuration in doubt by an actual path of the process.

clauses.zh: 策之问皆可许、其对皆为共对、唯所疑为空乃弃者，于其知之所至皆如所求；
clauses.en: An inquiry tree whose questions can all be allowed, whose answers are all common answers, and which aborts only when what is in doubt is empty, meets the target throughout its scope of knowing;

clauses.zh: 此策所疑有一状，则其知之所至有一状如所求。
clauses.en: If what this inquiry tree has in doubt contains a configuration, then its scope of knowing contains a configuration that meets the target.

clauses.zh: 往（五·六）定一动于一状之果为某状，谓凡法许此行此步之前每一移者，皆以此动送此状至彼状也。
clauses.en: A prefix (5.6) fixes the outcome of a move at a configuration as a certain configuration where every law that allows each transition of this run before this step sends this configuration by this move to that configuration.

clauses.zh: 凡行于此步之前既于一状采一动，往定其果。
clauses.en: If a run has taken a move at a configuration before this step, the prefix fixes its outcome.

clauses.zh: 凡变为法、状有二异者：行于此步之前未于一状采一动，则往不定其果；
clauses.en: For every process that is a law, where there are two different configurations: if a run has not taken a move at a configuration before this step, the prefix does not fix its outcome;

clauses.zh: 藏往之行，于其所经之每状，往唯定其所采之动之果。
clauses.en: For a run of kept history, at every configuration it passes through, the prefix fixes only the outcomes of the moves it took.

clauses.zh: 反事实，一体之动异于其所采，而余者依同一法所生之历程也。
clauses.en: A counterfactual is the history produced when the move of a part differs from the move it took and the rest follow one and the same law.

clauses.zh: 余者依一唯读既立者之取与之法：二流皆衡，在场者同，体之动同，起之积同，则二流每步之积与每一取与皆同。
clauses.en: Where the rest follow a law of taking and giving that reads only what is already settled: if two flows both balance, what takes part is the same, the moves of the part are the same and the starting levels are the same, then the levels and every taking and giving of the two flows at each step are the same.

clauses.zh: 凡唯读既立者之取与之法，其所生之流于其所生之积上衡，恰当其历程可行：无一步于一所待所取多于其积加其所与。
clauses.en: For every law of taking and giving that reads only what is already settled, the flow it produces balances on the levels it produces exactly where its history can be run: at no step is more taken from a condition than its level plus what is given to it.

clauses.zh: 体之动亦依一唯读既立者之取与之法，二法合生之历程可行：则凡衡流，在场者同此，体之动同此，余者依前法，起之积同此者，其每步之积与取与即此历程之积与取与；
clauses.en: If the moves of the part also follow a law of taking and giving that reads only what is already settled, and the history the two laws produce together can be run: then for every flow under balance in which what takes part is the same as here, the moves of the part are the same as here, the rest follow the former law and the starting levels are the same as here, its levels and takings and givings at each step are the levels and takings and givings of this history;

clauses.zh: 凡待者皆依一法而其历程可行者亦然。
clauses.en: The same holds where every formation follows a law and the history can be run.

clauses.zh: 故一动之反事实，即此动所生之历程。
clauses.en: So the counterfactual of a move is the history this move produces.

clauses.zh: 凡法与其一行：法自一状以一动有一步在此行所显之自然之法之外，恰当法自此状以此动有步，而此行从未于此状采此动。
clauses.en: For every law and a run of it: the law has a step from a configuration by a move beyond the law shown by this run exactly where the law has a step from this configuration by this move and the run never took this move at this configuration.

clauses.zh: 以体之动为入、余者依取与之法者，其一行之历不忒，而体于一状之一动有出于此历所显者之步，恰当此行于此状从未采此动：法于其历所加者，恰为其反事实。
clauses.en: With the moves of the part as inputs and the rest following a law of taking and giving, the history of a run is a consistent history, and the part has a step by a move at a configuration beyond what this history shows exactly where this run never took this move at this configuration: what the law adds to its history is exactly its counterfactuals.

clauses.zh: 试，于状复之处改其自身之动也。
clauses.en: An experiment changes its own move where the configuration returns.

clauses.zh: 凡行于某步复至前步之状而采一动，则自其次步起，往定此动于此状之果。
clauses.en: If a run at some step returns to the configuration of an earlier step and takes a move, then from the next step on, the prefix fixes the outcome of this move at this configuration.

clauses.zh: 凡变为法、状有二异者，行之状无复，则于其所经之每状，往不定其所采以外之动之果。
clauses.en: For every process that is a law, where there are two different configurations: if the configurations of a run have no return, then at every configuration it passes through, the prefix does not fix the outcome of any move other than the one it took.

clauses.zh: 凡行之状，其类皆在一族之中，则自每步以后，皆有二步其类同。
clauses.en: If the classes of the configurations of a run all lie in one family, then after every step there are two steps with the same class.

clauses.zh: 相若，变之步经一类皆为一变之步也：所给之控制，谓类所并者于其变无涉。
clauses.en: Control: every step of a process through a lumping is a step of one process: the given control says that what the lumping puts together is irrelevant to the change.

clauses.zh: 凡变之步经一类皆为一法之步，往经此类所定一动于一类之果，即凡属此类之状以此动之果之类，行经之、未经之皆然。
clauses.en: If every step of a process through a lumping is a step of a law, the outcome of a move at a class fixed by the prefix through this lumping is the class of the outcome of this move at every configuration of this class, whether or not the run passes through it.

clauses.zh: 有例：类所并之隐者每步而改，动无所改：往经此类，将处处无异之二动定为二果；
clauses.en: An example: a hidden factor that the lumping puts together changes at every step, and the move changes nothing: through this lumping the prefix fixes two moves that differ nowhere to two outcomes;

clauses.zh: 动随所并之隐者而改，则“动定其果”之误法每步皆许经此类所读之步，往永不去之；
clauses.en: If the move changes along with the hidden factor the lumping puts together, then the wrong law "the move fixes its outcome" allows at every step the steps read through this lumping, and the prefix never excludes it;

clauses.zh: 改其动而与所并之隐者相反，则至第五步无一法许其所读之步。
clauses.en: If the move is changed against the hidden factor the lumping puts together, then by the fifth step no law allows the steps it reads.

clauses.zh: 录，一次所遇之记也；
clauses.en: A record is the note of what occurs in one occasion;

clauses.zh: 有日之录，记一日所问与所答者也。
clauses.en: A dated record notes what was asked and what was answered on one day.

clauses.zh: 数往，自后之有日之录，读前一包之内容也。
clauses.en: Retrodiction reads, from later dated records, the contents of an earlier package.

clauses.zh: 所然之历皆合其自身之录之所答。
clauses.en: Every history that holds agrees with what its own records answered.

clauses.zh: 读前一包之内容：所答与内容之同异定然否，凡一域之历，合每录之所答、与一所许之隐源给同包者，皆给所然之内容，恰当此域之历与一所许之隐源给同包而内容异者，皆有一有日之录，彼与所然于其所答异。
clauses.en: Reading the contents of an earlier package: where sameness and difference of answers and contents are decided, for a region of histories, every history that agrees with what each record answered and gives the same package as an admitted hidden source gives the contents that hold, exactly where every history of this region that gives the same package as an admitted hidden source but different contents has a dated record on which its answer differs from what holds.

clauses.zh: 两端之录见一改，其间每一日，皆有一文于此既改、一文于此未改，各只一改。
clauses.en: If the records at the two ends show a change, then for each day between, there is a course that has already changed at it and a course that has not yet changed at it, each with only one change.

clauses.zh: 一行附一读，凡其有穷之段，皆有此读之一行与之同至此段也。
clauses.en: A run adheres to a reading: for every finite stretch of it, some run of this reading agrees with it up to this stretch.

clauses.zh: 一行附一读，恰当凡历之闭类含此读之诸行者，皆含之。
clauses.en: A run adheres to a reading exactly where every closed class of histories that contains the runs of this reading contains it.

clauses.zh: 一读可驳，凡不在其内之行，皆有一有穷之段，凡与之同至此段之行皆不在其内也。
clauses.en: A reading can be refuted where every run not in it has a finite stretch such that every run agreeing with it up to this stretch is not in it.

clauses.zh: 可驳之读，凡附之之行，其在读内不可非；
clauses.en: For a reading that can be refuted, that every run adhering to it lies within the reading cannot be refuted;

clauses.zh: 于凡变，凡可驳之读皆含附之之行，恰当凡辞皆不可非则然。
clauses.en: For every process, every reading that can be refuted contains the runs that adhere to it, exactly where double-negation stability holds for every claim.

clauses.zh: 于唯一状唯一动之变，凡逐步之然否，取诸段皆在其首然之步之前之历：于凡逐步之然否，此历或有最晚之段，或凡涯之外皆有其段，恰当无穷可尽。
clauses.en: For the process with one configuration and one move, for every step-by-step sequence of holding or not, take the history of all the stretches before the step at which it first holds: for every such sequence, this history either has a latest stretch or has stretches beyond every horizon, exactly where the limited principle of omniscience holds.

clauses.zh: 凡有穷之段皆有一读之一行与之同至此段，谓此读稠密；
clauses.en: A reading is called dense where for every finite stretch some run of the reading agrees with it up to this stretch;

clauses.zh: 有于每行每涯各下一读者，所下唯由至此涯之往而定，所下之读皆在一读之内，且其中有一行与此行同至此涯，恰当此读稠密。
clauses.en: There is something that for every run and every horizon puts down a reading, what it puts down fixed only by the prefix up to this horizon, every reading it puts down lying within one reading and containing a run that agrees with this run up to this horizon, exactly where this reading is dense.

clauses.zh: 征，一行有一段，凡与之同至此段之行皆在一读之内也。
clauses.en: Verification: a run has a stretch such that every run agreeing with it up to this stretch lies within a reading.

clauses.zh: 凡读之内每行皆有一段如此，谓之可征；
clauses.en: Where every run within a reading has such a stretch, the reading is called verifiable;

clauses.zh: 可征，恰当其每行皆于其中见征。
clauses.en: A reading is verifiable exactly where each of its runs is verified within it.

clauses.zh: 凡行在一读之内，恰当其附此读，且附之则在其内；
clauses.en: A run lies within a reading exactly where it adheres to this reading and, if it adheres, lies within it;

clauses.zh: 凡有穷之段，皆不能驳“附之则在其内”。
clauses.en: No finite stretch can refute "if it adheres, it lies within it".

clauses.zh: 于凡变问之，凡可征之读其补皆可驳，则非皆否则有是；
clauses.en: Asked of every process: if the complement of every verifiable reading can be refuted, then Markov's principle holds;

clauses.zh: 而非皆否则有是，恰当：凡变之行逐步各标然否，每步之标唯由至此步之往而定，则凡非步步标否之行，皆有一步，凡与之同至此步之行皆非步步标否。
clauses.en: and Markov's principle holds exactly where: for every run of a process with each step marked as holding or not, the mark of each step fixed only by the prefix up to this step, every run that is not marked as not holding at every step has a step such that every run agreeing with it up to this step is not marked as not holding at every step.

clauses.zh: 术，于每行之每涯答“是”或“否”者也。
clauses.en: A method answers "yes" or "no" at each horizon of each run.

clauses.zh: 术于极征一读，谓此读恰在术自某步起永答“是”之行上然；
clauses.en: A method verifies in the limit a reading where this reading holds exactly on the runs on which the method from some step on always answers "yes";

clauses.zh: 术于极驳一读，谓此读恰在术之“是”屡见之行上然。
clauses.en: A method refutes a reading in the limit where this reading holds exactly on the runs on which a "yes" of the method recurs.

clauses.zh: 状之同异定然否，则“末步无所改”之术，于极征“行之状自某步不再改”。
clauses.en: Where sameness and difference of configurations are decided, the method "nothing changed at the last step" verifies in the limit "the configuration of the run changes no more from some step on".

clauses.zh: 于二状而凡移皆许之变，“行之状自某步不再改”既不可征，亦不可驳；
clauses.en: For a process on two configurations that allows every transition, "the configuration of the run changes no more from some step on" can be neither verified nor refuted;

clauses.zh: 若非皆否则有是，则凡由往所定之术，皆不能于极驳之。
clauses.en: If Markov's principle holds, no method fixed by prefixes can refute it in the limit.

clauses.zh: 于极之辨认，即追踪一不随涯而改者。
clauses.en: Identification in the limit is tracking something that does not change with the horizon.

clauses.zh: 参验，以可失实之见证互参而验之也。
clauses.en: Cross-checking is testing by checking fallible witnesses against one another.

clauses.zh: 凡二答异之候选，见证皆报之录无一为二者所共许，恰当其包络相离：谓此之每一失实集与彼之每一失实集，皆留一见证于二者之外。
clauses.en: For every two candidates that differ in their answer, no record the witnesses report is admitted by both, exactly where their envelopes are apart: for every fault set of this one and every fault set of that one, some witness is left outside both.

clauses.zh: 凡许全体见证皆失实之候选在一行中，则永在，其后无一凭可立。
clauses.en: If a candidate that admits all witnesses being faulty is in a run, it stays there forever, and after it no certificate can be established.

clauses.zh: 见证之族重出一遍，不改一步，不改一凭。
clauses.en: Listing the family of witnesses twice changes no step and no certificate.

clauses.zh: 阙，于不能定处不出值也。
clauses.en: Silence: giving no value where the value cannot be determined.

clauses.zh: 凡读于一域，所给之值皆为特征之值，谓之于域符；
clauses.en: Where every value a reading gives on a region is the value of the feature, the reading is said to accord on the region;

clauses.zh: 于域之每状皆出特征之值，谓之于域每状皆得。
clauses.en: Where it gives the value of the feature at every configuration of the region, it is said to hit at every configuration of the region.

clauses.zh: 处处阙者，于域符；
clauses.en: What keeps silence everywhere accords on the region;

clauses.zh: 域有一状，则处处阙者不于域每状皆得。
clauses.en: If the region has a configuration, what keeps silence everywhere does not hit at every configuration of the region.

clauses.zh: 于域符之读，于类并域中二状而特征异之处，必阙。
clauses.en: A reading that accords on the region must keep silence wherever the lumping puts together two configurations of the region with different features.

clauses.zh: 于域每状皆得之读，必特征于域中随类而同；
clauses.en: A reading that hits at every configuration of the region requires the feature to be same by class on the region;

clauses.zh: 类于域中之每值，皆给出域中出此值之一状，则于域每状皆得之读有之，恰当特征于域中随类而同。
clauses.en: If for each value of the lumping on the region a configuration of the region giving this value is given, then a reading that hits at every configuration of the region exists exactly where the feature is same by class on the region.

title: 读不尽其所读
title_en: A reading does not exhaust what it reads

clauses.zh: 凡以所读为索引之诸读，有一象移每一值，则有一读，诸读无说之者。
clauses.en: For every family of readings indexed by what is read, if there is a model that moves every value, then there is a reading that no reading of the family expresses.

clauses.zh: 以所读为索引之诸辞，不能说辞之每一样；
clauses.en: Claims indexed by what is read cannot express every kind of claim;

clauses.zh: 以自身之状为辞之系辞，无一状然关于状之每一样之辞。
clauses.en: In a frame whose claims are its own configurations, not every kind of claim about configurations is what some configuration holds.

clauses.zh: 值之同异定然否、所读与值皆非空：有以所读为索引之诸读，以相等比较说每一读者，恰当值只有一种。
clauses.en: Where sameness and difference of values are decided and what is read and the values are both nonempty: there is a family of readings indexed by what is read that expresses every reading by comparison for equality, exactly where the values are of only one kind.

clauses.zh: 以所读为索引之诸读逐步而补其所缺者，每步守其前步所说者，并说前步之所缺：所用之象移每一值，则每步缺其自身之缺，后步必说前步所未说者；
clauses.en: For readings indexed by what is read that supply step by step what they lack, each step keeping what the step before expressed and expressing what the step before lacked: if the model used moves every value, then each step lacks its own lack, and a later step must express what an earlier step did not;

clauses.zh: 比较诸值之关系又对称而可传，则无有穷多之读能于每步皆有其一说此步之所缺。
clauses.en: If the relation comparing the values is moreover symmetric and transitive, then no finitely many readings can have at every step one of them that expresses what this step lacks.

clauses.zh: 知来，自往出一值或阙也。
clauses.en: Extrapolation gives a value from the prefix, or keeps silence.

clauses.zh: 得，出一值而即所来之值也；
clauses.en: Hits: it gives a value, and it is the value that comes;

clauses.zh: 不符，出一值而所来异也；
clauses.en: Misses: it gives a value, and what comes differs;

clauses.zh: 符，无一步不符也。
clauses.en: Accords: at no step a miss.

clauses.zh: 值之同异定然否，则所给之值不为不符者，即所来之值：符者于每步或阙，或得。
clauses.en: Where sameness and difference of values are decided, a value given that is not a miss is the value that comes: what accords at each step either keeps silence or hits.

title: 往不定来与不测
title_en: The prefix does not fix what comes, and the diagonal course

clauses.zh: 终而复始，文自某步起，每隔定数之步而复也。
clauses.en: A lasso: a course that from some step on returns every fixed number of steps.

clauses.zh: 凡文、凡步，有二值，则有二文与之同往而于此步各为一值，二文皆终而复始；
clauses.en: For every course and every step, where there are two values, there are two courses with the same prefix as it that take one value each at this step, and both courses are lassos;

clauses.zh: 自此往出一值，于二文皆无不符，不然；
clauses.en: It is not so that a value given from this prefix misses on neither course;

clauses.zh: 值之同异定然否，则于其一不符。
clauses.en: Where sameness and difference of values are decided, it misses on one of them.

clauses.zh: 不测，一知来于其上所给之值皆不符之文也：有一象移每一值，则凡知来于其不测之文上所给之每值皆不符，无一步起每步皆得者；
clauses.en: A diagonal course is a course on which every value an extrapolation gives misses: if there is a model that moves every value, then every value any extrapolation gives on its diagonal course misses, and there is no step from which it hits at every step;

clauses.zh: 不测之文为一法之轨经一象之文，此法之状含其全往，无一族尽其状。
clauses.en: The diagonal course is the course through a model of the trajectory of a law whose configurations contain the whole prefix, and no family contains all its configurations.

clauses.zh: 过则改，依次用候选，当前者不符则换其次，所给之值即当前者所给之值也。
clauses.en: Extrapolation by elimination uses candidates in order, moving to the next when the current one misses, and the value it gives is the value the current one gives.

clauses.zh: 值之同异定然否：当前候选之次序不减；
clauses.en: Where sameness and difference of values are decided: the position of the current candidate in the order does not decrease;

clauses.zh: 凡与文相符之候选，过则改不越之；
clauses.en: Extrapolation by elimination does not pass beyond any candidate that accords with the course;

clauses.zh: 有候选与之相符，则不屡不符；
clauses.en: If some candidate accords with the course, missing does not recur;

clauses.zh: 凡被越之候选，皆曾于往之某步不符。
clauses.en: Every candidate passed over has missed at some step of the prefix.

clauses.zh: 凡法，其轨之状皆在一族之中，则经任一类之文终而复始，始步与其复之步数之和不过族之员数。
clauses.en: For every law all the configurations of whose trajectory lie in one family, the course through any lumping is a lasso, and its start step plus the number of steps of its return is no more than the number of members of the family.

clauses.zh: 值之同异定然否，于此法之轨，过则改于终而复始之候选上：其不符少于族之员数之三角数；
clauses.en: Where sameness and difference of values are decided, on the trajectory of this law, extrapolation by elimination over lasso candidates: its misses are fewer than the triangular number of the number of members of the family;

clauses.zh: 自族之员数之步起每步出值；
clauses.en: from the step equal to the number of members of the family on, it gives a value at every step;

clauses.zh: 不屡不符；
clauses.en: missing does not recur;

clauses.zh: 其自某步起每步皆得，不可非；
clauses.en: that from some step on it hits at every step cannot be refuted;

clauses.zh: 族之员数为 N、其三角数为 T，则自 N＋(N＋N－1)·T 步起每步皆得。
clauses.en: If the number of members of the family is N and its triangular number is T, then from step N + (N + N − 1)·T on it hits at every step.

clauses.zh: 凡于终而复始之候选上过则改，自某步起每步皆得者，其文终而复始；
clauses.en: If extrapolation by elimination over lasso candidates hits at every step from some step on, then the course is a lasso;

clauses.zh: 有一象移每一值，则其不测之文不终而复始。
clauses.en: If there is a model that moves every value, then its diagonal course is not a lasso.

title: 有界则往定其行
title_en: Bounded, the prefix fixes the run

clauses.zh: 凡二文，其状一不过 N 种、一不过 N′ 种，于 N＋N′－1 步之前皆同，则处处皆同：其往至此定之。
clauses.en: For every two courses, one with no more than N kinds of configuration and the other with no more than N′ kinds, if they are the same before step N + N′ − 1, then they are the same everywhere: the prefix up to there fixes them.

clauses.zh: 此长确切：有二值，则于任何界，有二文，状各不过其界，同至 N＋N′－2 步之前而于此步异。
clauses.en: This length is exact: where there are two values, for any bounds there are two courses, each with configurations within its bound, the same before step N + N′ − 2 and different at this step.

clauses.zh: 值之同异定然否，状不过 N 种之文上，界内终而复始之候选于 N＋N－1 步之前无不符者，永无不符。
clauses.en: Where sameness and difference of values are decided, on a course with no more than N kinds of configuration, a lasso candidate within the bound that has no miss before step N + N − 1 never misses.

clauses.zh: 值之同异定然否，不给界而用最小界之知来，于状不过 N 种之文，自 N＋N－1 步起每步皆得；
clauses.en: Where sameness and difference of values are decided, extrapolation that is given no bound and uses the least bound hits at every step from step N + N − 1 on, on every course with no more than N kinds of configuration;

clauses.zh: 有二值，则无知来能于每一状不过 M＋2 种之文，皆于 M＋M＋2 步得。
clauses.en: Where there are two values, no extrapolation hits at step M + M + 2 on every course with no more than M + 2 kinds of configuration.

clauses.zh: 法下，族中之状闭于此法者，族中二状经类文同，恰当其文于族之员数减一步之前皆同；
clauses.en: Under a law, where the configurations of a family form an absorbing region of this law, two configurations of the family have the same course through a lumping exactly where their courses are the same before the step equal to the number of members of the family minus one;

clauses.zh: 有一族尽其状，则二状自身起凡一串之动同可行、行后所能然之辞同，亦恰当此。
clauses.en: Where one family contains all the configurations, this also holds exactly where, from the two configurations themselves, every string of moves can be run alike and the claims that can hold after running are the same.

clauses.zh: 习，经所见而择也：凡由所见之值所算之量（于所见上同之二函，其量皆同），由之所为之择，于所见上同之二函皆同。
clauses.en: Training is selection through the data: for every amount computed from the values in the data (two functions the same on the data have the same amount), the selection made from it is the same for two functions the same on the data.

clauses.zh: 凡一域之函，其中二函于所见上同者于一入皆同值，恰当所见于此域定此入之值；
clauses.en: For every region of functions, any two functions in it that are the same on the data have the same value at an input exactly where the data fix the value at this input on this region;

clauses.zh: 域于所见外一入自由，则凡经所见之择，于此仍如域之自由。
clauses.en: If the region is free at an input outside the data, then every selection through the data is still as free there as the region.

clauses.zh: 可知，一特征经一类，有知来自经此类之往出值，于每状之轨皆自某步起每步皆得之也。
clauses.en: Learnable: for a feature through a lumping, there is an extrapolation that gives values from the prefix through this lumping and, on the trajectory of every configuration, hits at every step from some step on.

clauses.zh: 类之同异定然否，于一族尽其状之宇：一特征经一类可知，恰当凡经此类文同之二状，其特征自某步起皆同；
clauses.en: Where sameness and difference of classes are decided, in a world whose configurations one family contains: a feature is learnable through a lumping exactly where for any two configurations with the same course through this lumping, their features are the same from some step on;

clauses.zh: 亦恰当有一唯由经类之往而定之猜，于极追踪此特征。
clauses.en: also exactly where there is a guess fixed only by the prefix through the lumping that tracks this feature in the limit.

clauses.zh: 随类而同之特征，皆可知；
clauses.en: Every feature same by class is learnable;

clauses.zh: 法令每状不改者，可知者恰是随类而同者。
clauses.en: Under a law that leaves every configuration unchanged, the learnable features are exactly those same by class.

clauses.zh: 经类文同之二状，其特征屡异，则无知来于二者之轨皆自某步起每步皆得。
clauses.en: If two configurations with the same course through the lumping have features that differ recurrently, then no extrapolation hits at every step from some step on, on both trajectories.

clauses.zh: 有例：一状一类值之宇，二特征各有一知来自某步起每步皆得之，而无一知来于二者皆然。
clauses.en: An example: a world of one configuration and one class value, in which each of two features has an extrapolation that hits it at every step from some step on, and no extrapolation does so for both.

clauses.zh: 衢，二行之类于某步之前皆同、于此步异也。
clauses.en: Runs part: the classes of two runs are the same before some step and differ at this step.

clauses.zh: 凡于衢，无知来于此步于二行皆得。
clauses.en: Wherever runs part, no extrapolation hits on both runs at this step.

clauses.zh: 动与状皆有一族尽之、步之可否定然否、类之同异定然否之变：以此变所构之知来，于某步于自一状起之每行皆得，恰当自此状起之二行于此步皆不成衢。
clauses.en: For a process whose moves and configurations each have a family containing all of them, where whether a step is allowed is decided and sameness and difference of classes are decided: the extrapolation built from this process hits at some step on every run from a configuration exactly where no two runs from this configuration part at this step.

clauses.zh: 有二值，则凡往之后，于凡状皆可移至凡状之变中，皆有二行同此往而于此成衢。
clauses.en: Where there are two values, after every prefix, in a process in which every configuration can go to every configuration, there are two runs with this prefix that part here.

clauses.zh: 大率，以计数言多数之历程显其轻重也。
clauses.en: Typicality: the histories that are the majority by counting show their weighting.

clauses.zh: 凡二值各有自然数之轻重 p、q，n 步诸历程各以其轻重计其平方差，其和恰为 n·p·q·(p＋q)^n；
clauses.en: For two values with natural-number weightings p and q, if each history of n steps counts its squared deviation by its weighting, the sum is exactly n·p·q·(p + q)^n;

clauses.zh: 平方差不小于 d 之历程，其轻重之和乘 d 不过此数。
clauses.en: The sum of the weightings of the histories whose squared deviation is not less than d, multiplied by d, is no more than this number.

clauses.zh: 凡 u 不小于 v，至少有 k 个一之历程，其轻重之和乘 u^k·v^n，不过 (p·u＋q·v)^n·v^k。
clauses.en: For every u not less than v, the sum of the weightings of the histories with at least k ones, multiplied by u^k·v^n, is no more than (p·u + q·v)^n·v^k.

clauses.zh: 以时为动，n 步之时之历程，其历程之平方差不小于 d 者，其数乘 d 亦不过 n·p·q·(p＋q)^n。
clauses.en: With situations as moves, the number of histories of situations of n steps whose history has a squared deviation not less than d, multiplied by d, is also no more than n·p·q·(p + q)^n.

clauses.zh: 名（一·二十）有三处：物之名，宇所以标其物者也；
clauses.en: A name (1.20) is in three places: the name of a relatum, by which the world labels its relata;

clauses.zh: 状之名，读给状之值（状经类之文之前段亦其一种，十·十）；
clauses.en: the name of a configuration, the value a reading gives a configuration (the earlier segment of the course of a configuration through a lumping is one kind of it, 10.10);

clauses.zh: 义项之名，码所配者也。
clauses.en: the name of a sense entry, what a code assigns.

clauses.zh: 码，以名配诸义项者也；
clauses.en: A code assigns names to sense entries;

clauses.zh: 义项，一名所可指之一义也；
clauses.en: A sense entry is one meaning a name can refer to;

clauses.zh: 听，听者于一义项依从违取说者之名也；
clauses.en: Hearing: a hearer, for a sense entry, takes the name of the speaker according to whether it follows or not;

clauses.zh: 录（九·二十二）之于名，记其遇一名与否、予何义项也。
clauses.en: A record (9.22), for a name, notes whether the name occurs in it and which sense entries it offers.

clauses.zh: 凡改认，每所待之恒持、终不足、绝而终不足皆不改。
clauses.en: Under every re-identification, whether each condition is renewed, consumed or broken for good does not change.

clauses.zh: 名无固宜，名不载关系也：凡改名，待者之恒、竭、剥，其待之结与解，其作，与待网之不息，皆不改；
clauses.en: Names have no fixed fit: names carry no relation: under every renaming, the renewing, consuming and undermining of a formation, the forming and dissolving of its dependences, its arising, and the web being unceasing do not change;

clauses.zh: 以不并之改名换一读或一码之名，读之载法、码之以一名配二义项与否（十·七），皆不改。
clauses.en: Replacing the names of a reading or a code by a renaming that merges nothing, whether the reading carries a law and whether the code assigns one name to two sense entries (10.7) do not change.

clauses.zh: 有一待网，其一改认每步之关系皆同，而恒、剥、结与不息皆改，且改认后无恒而有二竭。
clauses.en: There is a web with a re-identification under which the relations at every step are the same, while renewing, undermining, forming and unceasing all change, and after the re-identification nothing is renewing and two are consuming.

clauses.zh: 正名（一·二十三）之律：凡二正名，所并者同。
clauses.en: The law of descriptions that make sense (1.23): every two descriptions that make sense put together the same things.

clauses.zh: 以状自名为正名，恰当同之状本为一。
clauses.en: Naming configurations by themselves is a description that makes sense exactly where alike configurations are in fact one.

clauses.zh: 法以一类示之，一读所并者所示皆同、此读载法、且凡二状自身起每步所示皆同者此读皆并之，则此读为正名。
clauses.en: Where a law is shown through a lumping, if what a reading puts together shows the same, this reading carries the law, and this reading puts together every two configurations that from themselves on show the same at every step, then this reading is a description that makes sense.

clauses.zh: 私名，一步之内一名止于一物也；
clauses.en: A proper name: within one step a name belongs to one relatum only.

clauses.zh: 达名，凡所读者皆并为一之名也。
clauses.en: An unrestricted name is a name that puts together everything read as one.

clauses.zh: 凡改认，每步之新名皆私名。
clauses.en: Under every re-identification, the new names at each step are proper names.

clauses.zh: 凡动皆随以状自名之类而同。
clauses.en: Every move is same by class for the lumping that names configurations by themselves.

clauses.zh: 达名于凡变皆载法；
clauses.en: The unrestricted name carries a law for every process;

clauses.zh: 法以一类示之，达名为正名，恰当凡二状自身起每步所示皆同。
clauses.en: Where a law is shown through a lumping, the unrestricted name is a description that makes sense exactly where every two configurations from themselves on show the same at every step.

clauses.zh: 贯，凡遇一名之录皆予一义项也。
clauses.en: Cross-situational standing: every record in which a name occurs offers the sense entry.

clauses.zh: 一义项不贯于一名，恰当有一遇此名之录不予之。
clauses.en: A sense entry lacks cross-situational standing for a name exactly where some record in which this name occurs does not offer it.

clauses.zh: 通意，一名于义项之族中犹贯者唯余一义项也。
clauses.en: Resolves: in a family of sense entries, only one sense entry is left that still has cross-situational standing for a name.

clauses.zh: 凡义项之族其员各异、义项之同异定然否：一名通意于一义项，恰当此义项在族中，凡遇此名之录皆予之，且族中他义项各有一遇此名之录不予之。
clauses.en: For every family of sense entries with distinct members, where sameness and difference of sense entries are decided: a name resolves to a sense entry exactly where this sense entry is in the family, every record in which this name occurs offers it, and each other sense entry of the family has a record in which this name occurs that does not offer it.

clauses.zh: 后之录唯减族中犹贯者，所去者不复。
clauses.en: Later records only reduce the members of the family that still have standing; those removed do not return.

clauses.zh: 所指在族中而凡遇此名之录皆予之，则族中唯一犹贯者即所指。
clauses.en: If what is meant is in the family and every record in which this name occurs offers it, then the one member of the family that still has standing is what is meant.

clauses.zh: 辨，码不以一名配二义项也。
clauses.en: Tells apart: a code does not assign one name to two sense entries.

clauses.zh: 喻，读者之码配一义项之名，正是所听之名也。
clauses.en: Decodes: the name the code of what reads assigns to a sense entry is exactly the name heard.

clauses.zh: 凡读者之码辨：读说者配某义项之名为此义项且唯此，恰当二码于此义项同名；
clauses.en: For every code of what reads that tells apart: the name the speaker assigns to some sense entry is read as this sense entry and only this exactly where the two codes give this sense entry the same name;

clauses.zh: 读者以说者之名配他义项者，喻为他义项而不为此。
clauses.en: Where what reads assigns the name of the speaker to another sense entry, it decodes it as the other sense entry and not as this one.

clauses.zh: 码自喻其诸名，恰当其辨。
clauses.en: A code decodes its own names exactly where it tells apart.

clauses.zh: 于一域随一名之类而同者，旁读他名，于此域亦随二名并读之类而同。
clauses.en: What is same by class on a region for the lumping of one name, reading another name alongside, is also same by class on this region for the lumping of the two names read together.

clauses.zh: 知名，自所问读得其码也。
clauses.en: Code acquisition is obtaining a code by reading what is asked.

clauses.zh: 于二原子以接与倍所成之式：二原子之值有异之码，自二原子与一接之所问读出之码即其码，于凡式与之同值，深无所限；
clauses.en: For formulas built from two atoms by joining and doubling: for codes in which the values of the two atoms differ, the code read out from what is asked of the two atoms and of one join is the code itself, with the same value on every formula, with no limit of depth;

clauses.zh: 于二原子之值有异之诸码，只读二原子之值，接之序不随其类而同，故无读于其每码皆得其序。
clauses.en: For codes in which the values of the two atoms differ, reading only the values of the two atoms, the order of joining is not same by class for its lumping, so no reading obtains its order for every one of these codes.

title: 前段之名与所带之值
title_en: Prefix names and the values they carry

clauses.zh: 前段之名，以状经类之文之前段为状之名也。
clauses.en: A prefix name takes the earlier segment of the course of a configuration through a lumping as the name of the configuration.

clauses.zh: 凡法，诸状有一族尽之，其员 N，类之同异定然否：一特征经此类可知，恰当有一族，不过 N 员，员各为一前段之名（长 N−1）与其所带之值，以此族知来者，于每状之轨皆自某步起每步皆得。
clauses.en: For every law whose configurations one family of N members contains, where sameness and difference of classes are decided: a feature is learnable through this lumping exactly where there is a family of no more than N members, each member a prefix name (of length N − 1) with the value it carries, such that extrapolation by this family hits, on the trajectory of every configuration, at every step from some step on.

clauses.zh: 凡以一族知来而于一状之轨自某步起每步皆得者，自此步起，特征所取之每值皆为族中某员所带之值。
clauses.en: For every extrapolation by a family that hits at every step from some step on, on the trajectory of a configuration, from this step on every value the feature takes is the value carried by some member of the family.

clauses.zh: 约定俗成，码于诸待者之间以听而成也。
clauses.en: A shared code is a code formed among formations by hearing.

clauses.zh: 凡听不造名：听后每待者于每义项之名，或其旧名，或说者之名。
clauses.en: No hearing coins a name: after hearing, the name of each formation for each sense entry is either its old name or the name of the speaker.

clauses.zh: 一域之待者于一义项同名，凡于此义项之听，听者在域内则说者亦在域内者，其同不改。
clauses.en: If the formations of a region have the same name for a sense entry, and in every hearing on this sense entry in which the hearer is within the region the speaker is also within the region, their sameness does not change.

clauses.zh: 诸待者于一义项皆同名，则其后凡听、凡从违，此义项之名皆不改。
clauses.en: If all formations have the same name for a sense entry, then afterwards, under every hearing and every following or not, the name of this sense entry does not change.

clauses.zh: 凡听皆从者：每待者于一义项所得之名，乃起点时其所自之名；
clauses.en: Where every hearing follows: the name each formation obtains for a sense entry is the name, at the starting point, of its provenance;

clauses.zh: 有二名相异者，一听之序自凡起点皆使诸待者于此义项同名，恰当其使诸待者于此义项同所自；
clauses.en: Where there are two different names, an order of hearing brings the formations to the same name for this sense entry from every starting point exactly where it brings them to the same provenance for this sense entry;

clauses.zh: 有一族尽诸待者而待者非无，一序所能使共享之名，恰为起点已在用之名。
clauses.en: Where one family contains all the formations and there are formations, the names an order can make shared are exactly the names already in use at the starting point.

clauses.zh: 凡码之法，不偏于其所互换之诸待者，亦不偏于其所改之名，而此改名于一义项移其每名：自于二者对称之起点，所互换之待者于此义项永不同名。
clauses.en: For every law of codes unchanged by the exchange of the formations it exchanges and by the renaming of the names it changes, where this renaming moves every name for a sense entry: from a starting point symmetric under both, the exchanged formations never have the same name for this sense entry.

clauses.zh: 有二待者焉：众所从者、所偏之名、一听之序，各于一步使之同名；
clauses.en: There are two formations for which one that all follow, a preferred name, and an order of hearing each bring them to the same name in one step;

clauses.zh: 众所从者与听之序偏待者之互换，所偏之名偏改名。
clauses.en: The one that all follow and the order of hearing break the exchange of formations; the preferred name breaks the renaming.

clauses.zh: 凡从之一听，听者之码原辨者，听后仍辨，恰当所取之名非听者已配于他义项者。
clauses.en: For every hearing that is followed, a code of the hearer that told apart before still tells apart after, exactly where the name taken is not one the hearer has already assigned to another sense entry.

clauses.zh: 有二码焉，各辨二义项，一听彼于一义项之名而从之，遂以一名配二义项：逐义项而成之同名，可并义项。
clauses.en: There are two codes, each telling apart two sense entries; one hears the name of the other for one sense entry and follows it, and so assigns one name to two sense entries: sameness of names formed sense entry by sense entry can merge sense entries.

clauses.zh: 制名，以一码加于诸待者也。
clauses.en: An imposed code is a code put on the formations.

clauses.zh: 凡制名，诸待者于每义项同名；
clauses.en: Under every imposed code, the formations have the same name for each sense entry;

clauses.zh: 诸待者于凡义项皆相喻（喻为此且唯此），恰当所加之码辨；
clauses.en: The formations decode one another on every sense entry (decoding it as this and only this) exactly where the code put on them tells apart;

clauses.zh: 每待者恰失其原码所辨而所加之码所并者，其码即所加之码者无所遗；
clauses.en: Each formation loses exactly what its original code told apart and the code put on it merges; one whose code is the code put on it loses nothing;

clauses.zh: 此后凡听、凡从违，皆不改之。
clauses.en: Afterwards no hearing and no following or not changes this.

clauses.zh: 所并之辨：加于一域之待者，而域外之待者亦持所加之名者，永不复；
clauses.en: A distinction merged: if the code is put on the formations of a region, and formations outside the region also hold the names put on, it never returns;

clauses.zh: 所加之码并二义项者，一待者于其一持所加之名，于其二听一所持非所加之名者而从之，即复辨此二义项。
clauses.en: Where the code put on merges two sense entries, if a formation holding the name put on for one of them hears, for the other, a name held that is not the one put on and follows it, it tells these two sense entries apart again.

clauses.zh: 每代读前代之录：通意，则此代之录唯一录，遇此名而只予所通义项；
clauses.en: Each cohort reads the records of the cohort before: if they resolve, then the records of this cohort are a single record in which this name occurs and which offers only the sense entry resolved to;

clauses.zh: 不通，则原样传之。
clauses.en: if they do not resolve, they are passed on as they are.

clauses.zh: 凡义项之族其员各异、义项之同异定然否，前代之录通于一义项：自次代起录不再改，代代通于此义项。
clauses.en: For every family of sense entries with distinct members, where sameness and difference of sense entries are decided, if the records of the cohort before resolve to a sense entry: from the next cohort on the records change no more, and every cohort resolves to this sense entry.

clauses.zh: 通于同一义项之二族录，次代即为一，此后凡读于二者皆给同值。
clauses.en: Two families of records that resolve to the same sense entry become one at the next cohort, and afterwards every reading gives them the same value.

clauses.zh: 存前代之录而合读后之录者，唯通于原义项或不通；
clauses.en: Records that keep the records of the earlier cohort and read the later records together with them only resolve to the original sense entry or do not resolve;

clauses.zh: 录唯增者，所通可失而不可易。
clauses.en: Where records only grow, what they resolve to can be lost but not replaced.

clauses.zh: 应，一待者之取与随一所待之积而异也：有二历，除某步某所待之积外皆同，而取与之法使此待者跨一步于一所待之取与之差为正。
clauses.en: Responds to: the taking and giving of a formation differs with the level of a condition: there are two histories, the same except for the level of some condition at some step, and the law of taking and giving makes the gap between the takings and givings of this formation at a condition across a step positive.

clauses.zh: 取与之法缘感而读，谓凡在体外之待者，二历缘其感至某步每步无异，则此法于此待者跨此步之取与无异。
clauses.en: A law of taking and giving reads through couplings where, for every formation outside the part, if two histories are alike through its couplings at every step up to some step, then the taking and giving of this law for this formation across this step do not differ.

title: 感界应而不定应
title_en: Coupling bounds response and does not fix it

clauses.zh: 凡各待者于各步、各历与一历缘感无异否皆定然否，而一待者缘其感至某步分开此二历：则于任一所待，有一取与之法，缘一切待者之感而读，而此待者跨此步于此所待之取于二历下不同；
clauses.en: Where for each formation, each step and each history, whether it is alike through couplings with a history is decided, and a formation separates these two histories through its couplings up to some step: then for any condition there is a law of taking and giving that reads through the couplings of all formations under which the uptake of this formation at this condition across this step differs under the two histories;

clauses.zh: 亦有一取与之法，缘一切待者之感而读，而于一切步、一切历取与皆无异。
clauses.en: There is also a law of taking and giving that reads through the couplings of all formations whose taking and giving do not differ at any step or under any history.

title: 以积感入之所从来
title_en: Where coupling by level comes from

clauses.zh: 凡取与之法缘感而读而感唯以阈（无一所待以积感入任一待者），体外一待者于诸积不容之之步不取不与：二历于一步之前皆同，于此步后者每一所待之积皆不少于前者，则此待者跨此步于每一所待之所取、所与，后者皆不少于前者。
clauses.en: For every law of taking and giving that reads through couplings with couplings only by threshold (no condition couples into any formation by its level), where a formation outside the part neither takes nor gives at steps at which the levels do not admit it: if two histories are the same before a step, and at this step the level of each condition in the latter is not less than in the former, then the uptake and the replenishment of this formation at each condition across this step are, in the latter, not less than in the former.

clauses.zh: 故所待之同异定然否，则一应，与一所待之量唯定于所待 d 于其步之积而 d 之积不过 N 者：有一族如是之待者，依如是之法，所与之和恰为此应，恰当凡 x 少于 N，d 之积为 x 时之应不多于为 x 加一时者；
clauses.en: So, where sameness and difference of conditions are decided, for a response whose amount given to a condition is fixed only by the level of condition d at its step, the level of d being no more than N: there is a family of such formations, following such laws, whose sum of giving is exactly this response, exactly where for every x less than N, the response when the level of d is x is no more than when it is x plus one;

clauses.zh: 补 d 之积于一正量之缺之应（N 为正），无一族如是之待者所与之和恰为之。
clauses.en: No family of such formations has a sum of giving exactly equal to the response that supplies the shortfall of the level of d below a positive amount (N being positive).

clauses.zh: 所待之同异定然否，d 与一他所待于其步之积之和定为 N，则有一族待者，各以 d 与此所待为需而于诸积不容之之步不取不与，依如是之法，所与之和恰为凡唯定于 d 之积之应。
clauses.en: Where sameness and difference of conditions are decided and the sum of the levels of d and one other condition at its step is fixed at N, there is a family of formations, each with needs at d and at this condition and neither taking nor giving at steps at which the levels do not admit it, following such laws, whose sum of giving is exactly every response fixed only by the level of d.

clauses.zh: 所待与待者之同异定然否，则一所待以积感入体外一待者，不可非，恰当不可非有一缘感而读之取与之法，以不改此待者于此所待之需之足否之积之变应之。
clauses.en: Where sameness and difference of conditions and formations are decided, that a condition couples into a formation outside the part by its level cannot be refuted, exactly where it cannot be refuted that there is a law of taking and giving that reads through couplings and responds to it by a change of level that does not change whether the need of this formation at this condition is met.

title: 所及与诸域
title_en: What a part reaches and the closures

clauses.zh: 体之一员于某步在场，于一待者所待之所待有取与，则谓体及彼待者，是为所及。
clauses.en: If a member of a part takes part at some step and takes from or gives to a condition that a formation depends on, the part is said to reach that formation; this is what a part reaches.

clauses.zh: 资域，凡含此待者，且“其中者某步待一所待，有于此步在场而与之者，则与之者亦在其中”之域，所共含者也。
clauses.en: The feeding closure is what is contained in common by every region that contains this formation and is such that "if a member of it depends on a condition at some step, and something taking part at this step gives to the condition, then what gives to it is also in it".

clauses.zh: 扰域，凡含此待者，且凡于其中者所待之所待有取与者皆在其中之域，所共含者也。
clauses.en: The influence closure is what is contained in common by every region that contains this formation and contains everything that takes from or gives to a condition that a member of it depends on.

clauses.zh: 及域，凡含此待者，且“其中者于之有取与之所待为一待者所待，则此待者亦在其中”之域，所共含者也。
clauses.en: The reach closure is what is contained in common by every region that contains this formation and is such that "if a condition that a member of it takes from or gives to is depended on by a formation, then this formation is also in it".

clauses.zh: 感域，凡含此待者，且凡于感入其中者之所待有取与者皆在其中之域，所共含者也。
clauses.en: The coupling closure is what is contained in common by every region that contains this formation and contains everything that takes from or gives to a condition that couples into a member of it.

clauses.zh: 群域，凡含此待者，且凡与其中者共一所待（各或待之、或于之有取与）者皆在其中之域，所共含者也。
clauses.en: The system closure is what is contained in common by every region that contains this formation and contains everything that shares a condition with a member of it (each either depending on it or taking from or giving to it).

clauses.zh: 资域在扰域中，扰域在感域中；
clauses.en: The feeding closure lies within the influence closure, and the influence closure within the coupling closure;

clauses.zh: 扰域与及域皆在群域中。
clauses.en: The influence closure and the reach closure both lie within the system closure.

clauses.zh: 唯以阈感入者，感域即扰域。
clauses.en: Where coupling is only by threshold, the coupling closure is the influence closure.

clauses.zh: 乙在甲之群域，则甲在乙之群域。
clauses.en: If B is in the system closure of A, then A is in the system closure of B.

clauses.zh: 凡在扰域外者，不于域中任一者所待之所待有取与；
clauses.en: Everything beyond the influence closure takes from and gives to no condition that anything in the closure depends on;

clauses.zh: 凡在资域外者，于任一步在场，其于域中者此步所待之所待之所与为零；
clauses.en: Everything beyond the feeding closure, taking part at any step, gives zero to the conditions that what is in the closure depends on at this step;

clauses.zh: 凡在感域外者，不于感入域中任一者之所待有取与。
clauses.en: Everything beyond the coupling closure takes from and gives to no condition that couples into anything in the closure.

clauses.zh: 凡流衡，体之诸员皆在此待者之扰域外：则扰域中每一待者于每步，容于其积，恰当容于偏去此体之积（偏去之积，自同一始积，每步依体之诸员取与皆为零、余者如故之流而变者）。
clauses.en: Under every flow that balances, if all members of the part are beyond the influence closure of this formation: then each formation in the influence closure is, at each step, admitted by the levels exactly where it is admitted by the levels with this part withheld (the levels with the part withheld change, from one and the same starting level, at each step by the flow in which the taking and giving of the members of the part are all zero and the rest is as before).

clauses.zh: 感域随以积感入者而增，亦随于所待有取与者而增。
clauses.en: The coupling closure grows with what couples in by level, and also with what takes from or gives to conditions.

clauses.zh: 一关系去若干联，沿之之诸域皆如故，恰当每一所去之联，其终仍在沿所余之联其始之域中：每一所去之联皆有旁路。
clauses.en: If some links are removed from a relation, the closures along it all stay as before exactly where, for every link removed, its end still lies in the closure of its start along the remaining links: every removed link has a bypass.

clauses.zh: 依附而长之关系（诸联为一族，每一新联接一前未在任何联之物于一他物），去其任一联，则此联之两端相离：其一不在沿余联其他之域中。
clauses.en: For a relation grown by attachment (its links a family, each new link joining a relatum not before in any link to another relatum), removing any one of its links separates its two ends: one is not in the closure of the other along the remaining links.

clauses.zh: 依附而长之关系再接一联，去一长成之联而诸域如故，恰当新联之两端分在此联之两侧：沿余联，此联之一端至新联之一端，新联之另一端至此联之另一端。
clauses.en: If a relation grown by attachment is joined by one more link, removing a link of the grown relation leaves the closures as before exactly where the two ends of the new link lie on the two sides of this link: along the remaining links, one end of this link reaches one end of the new link, and the other end of the new link reaches the other end of this link.

clauses.zh: 依附而长之宇（其诸所待依次而长，每一所待恰为二待者所共，其一前此不与任何所待），其每一所待皆不可少：或待之、或于之有取与之二待者同在一群域，只沿他所待则不同在。
clauses.en: For a world grown by attachment (its conditions growing one after another, each condition shared by exactly two formations, one of which before this shared no condition), every condition of it is indispensable: the two formations that depend on it or take from or give to it are in one system closure, and along the other conditions alone they are not.

clauses.zh: 应域：自体之诸员出，其中者于二流之一中于感入一待者之所待有取与，则此待者亦在其中，如是辗转而至者也。
clauses.en: The responsive reach is what is reached, starting from the members of the part, by adding again and again a formation whenever something in it, in either of two flows, takes from or gives to a condition that couples into this formation.

clauses.zh: 一待者在体之应域中，恰当体之某员在此待者缘二流所成之感域中。
clauses.en: A formation is in the responsive reach of the part exactly where some member of the part is in the coupling closure this formation has through the two flows.

clauses.zh: 及而不感，在一待者之及域中而不在其感域中者也。
clauses.en: The selection gap is what lies in the reach closure of a formation and not in its coupling closure.

clauses.zh: 凡此待者感域中者所感之所待每步皆衡，体之诸员皆在其感域外：则凡缘感域中任一者（此待者在内）之感而择者，于积之历与偏去此体之积之历择之同；
clauses.en: If the conditions coupling into everything in the coupling closure of this formation balance at every step, and all members of the part are beyond its coupling closure: then every selector through the couplings of anything in the coupling closure (this formation included) selects the history of levels and the history of levels with this part withheld alike;

clauses.zh: 诸员皆在其感域中之任一域，合诸员之感而择者，亦同之。
clauses.en: For any region all of whose members lie in its coupling closure, what selects through the couplings of all its members together also selects them alike.

clauses.zh: 凡余者于二流皆循一缘感而读之取与之法，二流皆衡，在场者同，始积同，体于此待者缘二流所成之感域内动之无异（域中体之员缘感至某步无异，则跨此步于感入域中者之所待取与无异）：则凡缘此域中任一者之感而择者，于二流之积之历择之同；
clauses.en: If the rest follow, in both flows, a law of taking and giving that reads through couplings, both flows balance, what takes part is the same, the starting levels are the same, and the part moves alike within the coupling closure this formation has through the two flows (if the members of the part in the closure are alike through couplings up to some step, their takings and givings across this step at conditions coupling into anything in the closure do not differ): then every selector through the couplings of anything in this closure selects the histories of levels of the two flows alike;

clauses.zh: 动之后果（有此动则然、无此动则不然之择），于任一步非缘此域中任一者之感之择。
clauses.en: The consequence of the move (the selection that holds with this move and does not hold without it) is at no step a selection through the couplings of anything in this closure.

clauses.zh: 余者之法与二动之法皆唯读既立者，前一动缘体之员之感而读，二动于感入域中者之所待无异，二历程皆可行：则二历程亦然，无一所另给。
clauses.en: If the law of the rest and the laws of the two moves read only what is already settled, the first move reads through the couplings of the members of the part, the two moves do not differ at conditions coupling into anything in the closure, and both histories can be run: then the same holds of the two histories, with nothing given separately.

clauses.zh: 二流各于一所待 c 每步衡：c 之积于二流之同异，唯跨二流于 c 之共取或共与相异之步而改；
clauses.en: If two flows each balance at a condition c at every step: whether the level of c is the same in the two flows changes only across steps at which the joint taking or the joint replenishment of the two flows at c differ;

clauses.zh: 在场者同，则此步必有一在场之待者于 c 之所取或所与于二流相异。
clauses.en: If what takes part is the same, then at this step some formation taking part must take from or give to c differently in the two flows.

clauses.zh: 二程于 c 之积于一步复同（复合），则自任一前步至此步，二流于 c 之所取所与恰补其差：一流于前步之积加其间所与加他流其间所取，等于他流于前步之积加其间所与加此流其间所取。
clauses.en: If the levels of the two histories at c become the same again at a step (coming together again), then from any earlier step to this step, the takings and givings of the two flows at c exactly make up their gap: the level of one flow at the earlier step plus what is given in it in between plus what the other flow takes in between equals the level of the other flow at the earlier step plus what is given in it in between plus what this flow takes in between.

clauses.zh: 余者于二流皆循一缘感而读之取与之法，在场者同，体自某步起于二流与 c 取与皆同：则其后 c 之积之同异之改，必经体外一在场之待者，跨某步于 c 之取与于二流相异，而二流之积之历缘其感至此步有异。
clauses.en: If the rest follow, in both flows, a law of taking and giving that reads through couplings, what takes part is the same, and from some step on the part takes from and gives to c the same in both flows: then every later change in whether the level of c is the same must go through a formation taking part outside the part whose taking and giving at c across some step differ in the two flows, while the histories of levels of the two flows are not alike through its couplings up to that step.

title: 升所感者资于外
title_en: Raising what is coupled draws from beyond

clauses.zh: 凡流衡，所待之同异定然否，一域诸员所感之所待皆在一员各异之族中，含此族之一员各异之族跨一步与不过取：则凡唯于此族跨此步益处然、且然之择，必有一在场之待者，与此族多于取于此族，且取于一无员所感之所待。
clauses.en: Under every flow that balances, where sameness and difference of conditions are decided, the conditions coupling into the members of a region all lie in a family with distinct members, and a family with distinct members containing this family is gainless across a step: then for every selection that holds only where this family gains across this step, and that holds, some formation taking part gives to this family more than it takes from it, and takes from a condition that couples into no member.

clauses.zh: 由四·二十一之末律：凡流衡，族与族外一并跨一步与不过取，族外每一所待各有一待者以其需待之而足，族外之员皆不在族中，此域诸员所感之所待皆在族中：则凡唯于族之总积之升过族外诸待之余地之和处然、且然之择，必有族外一所待之待绝，其待者非此域之员，无员感其所待。
clauses.en: By the last law of 4.21: under every flow that balances, if the family together with what lies beyond the family is gainless across a step, each condition beyond the family has a formation depending on it with its need met, the members beyond the family are not in the family, and the conditions coupling into the members of this region all lie in the family: then for every selection that holds only where the rise of the total level of the family is more than the sum of the margins of the dependences beyond the family, and that holds, some dependence on a condition beyond the family is broken, whose formation is not a member of this region and whose condition couples into no member.

title: 莫上之者于族外最少
title_en: The maximal alternative is least beyond the family

clauses.zh: 二果，前者于一族之每一所待之积不少于后者，且于其一所待多之，谓前者于族过后者。
clauses.en: Of two outcomes, where the level of the former at each condition of a family is not less than that of the latter, and is more at one of its conditions, the former is said to surpass the latter on the family.

clauses.zh: 一序，凡于族过之者皆上之，不论族外何如，谓之随族而上。
clauses.en: An order of alternatives that ranks above everything it surpasses on the family, whatever lies beyond the family, is called rising with the family.

clauses.zh: 一族与族外之族：凡随族而上之序之莫上之者，于族外每一所待之积皆为可选之果之最少，恰当凡一可选之果于族外某所待多于另一可选之果，皆不可非有可选之果于族过前者。
clauses.en: For a family and a family beyond it: every maximal alternative of every order rising with the family has at each condition beyond the family the least level among the outcomes that can be chosen, exactly where for every outcome that can be chosen that has more at some condition beyond the family than another outcome that can be chosen, it cannot be refuted that some outcome that can be chosen surpasses the former on the family.

clauses.zh: 可汲，凡一可选之果于族外某所待多于另一可选之果，皆有可选之果于族过前者也；
clauses.en: Room beyond: for every outcome that can be chosen that has more at some condition beyond the family than another outcome that can be chosen, some outcome that can be chosen surpasses the former on the family;

clauses.zh: 有可汲，则随族而上之序之莫上之者，于族外每一所待之积皆为可选之果之最少。
clauses.en: If there is room beyond, then every maximal alternative of an order rising with the family has at each condition beyond the family the least level among the outcomes that can be chosen.

clauses.zh: 于待网，步后之积为如是之莫上之者，有可汲，族外每一所待各有一待者以其需待之而足：则族外一所待之待绝，恰当某可选之果使此所待之积少于其需。
clauses.en: On a web, if the levels after the step are such a maximal alternative, there is room beyond, and each condition beyond the family has a formation depending on it with its need met: then a dependence on a condition beyond the family is broken exactly where some outcome that can be chosen makes the level of this condition less than its need.

clauses.zh: 有宇焉，可选之果为三单位于源与库间之诸分，以“库之积至一者上于不至一者”为序：此序不随库而上，而使源足栖者之需之果与使源少于其需之果，俱为其莫上之者。
clauses.en: There is a world whose outcomes that can be chosen are the divisions of three units between a source and a store, ordered by "a level of the store reaching one ranks above one not reaching one": this order does not rise with the store, and the outcome in which the source meets the need of what dwells at it and the outcome that leaves the source below its need are both its maximal alternatives.

title: 可汲读于取与，诸择上者
title_en: Room beyond read off the exchange; maximal selectors

clauses.zh: 凡所待与待者之同异定然否，在场者之族之员各异，族连族外之族之员各异，族外之员皆不在族中，族有一所待；
clauses.en: For every case in which sameness and difference of conditions and formations are decided, the members of the family of what takes part are distinct, the members of the family joined with the family beyond are distinct, the members beyond the family are not in the family, and the family has a condition;

clauses.zh: 体之每员跨一步于每一所待所取不过其取限，只与族与族外之所待，而与之之和不过取于之之和；
clauses.en: each member of the part takes across a step at each condition no more than its taking limit, gives only to conditions of the family and beyond the family, and the sum of what it gives them is no more than the sum of what it takes from them;

clauses.zh: 余者取与如其实，所成之一步衡：则如是可得之诸果（于族外各不少于所设之底者）有可汲。
clauses.en: the rest take and give as they actually do, and the step so formed balances: then the outcomes that can be had in this way (each beyond the family not less than the floor set) have room beyond.

clauses.zh: 凡随族而上之序，其莫上之者于族外每一所待之积，为余者所留（步前之积加余者所与、减余者所取）减体于此之取限，不足则为零；
clauses.en: For every order rising with the family, the level of its maximal alternative at each condition beyond the family is what is left by the rest (the level before the step plus what the rest give, minus what the rest take) minus the taking limit of the part there, or zero if that falls short;

clauses.zh: 体之诸员于此之取限皆无，则莫上之者为余者所留；
clauses.en: If no member of the part has a taking limit there, the maximal alternative is what is left by the rest;

clauses.zh: 莫上之者使之少于余者所留，恰当体于此有取限且余者有所留。
clauses.en: The maximal alternative makes it less than what is left by the rest exactly where the part has a taking limit there and the rest leave something.

clauses.zh: 诸择上者，各有其族、其序随其族而上，各于他者所为之下以此步为其可得之果之莫上之者（相为莫上），此步衡，一所待在每一在场之择上者之族外：则此所待之积为“步前之积加诸择上者之外者所与、减其所取”减诸择上者之取限，不足则为零，与以诸择上者为一体时任一随族而上之序之莫上之者于此所留者同；
clauses.en: For maximal selectors, each with its family and its order rising with its family, each taking this step as a maximal alternative of the outcomes it can have given what the others do (mutually maximal), where this step balances and a condition lies beyond the family of every maximal selector taking part: then the level of this condition is "the level before the step plus what those other than the maximal selectors give, minus what they take" minus the taking limits of the maximal selectors, or zero if that falls short, the same as what is left there by a maximal alternative of any order rising with the family when the maximal selectors are taken as one part;

clauses.zh: 其后此所待若有积，则每择上者于此尽其取限而取，无所与。
clauses.en: Afterwards, if this condition stands as a condition, each maximal selector takes its full taking limit there and gives nothing.

title: 择上之程与所计之步
title_en: The course of maximal selection and the steps counted

clauses.zh: 凡在十一·十四之族与族外之条件下，体每步择上（每步之果皆为体自步前之积可得之果之莫上之者，其序随族而上，余者取与如其实），族外一所待：其积不少于一正需 m 之步，余者与之恰 r，余步不过 r；
clauses.en: Under the hypotheses of 11.14 on the family and the family beyond, if the part selects maximally at every step (the outcome of each step is a maximal alternative, in its order rising with the family, of the outcomes the part can have from the levels before the step, the rest taking and giving as they actually do), then for a condition beyond the family: at steps at which its level is not less than a positive need m, the rest give it exactly r, and at the other steps no more than r;

clauses.zh: 余者所取加体于此之取限每步皆为 k：则一待者每步以需 m 待之、始足者，绝而终不足，恰当 r < k；
clauses.en: If what the rest take plus the taking limit of the part there is k at every step: then a formation depending on it with need m at every step, met at the start, is broken for good exactly where r < k.

clauses.zh: 积始于不少于 m 者，每步皆不少于 m，恰当 k 不过 r。
clauses.en: A level starting not less than m is not less than m at every step exactly where k is no more than r.

clauses.zh: 诸择上者（各于十一·十四之条件下）每步相为莫上，流衡，一所待每步在每一在场之择上者之族外，诸择上者之外者每步与之不过 r，其所取加诸择上者之取限每步过 r，一待者每步以正需 m 待之，始足：则绝而终不足，不论各择上者之取限何小。
clauses.en: If maximal selectors (each under the hypotheses of 11.14) are mutually maximal at every step, the flow balances, a condition lies at every step beyond the family of every maximal selector taking part, those other than the maximal selectors give it no more than r at every step, what they take plus the taking limits of the maximal selectors is more than r at every step, and a formation has a bearing dependence on it with need m at every step, met at the start: then the dependence is broken for good, however small the taking limit of each maximal selector.

clauses.zh: 为天下先，一求者之量于一状多于每一他求者之量也。
clauses.en: Target above all: the amount of one seeking at a configuration is more than the amount of each other seeking.

clauses.zh: 凡状，二求者不俱为天下先。
clauses.en: At every configuration, two seekings do not both have the target above all.

clauses.zh: 凡法，一族有二求者，则无一状为法所不改而其中每一求者皆为天下先。
clauses.en: For every law, if a family has two seekings, then there is no configuration the law leaves unchanged at which every seeking in the family has the target above all.

clauses.zh: 足而止，行至一法所不改而合所求之状，自此不再改而每步合所求也（静见三·十）。
clauses.en: Enough: a run reaches a configuration that the law leaves unchanged and that meets the target, and from then on changes no more and meets the target at every step (for stillness see 3.10).

clauses.zh: 多于今，读于状之一量，一行跨一步而次步多于本步也；
clauses.en: More than now: an amount read from the configuration is, across a step of a run, more at the next step than at this one;

clauses.zh: 凡法，以多于今为所求者，其行不改之步皆不合之。
clauses.en: For every law, where the target is more than now, no step at which its run does not change meets the target.

clauses.zh: 讀（AI，D26、D45）：无明，求不舍其所求，而法所不改之状无一合其所求者也：或以多于今为所求（十一·十七），或二求者以上皆求为天下先（十一·十六）。
clauses.en: Reading (AI, D26, D45): seeking without rest is seeking that does not let go of its target while no configuration the law leaves unchanged meets its target: either the target is more than now (11.17), or two or more seekings each seek the target above all (11.16).

clauses.zh: 择者之所处（及而不感）非无明；
clauses.en: The place of a selector (the selection gap) is not seeking without rest;

clauses.zh: 无明是于此所处不舍之求。
clauses.en: seeking without rest is seeking that does not let go in this place.

clauses.zh: 以多于今为所求而每步皆合之，则所历之状两两相异，是自始日新，无一族能尽之（五·五）。
clauses.en: If the target is more than now and it is met at every step, then the configurations passed through are pairwise different, so there is novelty from the start, and no family can contain them all (5.5).

clauses.zh: 复归，规不改而只扰状之他分，为规所定之状吸回也。
clauses.en: Re-absorbed: where the rule does not change and only the other part of the configuration is perturbed, the configuration is drawn back to the one the rule fixes.

clauses.zh: 凡次状唯依规、不依状之他分，则规同之二状，自次步起其行同。
clauses.en: If the next configuration depends only on the rule and not on the other part of the configuration, then two configurations with the same rule have the same run from the next step on.

clauses.zh: 规不改者（次状之规同于本状之规），具一规之诸状，为法所不离之域。
clauses.en: Where the rule does not change (the rule of the next configuration is the same as the rule of this configuration), the configurations with one rule form a region the law does not leave.

clauses.zh: 执，果唯随规也：状与规为一对，下一对唯依规而不依状。
clauses.en: Capture: the outcome follows only the rule: configuration and rule are a pair, and the next pair depends only on the rule and not on the configuration.

clauses.zh: 凡一择，族之每员各配一数：择于其历然之每员，所配不少于 a；
clauses.en: For every selection, with each member of the family assigned a number: each member whose history the selection holds of is assigned no less than a;

clauses.zh: 于其历不然之每员，所配不多于 b；
clauses.en: each member whose history the selection does not hold of is assigned no more than b;

clauses.zh: b < a，二者皆有：则然者所配之和比不然者所配之和，严大于然者之数比不然者之数（率升）。
clauses.en: If b < a and there are members of both kinds: then the sum assigned to those it holds of, against the sum assigned to those it does not hold of, is strictly greater than the number of those it holds of against the number of those it does not hold of (the ratio rises).

clauses.zh: 与时转，规改之速也（状与规之行与时稽见八·十三，其律见八·十四）。
clauses.en: Pace is the speed at which a rule changes (for the run of configuration and rule and for the reading step, see 8.13; for its law, see 8.14).

clauses.zh: 凡诸值中有二相异者：一规于一快层上不改（状随此规而移）所生之程，经一读为值，其值至多 N 种者，任二于 L 步之段同则全同，恰当 L ≥ 2N − 1。
clauses.en: For any values among which two differ: the paths produced by a rule left unchanged over a fast layer (the configuration moving by this rule), read through a reading into values of at most N kinds, are such that any two that are the same over a stretch of L steps are the same throughout, exactly where L ≥ 2N − 1.

clauses.zh: 劫，规读其所择之率也：状与规之行中，时稽之步所读之规随状之率而不降（率不下，所读之规即不下，不论其时之规）。
clauses.en: Capture through the rule is a rule read from the ratio of what it selects: in a run of configuration and rule, the rule read at a reading step does not fall as the configuration's ratio does not fall (where the ratio is not lower, the rule read is not lower, whatever the rule at that time).

clauses.zh: 凡偏向之规之下择不降率，所读之规随率不降：其一，始之规偏向，凡所读之规皆偏向，则率无一步降，每一时稽之步之后皆胶（规偏向，且率所读之规不下于此规）。
clauses.en: If under every rule that tilts toward the carriers selection does not lower the ratio, and the rule read does not fall as the ratio does not fall: first, if the starting rule tilts toward the carriers and every rule read tilts toward them, then the ratio falls at no step, and after every reading step the run is locked (the rule tilts toward the carriers, and the rule the ratio reads is not below this rule).

clauses.zh: 其二，凡不下于一偏向之规者亦偏向，则胶之状此后每步皆胶，率与规皆不降；
clauses.en: Second, if every rule not below a rule that tilts toward the carriers also tilts toward them, then from a locked configuration the run is locked at every step after, and neither the ratio nor the rule falls;

clauses.zh: 自胶之状换规为任一仍偏向之规，于每一时稽之步之后，规不下于未换者而复胶。
