clauses.en: if from a locked configuration the rule is replaced by any rule that still tilts toward the carriers, then after every reading step the rule is not below that of the run without the replacement, and the run is locked again.

clauses.zh: 其三，凡所读之规皆偏向，则每程不论其始，自第二个时稽之步之后胶；
clauses.en: Third, if every rule read tilts toward the carriers, then every path, whatever its start, is locked from after the second reading step on;

clauses.zh: 此界确切。
clauses.en: this bound is exact.

clauses.zh: 劫及其读，规之读亦由率而成也。
clauses.en: Closed capture is where the reading of the rule is itself made by the ratio.

clauses.zh: 凡快层之状为率与率外之对，而次率与所读之规皆不读率外：率与规同始之二历程，每步率与规皆同，不论率外何如。
clauses.en: Wherever the configuration of the fast layer is a pair of the ratio and what lies beyond the ratio, and neither the next ratio nor the rule read reads what lies beyond the ratio: any two histories whose ratio and rule start the same have the same ratio and the same rule at every step, whatever lies beyond the ratio.

clauses.zh: 更有率外每步至少增一，在十一·二十三其二之条件下自一胶之状起：至第 t 步，率外不少于其始加 t，而程每步皆胶，率与规皆不下于其始。
clauses.en: If further what lies beyond the ratio grows by at least one at every step, and the run starts from a locked configuration under the condition of the second part of 11.23: then at step t what lies beyond the ratio is no less than its start plus t, while the path is locked at every step and neither the ratio nor the rule is below its start.

clauses.zh: 凡规之读于时稽之步由率而成（随率不降），规由此读与率读出（随二者不降）：规连其读为一规，读于率；
clauses.en: Wherever the reading of the rule at reading steps is made by the ratio (not falling as the ratio does not fall), and the rule is read off from this reading and the ratio (not falling as the two do not fall): the rule together with its reading is one rule, read from the ratio;

clauses.zh: 在十一·二十三其二之条件下胶，则率、规、读皆不降；
clauses.en: if it is locked under the condition of the second part of 11.23, then none of the ratio, the rule and the reading falls;

clauses.zh: 自胶之状换规为任一仍偏向之规、换读为任一读（或上或下），于每一时稽之步之后，规与读皆不下于未换者而复胶；
clauses.en: if from a locked configuration the rule is replaced by any rule that still tilts toward the carriers and the reading by any reading (higher or lower), then after every reading step neither the rule nor the reading is below that of the run without the replacement, and the run is locked again;

clauses.zh: 所读之规于每一读、每一率皆偏向，则每程不论其始，自第二个时稽之步之后胶。
clauses.en: if the rule read tilts toward the carriers at every reading and every ratio, then every path, whatever its start, is locked from after the second reading step on.

clauses.zh: 讀（AI，D26、D45）：明，择所接之感，及于容所不标者也。
clauses.en: Reading (AI, D26, D45): coupling beyond support is the couplings joined to a selection reaching what admission does not mark.

clauses.zh: 其途三：所待以积感入，所许之历，他者之感合用。
clauses.en: Its routes are three: a condition coupling in by its level, admitted histories, and the couplings of others used together.

title: 明之三途
title_en: The three routes of coupling beyond support

clauses.zh: 明之途：其一，所待以积感入：所待之同异定然否，凡一所待以积感入一待者，于每步加此所待之积以同一正量，则于每一步，原网与所加之网之积缘此待者之感有异。
clauses.en: The routes of coupling beyond support: first, a condition coupling in by its level: where the sameness or difference of conditions is decided, for every condition that couples into a formation by its level, if the level of this condition is raised at every step by one and the same positive amount, then at every step the levels of the original web and of the raised web are not alike through this formation's couplings.

clauses.zh: 其二，所许之历，其验与其误见九·十四。
clauses.en: Second, admitted histories: for their testing and their error, see 9.14.

clauses.zh: 其三，他者之感合用，其律见十一·二十七至十一·三十一。
clauses.en: Third, the couplings of others used together: for its laws, see 11.27 to 11.31.

clauses.zh: 兼感，一域诸员之感合用也。
clauses.en: Pooled coupling is the couplings of the members of a region used together.

clauses.zh: 缘兼感而择，凡二历缘每一员之感至某步皆无异者，择之同也。
clauses.en: Selection through pooled coupling is a selection that is the same on any two histories that are alike through each member's couplings up to a given step.

clauses.zh: 和而不同，兼感之所增也；
clauses.en: What pooling adds is what pooled coupling adds;

clauses.zh: 同而不和，兼感等于一员之感也。
clauses.en: pooled as one member is pooled coupling equal to the couplings of one member.

clauses.zh: 二历，凡缘兼感至某步之择皆择之同，恰当缘每员之感皆无异；
clauses.en: Every selection through pooled coupling up to a step is the same on two histories exactly where the two are alike through every member's couplings;

clauses.zh: 有缘兼感之择于此然于彼不然，恰当诸员不皆无异。
clauses.en: some selection through pooled coupling holds of the one and does not hold of the other exactly where not every member finds them alike.

clauses.zh: 一员缘其感分之者，有缘其感之择亦为缘兼感之择而分之。
clauses.en: Where one member separates them through its couplings, some selection through its couplings is also a selection through pooled coupling and separates them.

clauses.zh: 诸员有一族尽之，各员之无异定然否，则兼感分之恰当有一员分之。
clauses.en: If a family lists all the members and each member's being alike is decided, then pooled coupling separates them exactly where some member separates them.

clauses.zh: 兼感之择恰为一员之择，恰当凡此员缘感无异者诸员皆无异（同而不和）；
clauses.en: The selections through pooled coupling are exactly the selections through one member's couplings exactly where every two histories alike through this member's couplings are alike through every member's (pooled as one member);

clauses.zh: 此员无异而诸员不皆无异，则有兼感之择非缘此员之感（和而不同）。
clauses.en: if two histories are alike through this member's couplings and not alike through every member's, then some selection through pooled coupling is not a selection through this member's couplings (what pooling adds).

title: 兼感之域，读他者之感
title_en: The coupling closure of a region; reading another's couplings

clauses.zh: 一域之感域，诸员感域之并也。
clauses.en: The coupling closure of a region is the union of the coupling closures of its members.

clauses.zh: 凡此域之感域中者所感之所待每步皆衡，体之诸员皆在此域之感域外：则凡诸员皆在此域之感域中之任一域（此域在内），缘其兼感之择，于积之历与偏去此体之积之历择之同。
clauses.en: Wherever every condition coupled into by what lies in this region's coupling closure balances at every step, and every member of the part lies outside this region's coupling closure: then for any region whose members all lie in this region's coupling closure (this region included), every selection through its pooled coupling is the same on the history of levels and on the history of levels with this part withheld.

clauses.zh: 一待者另以积感入他者所感（以阈或以积）之一切所待，谓读他者之感：凡缘二者兼感之择，皆缘读者如是之感之择；
clauses.en: Reading another's couplings is a formation coupled in addition, by level, into every condition the other is coupled into (by threshold or by level): every selection through the pooled coupling of the two is a selection through the couplings of the formation that reads so;

clauses.zh: 他者于感入之之一所待有取与，则读者如是之感域，恰为二者所成之域之感域。
clauses.en: if the other has taking and giving at some condition that couples into it, then the coupling closure of the formation that reads so is exactly the coupling closure of the region the two form.

clauses.zh: 凡余者于二流皆循一缘感而读之取与之法，二流皆衡，在场者同，始积同，体于一域每员缘二流所成之感域内动之无异：则凡诸员皆在此域缘二流之感域中之任一域（体即此域亦然），缘其兼感之择于二流之积之历择之同；
clauses.en: If in two flows the others all follow one law of taking and giving that reads through couplings, both flows balance, what takes part is the same, the starting levels are the same, and the part's moves are alike within the coupling closure that each member of a region has through the two flows: then for any region whose members all lie in this region's coupling closure through the two flows (also where the part is this region), every selection through its pooled coupling is the same on the level histories of the two flows;

clauses.zh: 凡缘其感至某步分开二流之待者，皆在此域之感域外。
clauses.en: every formation that separates the two flows through its couplings up to some step lies outside this region's coupling closure.

clauses.zh: 动改一待者某步之容，则此待者在此域之感域外；
clauses.en: If a move changes a formation's admission at some step, then this formation lies outside this region's coupling closure;

clauses.zh: 其于此步之容，为凡含此待者之域自此步起缘兼感之择，而非诸员皆在此域之感域中之任一域于任何步之择。
clauses.en: its admission at this step is a selection through pooled coupling, from this step on, of every region that contains this formation, and is not a selection, at any step, of any region whose members all lie in this region's coupling closure.

clauses.zh: 凡后流之积之历广于前流者，则有一待者，于某步为后流之积所容而不为前流之积所容，其容亦如是。
clauses.en: Wherever the level history of the later flow widens that of the earlier flow, there is a formation admitted at some step by the later flow's levels and not by the earlier flow's, and its admission is likewise so.

clauses.zh: 凡取与之法于体外之每一待者缘其感而读，一域诸员皆在体外：缘此域诸员之动（依此法）之择，皆缘兼感之择；
clauses.en: Wherever a law of taking and giving reads, for every formation outside the part, through its couplings, and the members of a region all lie outside the part: every selection through the moves of this region's members (under this law) is a selection through pooled coupling;

clauses.zh: 诸员有一族尽之，各员之无异定然否，此域之动分开二历，则有一员缘其感分之。
clauses.en: if a family lists all the members, each member's being alike is decided, and the moves of this region separate two histories, then some member separates them through its couplings.

clauses.zh: 凡各待者于各步、各历与一历缘感无异否皆定然否，有一所待，诸员皆在体外：跨一步，凡缘感而读之法下诸员于每一所待取与皆无异，恰当诸员缘感至此步皆无异。
clauses.en: Wherever, for each formation, each step and each history, being alike through couplings with a given history is decided, there is some condition, and the members all lie outside the part: across a step, the members' taking and giving at every condition is alike under every law that reads through couplings, exactly where the members are alike through couplings up to this step.

clauses.zh: 在十一·三十之条件下，此域之感域中、体外之每一待者，于二流每步每所待取与无异。
clauses.en: Under the conditions of 11.30, every formation in this region's coupling closure and outside the part takes and gives alike in the two flows at every step and every condition.

clauses.zh: 此域有一员在体之应域中，恰当体有一员在此域缘二流之感域中。
clauses.en: Some member of this region lies in the part's responsive reach exactly where some member of the part lies in this region's coupling closure through the two flows.

clauses.zh: 应倍，一取与随一所待之积而异，其所取所与之差不过此积之差若干倍也。
clauses.en: Coupling strength is the multiple by which, as a taking and giving varies with a condition's level, the gap in what it takes and gives is bounded by the gap in this level.

clauses.zh: 可致，携带之法依诸应倍、起始之差与体之差逐步所给出之积之历也。
clauses.en: The carried amount is the level history that the law of carrying gives, step by step, from the coupling strengths, the starting gap and the part's gap.

clauses.zh: 凡有一族尽诸所待而各一：凡唯读既立者之法与此法之二流，二流皆衡而在场者同，体外之物从此法而其应倍不过 k，体之所为相差不过 σ，起始之积相差不过 δ：凡如此者，一所待于一步之差皆不过 a，恰当其可致不过 a。
clauses.en: Wherever a family lists every condition, each once: for every law that reads only what is already fixed and any two flows under this law, where both flows balance, what takes part is the same, the relata outside the part follow this law with coupling strength at most k, what the part does differs by at most σ, and the starting levels differ by at most δ: for all such, the gap at a condition at a step is at most a, exactly where its carried amount is at most a.

clauses.zh: 可致为正，恰当有一依步之路，由起始之差、体之差与正应倍而至之。
clauses.en: The carried amount is positive exactly where there is a path along the steps that reaches it from the starting gap, the part's gap and positive coupling strengths.

clauses.zh: 环，感之链自一所待而回至此所待也。
clauses.en: A loop is a chain of couplings from a condition back to this condition.

clauses.zh: 凡诸感步步皆在：自每一起始之差，有一阶于每步在 c 皆等于可致，恰当 c 之上游无所待在环上。
clauses.en: Wherever every coupling is present at every step: from every starting gap, some expansion order equals the carried amount at c at every step, exactly where no condition upstream of c lies on a loop.

clauses.zh: 成环，一步之感接一链之首尾而环始有也。
clauses.en: Closing is where the coupling of a step joins the head and the tail of a chain, and a loop first exists.

clauses.zh: 凡环，皆至某步而成。
clauses.en: Every loop comes to be by some step.

clauses.zh: 凡至 T+1 步所成之环：或至 T 步既成，或经一于 T 步作用之感，其感读 d 之积而与 c 取与，自 c 有链至环上之所待，自此所待有链至 d。
clauses.en: Every loop formed by step T+1 either was already formed by step T or passes through a coupling acting at step T that reads the level of d and has taking and giving with c, with a chain from c to a condition on the loop and a chain from this condition to d.

clauses.zh: 一取与始应其所与之所待之积，则成一所待之环。
clauses.en: When a taking and giving first responds to the level of the condition it gives to, a loop of one condition is formed.

title: 环在所读之内，其成不可先见
title_en: Loops lie within what is read, and their forming cannot be seen in advance

clauses.zh: 凡体外无物于任一步读 c 之积，则限于所读之感无环经 c，c 之下游唯 c。
clauses.en: If no relatum outside the part reads the level of c at any step, then among the couplings restricted to what is read no loop passes through c, and downstream of c there is only c.

clauses.zh: 凡有一族尽诸所待，体起后不再与差，起始之差不过 D，每步入每一所待之应倍之和不过 M，至 T 步所成之环皆不在 c 之上游：则至 T 每步 c 之可致不过 D 乘步数之一多项式，其次数为所待之数减一，不论其后诸感如何。
clauses.en: Wherever a family lists every condition, the part gives no further gap after the start, the starting gap is at most D, the sum of the coupling strengths into each condition at each step is at most M, and no loop formed by step T is upstream of c: then at every step up to T the carried amount at c is at most D times a polynomial in the number of steps, of degree the number of conditions less one, whatever the couplings after.

clauses.zh: 有一所待之自环成于 T 步：至 T 每步其可致皆为起始之差，此后每步倍之；
clauses.en: There is a loop of a condition on itself formed at step T: at every step up to T its carried amount is the starting gap, and at every step after it doubles;

clauses.zh: 成于 T 后任一步之自环，至 T 每步之可致与之相等。
clauses.en: a loop of the condition on itself formed at any step after T gives, at every step up to T, a carried amount equal to it.

clauses.zh: 盈科，升至一阈而后成一新之感也。
clauses.en: The filling threshold is where a level rises to a threshold and then a new coupling forms.

title: 不已与所失
title_en: Coupling recurs, and what a cut loses

clauses.zh: 不已，d 之积感入 c，屡有之也。
clauses.en: A coupling recurs where the level of d coupling into c recurs.

clauses.zh: 所失，可致截于一阶所未计者也。
clauses.en: What a cut loses is what the carried amount, cut at an expansion order, leaves uncounted.

clauses.zh: 凡截于 j 阶，可致等于 j 阶，加自可致本身依次经 j+1 次应所携者：所失即后一项，不论应倍逐步如何，皆然。
clauses.en: For every cut at expansion order j, the carried amount equals the amount at order j plus what is carried from the carried amount itself through j+1 responses in turn: what the cut loses is the latter term, however the coupling strengths go step by step.

clauses.zh: 凡差既至一环，环上之感皆不已，又有不已之感之链自环至 c：则每一阶皆于某步在 c 有所失。
clauses.en: If the gap has reached a loop, every coupling on the loop recurs, and there is a chain of recurring couplings from the loop to c: then a cut at every expansion order loses something at c at some step.

clauses.zh: 凡无感读 N 步及其后之积，则 N 阶于每步、每所待、自每一起始之差皆无所失。
clauses.en: If no coupling reads the levels of step N and after, then a cut at expansion order N loses nothing, at every step, at every condition and from every starting gap.

clauses.zh: 诸阶之可致，即沿步回溯之诸路之和：至一步，长 j+1 之诸路之和即 j 阶之可致；
clauses.en: The carried amount of the expansion orders is the sum over the paths traced back along the steps: up to a step, the sum over the paths of length j+1 is the carried amount of order j;

clauses.zh: 截于一阶，即截此和。
clauses.en: a cut at an expansion order is a cut of this sum.

clauses.zh: 滋，可致随步而长，过每一多项式也。
clauses.en: Runaway is the carried amount growing with the steps beyond every polynomial.

clauses.zh: 凡应倍每步皆同而只读本步之积，每步在场者同，有一族尽诸所待，体起后不再与差：c 之可致自每一起始之差皆为一多项式所界，恰当 c 之上游无环；
clauses.en: Wherever the coupling strengths are the same at every step and read only the levels of the present step, what takes part is the same at every step, a family lists every condition, and the part gives no further gap after the start: the carried amount at c is bounded by a polynomial from every starting gap exactly where there is no loop upstream of c;

clauses.zh: 环上应倍皆正者，环上一所待之可致每绕一匝至少倍之。
clauses.en: where the coupling strengths on a loop are all positive, the carried amount at a condition on the loop at least doubles with every loop turn.

clauses.zh: 凡体起后不再与差，起始之差不过 D，每步入每一所待之应倍之和不过 M，读 N 步及其后之积之感无环在 c 之上游：则不论应倍逐步如何，c 之可致为一多项式所界。
clauses.en: If the part gives no further gap after the start, the starting gap is at most D, the sum of the coupling strengths into each condition at each step is at most M, and the couplings that read the levels of step N and after have no loop upstream of c: then, however the coupling strengths go step by step, the carried amount at c is bounded by a polynomial.

clauses.zh: 频数，感作用之步数也。
clauses.en: Frequency is the number of steps at which a coupling acts.

clauses.zh: 凡体起后不再与差，起始之差不过 D，每步入每一所待之应倍之和不过 M，入每一所待之应倍之和于未标之步为零：则第 t 步之可致不过 D 乘 1+M 之 a 次方，a 为 t 前所标之步数。
clauses.en: If the part gives no further gap after the start, the starting gap is at most D, the sum of the coupling strengths into each condition at each step is at most M, and the sum of the coupling strengths into each condition is zero at unmarked steps: then the carried amount at step t is at most D times 1+M to the power a, where a is the number of marked steps before t.

clauses.zh: 凡差既至 e，又自 e 经依步之链回至 e，此一返之后，e 之可致至少为返前之二倍。
clauses.en: If the gap has reached e and comes back from e to e through a chain along the steps, then after this round trip the carried amount at e is at least twice what it was before the round trip.

clauses.zh: 凡 e 之可致于某步为正，此后一返接一返：若对每一多项式，有某 i，二之 i 次方过此多项式于第 i 返之步之值，则 e 之可致滋。
clauses.en: If the carried amount at e is positive at some step and round trips follow one another after it: if for every polynomial there is some i such that 2 to the power i exceeds the value of this polynomial at the step of the i-th round trip, then the carried amount at e runs away.

clauses.zh: 有不已之环而不滋者。
clauses.en: There is a loop whose coupling recurs and that does not run away.

clauses.zh: 报，诸环节依次所为之合也：送一差入首环节，每环节以所受交于次环节，末环节交回者即是。
clauses.en: The return map is the composition of what the loop links do in turn: a gap is sent into the first loop link, each loop link hands what it receives on to the next, and what the last loop link hands back is the return map.

clauses.zh: 凡诸环节所交皆不少于所受，则差每匝皆不小于其初；
clauses.en: If every loop link hands on no less than it receives, then the gap at every loop turn is no smaller than at the start;

clauses.zh: 差有一匝小于其初，则有一环节于某差所交少于所受。
clauses.en: if the gap at some loop turn is smaller than at the start, then some loop link hands on, at some gap, less than it receives.

clauses.zh: 凡报于零为零，于每一正差小于之，则差 d 至第 d 匝为零，此后每匝皆零；
clauses.en: If the return map is zero at zero and less than every positive gap at that gap, then a gap d is zero by the d-th loop turn and zero at every loop turn after;

clauses.zh: 此界确切。
clauses.en: this bound is exact.

clauses.zh: 凡诸环节各如数交出，则差每匝皆如其初。
clauses.en: If every loop link hands on exactly what it receives, then the gap at every loop turn is as at the start.

clauses.zh: 凡环有环节而诸环节所交皆至少倍其所受，则 n 匝之后，差至少为其初之二之 n 次方倍，自正差起过每一界。
clauses.en: If a loop has loop links and every loop link hands on at least twice what it receives, then after n loop turns the gap is at least 2 to the power n times its start, and from a positive gap it passes every bound.

clauses.zh: 凡环之诸环节皆以整数倍乘之：诸倍相乘为零，则自首匝起差每匝皆为零；
clauses.en: Wherever every loop link of a loop multiplies by a whole-number factor: if the product of the factors is zero, then from the first loop turn on the gap is zero at every loop turn;

clauses.zh: 为一，则差每匝皆如其初；
clauses.en: if it is one, then the gap at every loop turn is as at the start;

clauses.zh: 不小于二，则自正差起过每一界。
clauses.en: if it is no less than two, then from a positive gap the gap passes every bound.

clauses.zh: 故每匝之差，或为零，或不小于前匝；
clauses.en: So the gap at every loop turn is either zero or no smaller than at the loop turn before;

clauses.zh: 某匝之差为正而少于前匝者（渐闭），其环有一环节不是乘。
clauses.en: where the gap at some loop turn is positive and less than at the loop turn before (falling gradually), the loop has a loop link that is not a multiplication.

clauses.zh: 凡一环节交回为零，其后诸环节无所受则无所交，则自首匝之后差每匝皆为零，不论其前诸环节。
clauses.en: If a loop link hands back zero and the loop links after it hand on nothing when they receive nothing, then after the first loop turn the gap is zero at every loop turn, whatever the loop links before it.

clauses.zh: 其后有环节无所受而有所交，差可再为正：有一环，交回为零之环节之后接一加一之环节，首匝之后差每匝皆为一，不论其初。
clauses.en: If a loop link after it hands on something when it receives nothing, the gap can be positive again: there is a loop in which the loop link handing back zero is followed by a loop link that adds one, and after the first loop turn the gap is one at every loop turn, whatever its start.

clauses.zh: 还，二历程于一所待之差，每步之后皆为其前之差之报也。
clauses.en: Feedback is where the gap between two histories at a condition is, after every step, the return map of the gap before it.

clauses.zh: 凡二流于 c 每步皆衡：其取与自 s 步起以 f 应其差，恰当 s 后每步之差为其前之差之 f；
clauses.en: Wherever two flows balance at c at every step: their taking and giving responds to their gap by f from step s on, exactly where the gap at every step after s is f of the gap before it;

clauses.zh: 如此，则 s+n 步之差，为 f 自 s 步之差行 n 匝之后之值，一匝一步。
clauses.en: so the gap at step s+n is the value of f after n loop turns run from the gap at step s, one loop turn per step.

clauses.zh: 穷，c 之积降于阈下、法自不读之转为读之之处也。
clauses.en: The break is where the level of c falls below the threshold and the law turns from not reading it to reading it.

clauses.zh: 凡法唯于阈下读 c：二流皆衡而在场者同，体之所为同，体外从此法，起始唯 c 异而后者多 d，前者之 c 于 T 前每步皆不下于其阈：则至 T，c 外诸所待之积二流皆相等，后者之 c 每步皆多 d。
clauses.en: Wherever the law reads c only below the threshold: if both flows balance and what takes part is the same, what the part does is the same, what lies outside the part follows this law, the start differs only at c with the latter higher by d, and c in the former is not below its threshold at any step before T: then up to T the levels of every condition other than c are equal in the two flows, and c in the latter is higher by d at every step.

clauses.zh: 若法又唯读既立者，所标者唯 c：于 c 至此每步皆不下于阈之步，法之所给同其未穷之法（读 c 于阈下之处如在其阈之法）；
clauses.en: If the law also reads only what is already fixed, and c is the only one marked: at a step up to which c is not below the threshold at any step, what the law gives is the same as its pre-break law (the law that reads c, where it is below the threshold, as if it were at its threshold);

clauses.zh: 未穷之法于 c 之应倍为零，限于所读之感无环经 c，c 之下游唯 c。
clauses.en: the pre-break law has coupling strength zero at c; among the couplings restricted to what is read no loop passes through c, and downstream of c there is only c.

clauses.zh: 未兆，穷之前所感者不界其远近也。
clauses.en: Unread before the break is where what is coupled into before the break does not bound how near or far the break is.

clauses.zh: 凡 c 不以积感入待者 g，诸所待之同异定然否：于任一步 u，若至 u 每步 g 于 c 外之每一待皆足，则有一待网，唯 c 之积每步皆加同一数，至 u 每步皆容 g，且于原网容 g 之每步，二网之积缘 g 之感无异。
clauses.en: Wherever c does not couple into formation g by its level, and the sameness or difference of conditions is decided: for any step u, if at every step up to u every dependence of g other than at c is met, then there is a web, differing only in that the level of c is raised by one and the same number at every step, that admits g at every step up to u, and at every step at which the original web admits g the levels of the two webs are alike through g's couplings.

clauses.zh: 凡诸待者之同异定然否，g 之取与经其感，他者于 g 所感之所待之取与二流皆同，二流在场者同，g 所感之诸所待二流皆衡，起始 g 所感者后者不少、以积感入 g 者二流相等：若 g 所感之一所待其差至某步有改，则非此前每步原网皆容 g。
clauses.en: Wherever the sameness or difference of formations is decided, g's taking and giving goes through its couplings, the others' taking and giving at the conditions coupling into g is the same in both flows, what takes part is the same in both flows, every condition coupling into g balances in both flows, and at the start what couples into g is no less in the latter and what couples into g by its level is equal in the two flows: if the gap at some condition coupling into g changes by some step, then it is not the case that the original web admits g at every step before.

clauses.zh: 中节，于一步，c 上之共取与，共取多于共与者不过积过 m 之数，共与多于共取者不过积不及 m 之数也。
clauses.en: Without overshoot is where, at a step, in the joint taking and giving at c, the joint taking exceeds the joint giving by no more than the level exceeds m, and the joint giving exceeds the joint taking by no more than the level falls short of m.

clauses.zh: 凡流于 c 衡于一步：中节，恰当次步之积在 m 与本步之积之间（与本步同侧，不更远）。
clauses.en: Wherever a flow balances at c at a step: it is without overshoot exactly where the level at the next step lies between m and the level at this step (on the same side as this step, not farther).

clauses.zh: 凡流于 c 衡而 n 步皆中节，则 n 步后之积在 m 与起始之积之间。
clauses.en: If a flow balances at c and is without overshoot for n steps, then the level after n steps lies between m and the starting level.

clauses.zh: 中和，c 上之共取与于 m 之两侧皆反其离而中节也：在 m 上则共取多于共与，在 m 下则共与多于共取。
clauses.en: Two-sided regulation is where the joint taking and giving at c opposes the departure on both sides of m and is without overshoot: above m the joint taking exceeds the joint giving, and below m the joint giving exceeds the joint taking.

clauses.zh: 凡流衡，自 T 起每步于 m 中和：则积不在 m 之步，其与 m 之差至少减一；
clauses.en: If a flow balances and is in two-sided regulation at m at every step from T on: then at a step at which the level is not at m, its gap from m falls by at least one;

clauses.zh: n 步后之差不过初差减 n；
clauses.en: the gap after n steps is at most the first gap less n;

clauses.zh: 至 T 加初差之步，积即 m，此后每步皆 m。
clauses.en: by the step T plus the first gap the level is m, and it is m at every step after.

clauses.zh: 自 m 下起者，至 T 加其不及 m 之数之步即 m 而不移。
clauses.en: Starting below m, it is at m by the step T plus the amount by which it falls short of m, and does not move from it.

clauses.zh: 过正，相反之共取与出其积与 m 之差也。
clauses.en: Overshoot is an opposing joint taking and giving that exceeds the gap between its level and m.

clauses.zh: 凡流于 c 衡于一步，共取与反其离而不中节：积在 m 上，则次步之积在 m 下；
clauses.en: If a flow balances at c at a step, and the joint taking and giving opposes the departure and is not without overshoot: if the level is above m, then the level at the next step is below m;

clauses.zh: 在 m 下，则次步之积在 m 上。
clauses.en: if it is below m, then the level at the next step is above m.

clauses.zh: 有一流，每步皆衡、两侧皆反其离而每步过正，偶步在 m 上，奇步在 m 下，永不至 m。
clauses.en: There is a flow that balances at every step, opposes the departure on both sides and overshoots at every step, is above m at even steps and below m at odd steps, and never reaches m.

clauses.zh: 一偏，唯于一侧应之也。
clauses.en: One-sided response is responding on one side only.

clauses.zh: 有一流，守升至 m 之律之前提，每步中节，在 m 上而不相反，每步皆在 m 上：一偏不是中和。
clauses.en: There is a flow that satisfies the premise of the law of rising to m, is without overshoot at every step, is above m without opposing, and is above m at every step: one-sided response is not two-sided regulation.

clauses.zh: 识不早，应式迟 ℓ 步而读也：其于一步之所与所取，唯定于其余 ℓ+1 步以前之所为。
clauses.en: Reading late is a response function reading ℓ steps late: what it gives and takes at a step is fixed only by what the rest of the whole did ℓ+1 steps or more before.

clauses.zh: 凡应式迟 ℓ 步而读，自一起状，于每步移积不过 d 之一切其余，其积之历每步皆在 a 与 b 之间，0<a：则 a 加 2(ℓ+1)d 不过 b。
clauses.en: If a response function reads ℓ steps late and, from a starting configuration, for every rest of the whole that moves the level by at most d at each step, its level history lies between a and b at every step, with 0<a: then a plus 2(ℓ+1)d is at most b.

clauses.zh: 有应式，每步抵其余 ℓ+1 步前之所移，前 ℓ+1 步不取不与：它迟 ℓ 步而读，自不下于 (ℓ+1)d 之起状，于如此之一切其余，其积之历每步皆在起状上下 (ℓ+1)d 之内：此域之宽确切。
clauses.en: There is a response function that at each step offsets what the rest of the whole moved ℓ+1 steps before, and neither takes nor gives in the first ℓ+1 steps: it reads ℓ steps late, and from a starting configuration not below (ℓ+1)d, for every such rest of the whole, its level history lies at every step within (ℓ+1)d above or below the starting configuration: the width of this region is exact.

clauses.zh: 抑举，读其积在 a 下则与 M，在 b 上则取 M，在 a、b 之间则不取不与也。
clauses.en: The relay is: reading its level, it gives M where the level is below a, takes M where it is above b, and neither takes nor gives where it is between a and b.

clauses.zh: 凡 a 不过 b，0<a，0<M，(ℓ+1)M 不过 b+1：c 上之共取与唯是迟 ℓ 步之抑举、每步皆衡之流，自前 ℓ+1 步积皆为 a 下同一数之任一起状，皆自某步起每步皆在 a 与 b 之间，恰当 a+(ℓ+1)M 不过 b+1。
clauses.en: Wherever a is at most b, 0<a, 0<M, and (ℓ+1)M is at most b+1: every flow whose joint taking and giving at c is only the relay reading ℓ steps late and that balances at every step, from any starting configuration whose level in the first ℓ+1 steps is one and the same number below a, lies between a and b at every step from some step on, exactly where a+(ℓ+1)M is at most b+1.

clauses.zh: 所出：g 跨一步在场而与 x，x 跨此步而聚，则 x 出于 g，g 为 x 之所出。
clauses.en: Descent: where g takes part across a step and gives to x, and x comes to stand across this step, x descends from g, and g is what x descends from.

clauses.zh: 凡物跨一步而聚，于其物跨此步衡，则有其于此步之所出。
clauses.en: If a relatum comes to stand across a step and balances across this step, then there is something it descends from at this step.

clauses.zh: 凡流衡、唯运者与之，一有形之物跨一步而作，则有一他物于其步运而为其所出。
clauses.en: If a flow balances and only the active give, and an embodied relatum arises across a step, then there is another relatum that is active at that step and is what it descends from.

clauses.zh: 有流与待网焉，其中一物有所出，而其作在聚之后步，作时无所与；
clauses.en: There are a flow and a web in which a relatum descends from something, its arising is at a step after its coming to stand, and nothing is given to it when it arises;

clauses.zh: 有流与待网焉，不息而无一物有所出。
clauses.en: there are a flow and a web that are unceasing and in which no relatum descends from anything.

clauses.zh: 因，x 出于 g 之步，x 跨步后所待，g 于与之步亦待之也。
clauses.en: Inheritance is where, at the step at which x descends from g, what x depends on after the step g also depends on at the step of giving.

clauses.zh: 因含二者：x 跨此步新结之待，与 x 先已待、跨步仍待者。
clauses.en: Inheritance covers two: the dependences x newly forms across this step, and those x already had that it still has after the step.

clauses.zh: x 于与之步不待 c，则 x 于 c 有因，恰当 x 跨此步结 c 之待则 g 于与之步待 c。
clauses.en: If x does not depend on c at the step of giving, then x has inheritance at c exactly where, if x forms a dependence on c across this step, g depends on c at the step of giving.

clauses.zh: 凡物跨一步而聚，于其物跨此步衡，而其于此步之诸所出于 c 皆有因：则其跨步后待 c，必有一所出于与之步亦待 c；
clauses.en: If a relatum comes to stand across a step, balances across this step, and has inheritance at c from everything it descends from at this step: then, if it depends on c after the step, something it descends from also depends on c at the step of giving;

clauses.zh: 此步在场者莫待 c，则其跨步后不待 c。
clauses.en: if nothing taking part at this step depends on c, then it does not depend on c after the step.

clauses.zh: 传，因而需有界也：于一所待 c 与一界 δ，凡 x 出于 g、x 跨步后待 c，则 g 于与之步待 c，且 x 待 c 之需不过 g 待 c 之需加 δ。
clauses.en: Transmission is inheritance with a bound on need: for a condition c and a bound δ, wherever x descends from g and x depends on c after the step, g depends on c at the step of giving, and the need of x on c is at most the need of g on c plus δ.

clauses.zh: 传恰是因与需之界二者并。
clauses.en: Transmission is exactly inheritance and the bound on need together.

clauses.zh: 流衡，则传推出自某所出之传：凡聚而待 c 者，有一所出于与之步待 c，且其需不过该所出之需加 δ。
clauses.en: If the flow balances, then transmission implies transmission from some giver: everything that comes to stand and depends on c has something it descends from that depends on c at the step of giving, with its need at most that one's need plus δ.

clauses.zh: 后者严弱于传：有流与待网焉，衡、唯运者与之、有待，自某所出之传成立，而传于任何 δ 皆不成立。
clauses.en: The latter is strictly weaker than transmission: there are a flow and a web that balance, in which only the active give, that are dependent, where transmission from some giver holds and transmission holds for no δ.

clauses.zh: 凡宇有待、衡、唯运者与之、唯运者取且唯取于其所资、耗、有形、有列（传以外之七设），而其中有出者跨步后有所待，则去其一所出于与之步之一待，所得之宇具此七设而传不成立。
clauses.en: If a world is dependent, balances, has only the active giving, has only the active taking and taking only from what they draw from, dissipates, is embodied, and has a census (the seven suppositions other than transmission), and some offspring in it depends on something after its step, then removing one dependence, at the step of giving, of something it descends from yields a world that has these seven suppositions and in which transmission does not hold.

clauses.zh: 凡宇之条件，去一待而不改、且推出传者，凡具此条件之宇，皆无出者跨步后有所待。
clauses.en: For every property of worlds that does not change when one dependence is removed and that implies transmission, no world with this property has an offspring that depends on something after its step.

clauses.zh: 读出者初聚所待，唯其诸所出于与之步所资者，加资则待，则推出因；
clauses.en: The reading that what an offspring depends on when it first comes to stand is only what the things it descends from draw from at the step of giving, together with drawing implying dependence, implies inheritance;

clauses.zh: 有穷之宇具此七设者，二者缺一皆不足以推出因。
clauses.en: for finite worlds with these seven suppositions, with either of the two missing, inheritance does not follow.

clauses.zh: 凡有穷之宇衡、耗、有形、有待，传恰当诸所待皆有因。
clauses.en: For every finite world that balances, dissipates, is embodied and is dependent, transmission holds exactly where there is inheritance at every condition.

title: 八设互不相出
title_en: The eight suppositions do not follow from one another

clauses.zh: 宇之八设：有待（二·五）、衡（一·十五）、唯运者与之、唯运者取且唯取于其所资（一·十六）、耗（四·四）、有形（二·十一）、有列（三·六）、传（十三·三）。
clauses.en: The eight suppositions of a world: dependent (2.5), balance (1.15), only the active give, only the active take and take only from what they draw from (1.16), dissipation (4.4), embodied (2.11), census (3.6), transmission (13.3).

clauses.zh: 前六设与蓄（二·十），每设皆有宇合之、有宇不合之；
clauses.en: For the first six suppositions and for reserve (2.10), each has a world that satisfies it and a world that does not;

clauses.zh: 八设互不相出：每设皆有一宇合他七设而不合之。
clauses.en: the eight suppositions do not follow from one another: for each supposition there is a world that satisfies the other seven and not it.

clauses.zh: 读于一取与之法所生之程而计其余，前四设皆然（一·十七、二·五）。
clauses.en: The world read off the path that a law of taking and giving produces, with the rest of the whole counted, has all of the first four suppositions (1.17, 2.5).

clauses.zh: 凡宇计其余：每步在场者之族之员各异、每步为所给之一族所封，则有列；
clauses.en: For every world with the rest of the whole counted: if the members of the family taking part at each step are distinct and each step is closed on a given family, then it has a census;

clauses.zh: 计其余之宇有形，恰当原宇自衡而每物恰于其积为正之步取与。
clauses.en: the world with the rest of the whole counted is embodied exactly where the original world balances and each relatum takes and gives exactly at the steps at which its level is positive.

clauses.zh: 读自一唯读既立者之法而计其余，其余永不运，恰当其程可行。
clauses.en: For a world read off a law that reads only what is already fixed, with the rest of the whole counted, the rest of the whole is never active exactly where its path is feasible.

clauses.zh: 耗、有形、传为取与之法之状：读自取与之法、计其余、其余永不运而前四设皆然之宇，于此三设各有合之者、有不合之者。
clauses.en: Dissipation, embodiment and transmission are properties of the law of taking and giving: among worlds read off a law of taking and giving, with the rest of the whole counted, the rest of the whole never active, and the first four suppositions all holding, for each of these three suppositions some satisfy it and some do not.

clauses.zh: 传择，唯见容者有出于之者，而于界内所传之需于界内被选出也。
clauses.en: Evolution is where only what is admitted has offspring, and the needs passed on within the bound are selected within the bound.

clauses.zh: 凡唯运者与之、有待：x 出于 g 之步，g 见容；
clauses.en: Wherever only the active give and the web is dependent: at the step at which x descends from g, g is admitted;

clauses.zh: 一步不见容者，此步无出于之者；
clauses.en: what is not admitted at a step has no offspring at this step;

clauses.zh: 终不见容者，终无出于之者。
clauses.en: what is never admitted never has offspring.

clauses.zh: 若又于 δ 内传 c，则凡 x 出于 g 而跨步后待 c 者，x 待 c 之需不过 c 于与之步之积加 δ。
clauses.en: If moreover c is transmitted within δ, then wherever x descends from g and depends on c after the step, the need of x on c is at most the level of c at the step of giving plus δ.

clauses.zh: 若流又衡，则凡 x 于 S＋n 步出于 g 而跨步后待 c 者，x 之需加自 S 步起 n 步所取于 c 者，不过 c 于 S 之积加此 n 步所与 c 者加 δ。
clauses.en: If the flow also balances, then wherever x descends from g at step S＋n and depends on c after the step, the need of x plus what is taken from c in the n steps from step S is at most the level of c at S plus what is given to c in these n steps plus δ.

clauses.zh: 损益，出者之量对其所出之量之升与降也。
clauses.en: Variation is the rise and fall of an offspring's amount against the amount of what it descends from.

clauses.zh: 凡族，各员各有其出者之族，任以自然数读员与出者之量：出者之量之总加诸所降，等于各员之量按其出者之数计之总加诸所升（损益之计）。
clauses.en: For every family in which each member has its family of offspring, with the amounts of members and offspring read in any way as natural numbers: the total of the offspring's amounts plus all the falls equals the total of the members' amounts, each counted by its number of offspring, plus all the rises (the account of variation).

clauses.zh: 各员之出者皆 k 个，则按出者计之总为诸员之量之总之 k 倍。
clauses.en: If every member has k offspring, then the total counted by offspring is k times the total of the members' amounts.

clauses.zh: 凡族，任以自然数读诸员之轻重与量：员数乘诸员轻重与量相乘之总，加不一致，等于轻重之总乘量之总，加一致。
clauses.en: For every family, with the members' weightings and amounts read in any way as natural numbers: the number of members times the total of the products of each member's weighting and amount, plus the discordance, equals the total of the weightings times the total of the amounts, plus the concordance.

clauses.zh: 择项，以出者之数为轻重之一致减不一致也。
clauses.en: The selection term is the concordance less the discordance, with the number of offspring as the weighting.

clauses.zh: 以出者之数为轻重：员数乘按出者计之总，多于出者之数之总乘员之量之总，恰当一致多于不一致；
clauses.en: With the number of offspring as the weighting: the number of members times the total counted by offspring exceeds the total number of offspring times the total of the members' amounts exactly where the concordance exceeds the discordance;

clauses.zh: 二者等，恰当一致与不一致等。
clauses.en: the two are equal exactly where the concordance and the discordance are equal.

clauses.zh: 并损益之计：员数乘出者之量之总，加员数乘所降与不一致，等于出者之数之总乘员之量之总，加一致与员数乘所升。
clauses.en: Joined with the account of variation: the number of members times the total of the offspring's amounts, plus the number of members times the falls, plus the discordance, equals the total number of offspring times the total of the members' amounts, plus the concordance, plus the number of members times the rises.

title: 诸世之均
title_en: The family mean across successive families

clauses.zh: 世：首世一族，每世各员有其出者之族，次世即诸员之出者。
clauses.en: Successive family: the first is a family, each member of each successive family has its family of offspring, and the next successive family is the offspring of the members.

clauses.zh: 均以交乘相比：跨一步不改，恰当此世员数乘所降加不一致，等于一致加此世员数乘所升；
clauses.en: The family mean is compared by cross-multiplying: it does not change across a step exactly where the number of members of this successive family times the falls, plus the discordance, equals the concordance plus the number of members of this successive family times the rises;

clauses.zh: 升，恰当前者少于后者。
clauses.en: it rises exactly where the former is less than the latter.

clauses.zh: 一世之均异于首世，则其前有一步不相抵，逐步判之即得；
clauses.en: If the family mean of a successive family differs from that of the first, then at some step before it the two sides do not offset each other, and checking step by step finds it;

clauses.zh: 诸步无损益（各出者之量等于其员之量），则其前有一步不一致异于一致；
clauses.en: if there is exact transmission at every step (each offspring's amount equals its member's amount), then at some step before it the discordance differs from the concordance;

clauses.zh: 诸步各员出者之数皆同，则其前有一步所降异于所升。
clauses.en: if at every step every member has the same number of offspring, then at some step before it the falls differ from the rises.

title: 见容者不被逆选
title_en: What is admitted is not selected against

clauses.zh: 凡唯运者与之、有待，一族诸员所列之出者皆于此步出于其员：一量于每一见容之员处不低于诸员之量，则不一致为零，择项不为负。
clauses.en: Wherever only the active give and the web is dependent, and the offspring listed for the members of a family all descend from their member at this step: if an amount at every admitted member is not below the amounts of all the members, then the discordance is zero and the selection term is not negative.

clauses.zh: 于此流，凡诸世皆由所出而成，一量于每世见容之员处不低于该世诸员之量：若一段诸步所降皆为零，则其均于此段不降；
clauses.en: In this flow, wherever the successive families are all formed by descent and an amount at the admitted members of each successive family is not below the amounts of all members of that successive family: if the falls at every step of a stretch are zero, then the family mean does not fall over this stretch;

clauses.zh: 若此段诸步无损益而其均有改，则其改为升，且有一步一致多于不一致。
clauses.en: if there is exact transmission at every step of this stretch and the family mean changes, then the change is a rise, and at some step the concordance exceeds the discordance.

title: 出者之数之选
title_en: Selection on the number of offspring

clauses.zh: 以轻重读其自身则无不一致：员数乘诸轻重之平方之总，等于轻重之总之平方加一致（诸对差之平方之总）；
clauses.en: A weighting read against itself has no discordance: the number of members times the total of the squares of the weightings equals the square of the total of the weightings plus the concordance (the total of the squares of the pairwise gaps);

clauses.zh: 故不低于轻重之总之平方，恰当诸轻重皆同乃等。
clauses.en: so it is not below the square of the total of the weightings, and is equal to it exactly where the weightings are all the same.

clauses.zh: 以出者之数为轻重：员数乘按出者计之出者之数之总，不低于出者之数之总之平方，恰当诸员出者之数皆同乃等。
clauses.en: With the number of offspring as the weighting: the number of members times the total of the numbers of offspring counted by offspring is not below the square of the total number of offspring, and is equal to it exactly where every member has the same number of offspring.

clauses.zh: 以出者之数为量读诸世：某步所降为零，则出者之数之均跨此步不降；
clauses.en: Reading successive families with the number of offspring as the amount: if the falls at a step are zero, then the family mean of the number of offspring does not fall across this step;

clauses.zh: 此步无损益，则出者之数之均升恰当一致为正，不改恰当诸员出者之数皆同。
clauses.en: if there is exact transmission at this step, then the family mean of the number of offspring rises exactly where the concordance is positive, and does not change exactly where every member has the same number of offspring.

clauses.zh: 凡族，任以自然数读轻重与量：一致加不一致之平方，不过轻重之诸对差平方之总乘量之诸对差平方之总；
clauses.en: For every family, with weightings and amounts read in any way as natural numbers: the square of the concordance plus the discordance is at most the total of the squared pairwise gaps of the weightings times the total of the squared pairwise gaps of the amounts;

clauses.zh: 量即轻重自身则等。
clauses.en: where the amount is the weighting itself, the two are equal.

clauses.zh: 诸世中某步无损益，则其均（交乘）之升或降之平方，不过出者之数之诸对差平方之总乘此量之诸对差平方之总。
clauses.en: If there is exact transmission at some step of successive families, then the square of the rise or fall of the family mean (by cross-multiplying) is at most the total of the squared pairwise gaps of the numbers of offspring times the total of the squared pairwise gaps of this amount.

title: 出者之数之界
title_en: The bound on the number of offspring

clauses.zh: 一员一步之出者皆出于之，其数不过其此步与诸出者之总。
clauses.en: Where a member's offspring at a step all descend from it, their number is at most the total it gives to the offspring at this step.

clauses.zh: 一族跨一步衡且耗：出者各异而皆为族之员，其数加此步取于族之取者之数，不过此步前族之总积。
clauses.en: Where a family balances and dissipates across a step: if the offspring are distinct and are all members of the family, their number plus the number of takers that take from the family at this step is at most the family's total level before this step.

clauses.zh: 诸世皆由所出而成，出者皆为一族之员，此族自首步至其始总积之步，每步衡且耗，则编号为始总积加一之世空（首世编号为零）；
clauses.en: If the successive families are all formed by descent, the offspring are all members of one family, and this family balances and dissipates at every step from the first step to the step numbered by its starting total level, then the successive family numbered by the starting total level plus one is empty (the first successive family is numbered zero);

clauses.zh: 以出者之数为量读之，若次世有员，则于始总积之步前有一步，员数乘所降多于一致加员数乘所升。
clauses.en: read with the number of offspring as the amount, if the next successive family has members, then at some step before the step of the starting total level the number of members times the falls exceeds the concordance plus the number of members times the rises.

clauses.zh: 一族逐组列为 k 组、各组员数同：整体之一致，加 k 乘组内之不一致与组间之不一致，等于整体之不一致，加 k 乘组内之一致与组间之一致。
clauses.en: Where a family is listed group by group as k groups with the same number of members in each: the concordance of the whole family, plus k times the within-group discordance, plus the among-group discordance, equals the discordance of the whole family, plus k times the within-group concordance, plus the among-group concordance.

clauses.zh: 故于一量，组内之一致不多于其不一致，则整体之一致多于不一致者，唯当组间之一致多于不一致。
clauses.en: So, for an amount whose within-group concordance is not more than its within-group discordance, the concordance of the whole family exceeds its discordance only where the among-group concordance exceeds the among-group discordance.

clauses.zh: 诸组员数不一者，取诸组员数之一公倍数，各组自身之项按其因数计，组间之项以诸组之均逐员读之，亦有与之对应之解（各项乘以公倍数所定之因数）；
clauses.en: Where the groups differ in their numbers of members, taking a common multiple of the groups' numbers of members, counting each group's own terms by its multiplier, and reading the among-group terms member by member from the groups' family means, there is also a corresponding decomposition (each term multiplied by a multiplier the common multiple fixes);

clauses.zh: 一世有员、逐组列为诸均相同之组而无损益，则其均升，恰当组内（如是计之）一致多于不一致。
clauses.en: if a successive family has members, is listed group by group as groups with the same family means, and has exact transmission, then its family mean rises exactly where the within-group concordance (counted so) exceeds the discordance.

title: 以无出者选于组间
title_en: Selection among groups by having no offspring

clauses.zh: 诸组员数同，凡某量之总少于另一组之组皆无出者，则组间无不一致；
clauses.en: Where the groups have the same number of members and every group whose total of an amount is less than another group's has no offspring, there is no among-group discordance;

clauses.zh: 故整体之择项为正，恰当 k 乘组内不一致少于 k 乘组内一致加组间一致；
clauses.en: so the selection term of the whole family is positive exactly where k times the within-group discordance is less than k times the within-group concordance plus the among-group concordance;

clauses.zh: 诸组内此量又各皆同，则整体之择项不为负。
clauses.en: if moreover this amount is the same within each group, then the selection term of the whole family is not negative.

clauses.zh: 于流：流衡、唯运者与之、有待，于一所待 c，与之者皆待之而需不下于 m，自 T 起 n 步所与 c 者少于取于 c 者，c 于 T 之积少于 n 加 m，则自 T＋n 起，凡于其步待 c 而需不下于 m 者，无出于之者。
clauses.en: In a flow: where the flow balances, only the active give, the web is dependent, and for a condition c every renewer of c depends on it with need not below m, if at each of the n steps from T what is given to c is less than what is taken from c, and the level of c at T is less than n plus m, then from T＋n on nothing that depends on c at its step with need not below m has offspring.

clauses.zh: 唯运者与之，诸世由所出而成，一世之员皆不运，则次世空。
clauses.en: Where only the active give and the successive families are formed by descent, if no member of a successive family is active, then the next successive family is empty.

clauses.zh: 首世逐组列出，各组之员于一量皆为其组初立之值，诸步无损益：则由所出而成之组，历世每员皆带其组初立之值，组内无择项；
clauses.en: Where the first successive family is listed group by group, the members of each group all have, for an amount, the value with which their group was first set, and there is exact transmission at every step: then in the groups formed by descent every member, across the successive families, carries the first value of its group, and there is no within-group selection term;

clauses.zh: 诸由所出而成之组于第 t 世皆有员时，自第 t 世至次世均升，恰当以其员数之一公倍数读之，诸组之均与出者之数一致多于不一致。
clauses.en: where every group formed by descent has members in the t-th successive family, the family mean rises from the t-th successive family to the next exactly where, read by a common multiple of their numbers of members, the concordance of the groups' family means with the numbers of offspring exceeds the discordance.

clauses.zh: 于流：唯运者与之，诸世由所出而成，若第 T 世之前每世，凡初立之值少于另一组之组，其由所出而成者之员皆不运，则第 T 世之均不低于首世；
clauses.en: In a flow: where only the active give and the successive families are formed by descent, if in every successive family before the T-th, for every group whose first value is less than another group's, the members of what is formed by descent from it are all inactive, then the family mean of the T-th successive family is not below that of the first;

clauses.zh: 第 t 世凡初立之值少于另一组之组，其由所出而成者之员皆不运，而一初立之值较多之组，其由所出而成者有一员留出者，旁有一初立之值较少之组之由所出而成者有员，则自第 t 世至次世均升。
clauses.en: if in the t-th successive family, for every group whose first value is less than another group's, the members of what is formed by descent from it are all inactive, while in what is formed by descent from a group with a larger first value some member leaves offspring, and beside it what is formed by descent from a group with a smaller first value has members, then the family mean rises from the t-th successive family to the next.

clauses.zh: 拟次世不即出者之族，而自出者之族有放回抽 n 次而成：族中前类 p 个、后类 q 个，各抽样以其抽法之数为其重。
clauses.en: Under a representation in which the next successive family is not the family of offspring itself but is formed from the family of offspring by n draws with replacement: the family has p of the first kind and q of the second, and each sample has as its weight the number of ways of drawing it.

clauses.zh: p＋q 乘诸抽样之前类抽数按其重计之总，等于 n·p·(p＋q)ⁿ。
clauses.en: p＋q times the total, over the samples counted by their weights, of the number of first-kind draws equals n·p·(p＋q)ⁿ.

clauses.zh: 若 (p＋q)·h＋g＝N·p，则前类抽数乘 N 不过 h 乘 n 之诸抽样，其重之总乘 n²·g²，不过 N²·n·p·q·(p＋q)ⁿ，且不少于 qⁿ。
clauses.en: If (p＋q)·h＋g＝N·p, then the total weight of the samples whose number of first-kind draws times N is at most h times n, multiplied by n²·g², is at most N²·n·p·q·(p＋q)ⁿ, and that total weight is no less than qⁿ.

clauses.zh: N 员之族，前类 h 员（h 不过 N），每世自前世唯按其类之数有放回抽 N 次：k 世之诸历（各以其抽法之数为其重），末世前类数按其重计之总，等于 h·(N^N)^k。
clauses.en: For a family of N members with h of the first kind (h at most N), each successive family drawn N times with replacement from the one before by the numbers of its kinds alone: over the histories of k successive families (each with the number of ways of drawing it as its weight), the total, counted by weight, of the number of the first kind in the last successive family equals h·(N^N)^k.

clauses.zh: 始于无前类者，诸历每世皆无；
clauses.en: Starting with none of the first kind, every history has none at every successive family;

clauses.zh: 始于全为前类者，诸历每世皆全。
clauses.en: starting with all of the first kind, every history has all at every successive family.

clauses.zh: 若 r＋2＝N^N，则 k 世后仍有二类之历，其重之总不过 r^k；
clauses.en: If r＋2＝N^N, then the total weight of the histories that still have both kinds after k successive families is at most r^k;

clauses.zh: 定于前类之历，其重之总乘 N 不过 h·(N^N)^k，加 N·r^k 则不少于之。
clauses.en: the total weight of the histories fixed at the first kind, times N, is at most h·(N^N)^k, and with N·r^k added it is no less than h·(N^N)^k.

clauses.zh: 择所经之象（一·三），配每一可择者一值。
clauses.en: The model a selection goes through (1.3) assigns a value to each selectable.

clauses.zh: 择经象者，换二可择者之值则换其所择。
clauses.en: A selection through a model, when the values of two selectables are swapped, swaps what it selects.

clauses.zh: 凡可择者之同异定然否：二可择者为每一经象之择所同择，恰当象配二者同值；
clauses.en: Wherever the sameness or difference of selectables is decided: two selectables are selected alike by every selection through a model exactly where the model assigns them the same value;

clauses.zh: 一可择者可为一经象、每象至多择一之择所择，恰当他可择者之值皆异于其值。
clauses.en: a selectable can be selected by a selection through a model that selects at most one under each model exactly where the values of the other selectables all differ from its value.

clauses.zh: 一辞于象配同值之二可择者一然一否，则无经此象之择恰择其然者。
clauses.en: If a claim holds of one and not of the other of two selectables to which the model assigns the same value, then no selection through this model selects exactly those of which it holds.

clauses.zh: 取法，经他者实应之学也。
clauses.en: Learning through response is learning through others' actual responses.

clauses.zh: 于所拟之取法之对（取法者所受唯所取法者之实应；
clauses.en: In the represented pair of learning through response (the learning side receives only the actual responses of the side learned from;

clauses.zh: 所装、语法、一族问与积皆为所给）中，所取法者既有所装，则取法者自之所学，同于自一唯有此所装、积与之同之所取法者所学（取法者之积、部件与一族问皆同）。
clauses.en: what is installed, the grammar, a family of questions and the levels are all given), where the side learned from has something installed, what the learning side learns from it is the same as what it learns from a side learned from that has only this installed and the same levels (the learning side's levels, components and family of questions being the same).

clauses.zh: 无应则取法者不添样本；
clauses.en: Where there is no response, the learning side adds no sample;

clauses.zh: 一族问之后，二者之积与已用之量之总不改。
clauses.en: after a family of questions, the total of the two sides' levels and the amounts already used does not change.

clauses.zh: 群，待者同在群域者也。
clauses.en: A collective is formations that lie together in a system closure.

clauses.zh: 有一所待，凡待者或于某步待之，或于之有取与，则凡待者皆在凡待者之群域。
clauses.en: If there is a condition such that every formation either depends on it at some step or has taking and giving at it, then every formation lies in the system closure of every formation.

clauses.zh: 相待，凡待者皆在凡待者之扰域也：每一待者，皆可辗转为每一他者所扰。
clauses.en: Mutual dependence is where every formation lies in the influence closure of every formation: each formation can be influenced, through a chain, by every other.

clauses.zh: 相待，恰当凡待者皆在凡待者之及域。
clauses.en: Mutual dependence holds exactly where every formation lies in the reach closure of every formation.

clauses.zh: 同患，凡待者皆于某步待之、又于之有取与之所待也。
clauses.en: A common condition is a condition that every formation depends on at some step and also has taking and giving at.

clauses.zh: 凡流有同患，则凡待者皆在凡待者之及域，凡待者相待。
clauses.en: If a flow has a common condition, then every formation lies in the reach closure of every formation, and the formations are in mutual dependence.

clauses.zh: 交相资，凡待者皆在凡待者之资域也。
clauses.en: Mutual feeding is where every formation lies in the feeding closure of every formation.

clauses.zh: 凡交相资者相待；
clauses.en: Mutual feeding implies mutual dependence;

clauses.zh: 凡相待者，凡待者皆在凡待者之群域。
clauses.en: where there is mutual dependence, every formation lies in the system closure of every formation.

clauses.zh: 有凡待者皆在凡待者之群域而不相待之流；
clauses.en: There is a flow in which every formation lies in the system closure of every formation and there is no mutual dependence;

clauses.zh: 有衡而相待、而二者皆不在对方之资域之流。
clauses.en: there is a flow that balances and has mutual dependence, with two formations neither of which lies in the other's feeding closure.

clauses.zh: 由十二·八（诸步皆标）与十二·七（每绕一匝至少倍之）：凡体起后不再与差，起始之差不过 D，每步入每一所待之应倍之和不过 M，则第 t 步之可致不过 D 乘 1＋M 之 t 次方；
clauses.en: From 12.8 (every step marked) and 12.7 (at least doubling with every loop turn): if the part gives no further gap after the start, the starting gap is at most D, and the sum of the coupling strengths into each condition at each step is at most M, then the carried amount at step t is at most D times 1＋M to the power t;

clauses.zh: 又有一环之感每步皆在（环长 m＋1），则自第 T 步起绕环 R 匝（至第 T＋(m＋1)R 步），环所在之所待之可致，至少为其第 T 步之可致之二之 R 次方倍。
clauses.en: if moreover the couplings of a loop are present at every step (the loop of length m＋1), then after R loop turns from step T (up to step T＋(m＋1)R) the carried amount at the condition where the loop lies is at least 2 to the power R times its carried amount at step T.

clauses.zh: 凡衡，自第 T 步起 n 步无所与于一所待 c，而每步于 c 之共取多于自第 T 步至其前于 c 之共取之和：则此 n 步之每步，c 之积皆过第 T 步之积之半，而第 T 步之积不少于二之 n 次方减一。
clauses.en: Wherever the flow balances, nothing is given to a condition c for n steps from step T, and the joint taking at c at each step exceeds the sum of the joint taking at c from step T up to before it: then at each of these n steps the level of c exceeds half the level at step T, and the level at step T is no less than 2 to the power n less one.

clauses.zh: 出入相掩（四·十九）之下：凡衡，于一所待步步出入相掩，又凡待者唯待此所待，其需皆不过此所待第零步之积，则凡待者步步见容。
clauses.en: Under taking within giving (4.19): wherever the flow balances, there is taking within giving at a condition at every step, and every formation depends only on this condition with need at most the level of this condition at step zero, every formation is admitted at every step.

clauses.zh: 念旧恶，一物于次步与，恰当其此步与、且其所俟者此步皆与也。
clauses.en: Waiting with memory is where a relatum gives at the next step exactly where it gives at this step and everything it waits on gives at this step.

clauses.zh: 凡依念旧恶之法：一物某步不与，则此后每步不与；
clauses.en: Under the law of waiting with memory: if a relatum does not give at some step, then it does not give at any step after;

clauses.zh: 一物始不与，由之经长 k 之俟链至于他物，则他物自第 k 步起每步不与；
clauses.en: if a relatum does not give at the start and a chain of waiting of length k leads from it to another relatum, then the other does not give at any step from step k on;

clauses.zh: 凡物皆在一物之 d 俟之内，而此物始不与，则自第 d 步起凡物皆不与。
clauses.en: if every relatum lies within d waitings of one relatum and this relatum does not give at the start, then from step d on no relatum gives.

clauses.zh: 不念旧恶，一物于次步与，恰当其所俟者此步皆与也。
clauses.en: Waiting without memory is where a relatum gives at the next step exactly where everything it waits on gives at this step.

clauses.zh: 凡依不念旧恶之法：凡物之间皆无长 L 之俟链，则不论其始，自第 L 步起凡物每步皆与；
clauses.en: Under the law of waiting without memory: if there is no chain of waiting of length L between any relata, then, whatever the start, every relatum gives at every step from step L on;

clauses.zh: 有一长 p 之俟链自 b 至于 b，b 始不与，则 b 于 p 之每一倍数步皆不与。
clauses.en: if there is a chain of waiting of length p from b back to b and b does not give at the start, then b does not give at any step that is a multiple of p.

clauses.zh: 凡依念旧恶之法、凡依不念旧恶之法，所俟加多，则每步之与者皆在原来同步之与者之中。
clauses.en: Under the law of waiting with memory and under the law of waiting without memory, if more is waited on, then the relata giving at each step are among those that gave at the same step before.

clauses.zh: 不求备，一物于其所俟者缺不过 tol 个犹与，tol 至少为一也。
clauses.en: Tolerance is where a relatum still gives when no more than tol of what it waits on are missing, with tol at least one.

clauses.zh: 凡依缺不过 tol 犹与之法：一域之员始皆与，每员所俟者在域外者不过其 tol 个，则不论他物，此域之员每步皆与；
clauses.en: Under the law of still giving while no more than tol are missing: if the members of a region all give at the start and each member waits on no more than its tol outside the region, then, whatever the other relata, the members of this region give at every step;

clauses.zh: 一域之外始皆与，每物所俟者在此域内者不过其 tol 个，则自第一步起凡物每步皆与；
clauses.en: if everything outside a region gives at the start and each relatum waits on no more than its tol inside this region, then from step one on every relatum gives at every step;

clauses.zh: 无一物之 tol 不少于其所俟之数，则一步无一物与，此后每步皆然。
clauses.en: if no relatum has a tol no less than the number it waits on, then once no relatum gives at a step, the same holds at every step after.

clauses.zh: tol 为零之法，其历程即不念旧恶之法之历程。
clauses.en: The law with tol zero has the same path as the law of waiting without memory.

clauses.zh: 有以待之，一物于某步自每一起状皆与也。
clauses.en: Restoring from every start is where a relatum gives at some step from every starting configuration.

clauses.zh: 凡法守包含（一状之与者皆在另一状之与者之中，则次步亦然）：一物于 n 步自每一起状皆与，恰当其自莫与之状起于 n 步与；
clauses.en: Wherever a law keeps inclusion (if the relata giving in one configuration are all among those giving in another, then the same holds at the next step): a relatum gives at step n from every starting configuration exactly where it gives at step n starting from the configuration in which none gives;

clauses.zh: 自莫与之状起，一物于某步与，则次步亦与；
clauses.en: starting from the configuration in which none gives, if a relatum gives at some step, then it also gives at the next step;

clauses.zh: 于 n 步自每一起状皆与者，此后每步自每一起状皆与；
clauses.en: what gives at step n from every starting configuration gives at every step after from every starting configuration;

clauses.zh: 莫与之状之次步无一物与，则自莫与之状起每步皆无一物与。
clauses.en: if no relatum gives at the step after the configuration in which none gives, then, starting from the configuration in which none gives, no relatum gives at any step.

clauses.zh: 先施，一物每一步之后皆与，不视其所俟者也。
clauses.en: Giving first is where a relatum gives after every step, without regard to what it waits on.

clauses.zh: 凡依先施之法（每一步之后，先施者皆与；
clauses.en: Under the law of giving first (after every step, the relata that give first all give;

clauses.zh: 他物所俟者此步皆与，则次步与），诸物之为先施者皆定然否：一物于 n 步自每一起状皆与，恰当无一长 n、起点之外无先施者之俟链入之；
clauses.en: any other relatum gives at the next step if everything it waits on gives at this step), where whether each relatum gives first is decided: a relatum gives at step n from every starting configuration exactly where no chain of waiting of length n, with no relatum giving first except at its starting point, leads into it;

clauses.zh: 有一俟链自 b 至于 b（长为正），起点之外无先施者，则自莫与之状起，b 每步皆不与；
clauses.en: if there is a chain of waiting from b back to b (of positive length) with no relatum giving first except at its starting point, then, starting from the configuration in which none gives, b gives at no step;

clauses.zh: 一物于不念旧恶之法下于 n 步自每一起状皆与，则于先施之法下亦然。
clauses.en: if a relatum gives at step n from every starting configuration under the law of waiting without memory, then the same holds under the law of giving first.

clauses.zh: 不校，环上一环节交回少于所受也。
clauses.en: A loop returning less is a loop on which a loop link hands back less than it receives.

clauses.zh: 报之行于何步降、于何步为零，见十二·九。
clauses.en: For the steps at which the run of the return map falls and the steps at which it is zero, see 12.9.

clauses.zh: 争，诸待者于一所待连步共取过与也；
clauses.en: A race at a shared condition is where formations have joint excess at a condition over consecutive steps;

clauses.zh: 其积之降与待之者之亡，见四·十九、四·二十。
clauses.en: for the fall of its level and the ending of what depends on it, see 4.19 and 4.20.

clauses.zh: 称，一体之量计以其族之体数之倍，对其族诸体之量之和之相对位置也。
clauses.en: Relative position is the position of a part's amount, counted as many times as there are parts in its family, against the sum of the amounts of the parts of its family.

clauses.zh: 凡有穷之族、凡量之读：诸体之称之和为零。
clauses.en: For every finite family and every reading of amounts: the sum of the relative positions of the parts is zero.

clauses.zh: 凡诸体之量自此而彼：全族升计之和等于降计之和；
clauses.en: Wherever the parts' amounts go from these to those: the sum of the rise counts over the whole family equals the sum of the fall counts;

clauses.zh: 一体之升计加他体升计之和，等于其降计加他体降计之和；
clauses.en: a part's rise count plus the sum of the other parts' rise counts equals its fall count plus the sum of the other parts' fall counts;

clauses.zh: 族非空，则诸体之称不皆升；
clauses.en: if the family is not empty, then the relative positions of the parts do not all rise;

clauses.zh: 一体之称升，必有他体之称降。
clauses.en: if a part's relative position rises, some other part's relative position falls.

title: 争之所终
title_en: Where a race at a shared condition ends

clauses.zh: 凡于一所待自第 T 步起连 n 步衡而共取过与，一体于第 T＋n 步待之，第 T 步之积少于 n 加其于第 T＋n 步之需，而此体于其步有待（运则见容）：则此体于第 T＋n 步不运，不论其称。
clauses.en: If at a condition, for n consecutive steps from step T, the flow balances and there is joint excess, a part depends on it at step T＋n, the level at step T is less than n plus its need at step T＋n, and this part is dependent at its step (active only where admitted): then this part is not active at step T＋n, whatever its relative position.

clauses.zh: 又四·二十之诸条件具（衡，唯运者与之，有待，与之者皆待之而需不下于 m，第 T 步之积少于 n 加 m），则凡族、凡量之读：自第 T 步至第 T＋n 步，诸体升计之和等于降计之和；
clauses.en: If moreover the conditions of 4.20 all hold (balance, only the active give, dependent, every renewer depends on it with need not below m, the level at step T less than n plus m), then for every family and every reading of amounts: from step T to step T＋n the sum of the parts' rise counts equals the sum of their fall counts;

clauses.zh: 积至少降 n；
clauses.en: the level falls by at least n;

clauses.zh: 自第 T＋n 步起每步皆在 m 之下；
clauses.en: from step T＋n on it is below m at every step;

clauses.zh: 此后族中量莫过之者，于其步待此所待而需不下于 m，皆不运。
clauses.en: after this, the members of the family whose amount none exceeds, where they depend on this condition at their step with need not below m, are all inactive.

clauses.zh: 族非空，其员自第 T＋n 步起皆待此所待而需不下于 m，则此后每步族中皆有量莫过之者，而皆不运。
clauses.en: If the family is not empty and its members all depend on this condition with need not below m from step T＋n on, then at every step after there is a member of the family whose amount none exceeds, and all such members are inactive.

clauses.zh: 有力，一状一动绝一待，偏去一物，同一动于偏去之状犹可行，而其每一果皆持此待也。
clauses.en: A relatum makes a difference where a move at a configuration breaks a dependence and, with the relatum withheld, the same move can still be taken at the configuration with it withheld, and every outcome of it keeps this dependence.

clauses.zh: 凡一动绝一待，而偏去任一物，同一动犹绝之，则无一物有力。
clauses.en: If a move breaks a dependence and, with any one relatum withheld, the same move still breaks it, then no relatum makes a difference.

clauses.zh: 若一动绝一待，偏去一物而同一动犹可行，此待于偏去之状犹在而足，则此物有力，恰当偏去之后同一动不再绝之。
clauses.en: If a move breaks a dependence, with a relatum withheld the same move can still be taken, and this dependence is still present and met at the configuration with it withheld, then this relatum makes a difference exactly where, after it is withheld, the same move no longer breaks the dependence.

title: 同力与合致而无独致
title_en: Making a difference together, and difference made only together

clauses.zh: 同力，一状一动绝一待，而并偏去一族之员，同一动于并偏去之状犹可行，其每一果皆持此待也。
clauses.en: A family makes a difference together where a move at a configuration breaks a dependence and, with the members of the family withheld together, the same move can still be taken at the configuration with them withheld together, and every outcome of it keeps this dependence.

clauses.zh: 合致而无独致，同力而族中无一员有力也。
clauses.en: Difference made only together is where the family makes a difference together and no member of the family makes a difference.

clauses.zh: 凡合致而无独致，族之员不少于二。
clauses.en: Wherever there is difference made only together, the family has no fewer than two members.

clauses.zh: 凡法（一状一动之果至多一），族中每一员偏去之，同一动皆可行，此待于偏去之状皆在而足：则合致而无独致，恰当同力而偏去任一员同一动仍绝此待。
clauses.en: For every law (a move at a configuration having at most one outcome), where with each member of the family withheld the same move can be taken and this dependence is present and met at the configuration with it withheld: there is difference made only together exactly where the family makes a difference together and, with any one member withheld, the same move still breaks this dependence.

clauses.zh: 分数，叶之有穷成对嵌套也。
clauses.en: A joint plan is a finite nesting of leaves in pairs.

clauses.zh: 一状实现一分数，恰当有二体，与此状满足所给之三元关系 J，而各实现其一侧，以至于叶；
clauses.en: A configuration realizes a joint plan exactly where there are two parts that, with this configuration, satisfy the given three-place relation J, and each realizes one side of it, down to the leaves;

clauses.zh: 叶于其体读之。
clauses.en: a leaf is read at its part.

clauses.zh: 凡类：类所同之二状，一于 J 有二体，则另一亦于 J 有二体，与前二体各为类所同；
clauses.en: For every lumping: if, of two configurations the lumping makes the same, one has two parts under J, then the other also has two parts under J, each the same under the lumping as the corresponding one of the first two;

clauses.zh: 叶经类读之与于状读之同：则一状之类，于经类所读之 J 下实现一分数，恰当此状实现之。
clauses.en: if reading a leaf through the lumping is the same as reading it at the configuration: then a configuration's class realizes a joint plan under the J read through the lumping exactly where this configuration realizes it.

clauses.zh: 分，体之所履各在其所分者之所履之内，而同出一所分者之二体所履无所共也。
clauses.en: Exclusive footprints is where the footprint of each part lies within the footprint of what it is divided from, and two parts divided from one and the same have nothing in common in their footprints.

clauses.zh: 凡分，一状实现一分数（每叶所带之族，其员各异，皆在其体之所履之内）：则诸叶之族依次相接，其员各异，皆在此状之所履之内。
clauses.en: Wherever footprints are exclusive and a configuration realizes a joint plan (each leaf carrying a family whose members are distinct and all lie within its part's footprint): then the leaves' families, joined in order, have distinct members, all within this configuration's footprint.

clauses.zh: 得兼，自一状有一行，每步皆在诸域之内也。
clauses.en: Kept together is where from a configuration there is a run that lies within the regions at every step.

clauses.zh: 凡变、凡状：自此状无一行离二域皆含之状，恰当无一行离其一，亦无一行离其二。
clauses.en: For every process and every configuration: from this configuration no run leaves the configurations both regions contain, exactly where no run leaves the first and no run leaves the second.

clauses.zh: 二域于一状得兼，则自此状于二域各有一行不离之。
clauses.en: If two regions are kept together at a configuration, then from this configuration each of the two regions has a run that does not leave it.

clauses.zh: 有一变一状，自之于二域各有一行不离之，而二域不得兼；
clauses.en: There are a process and a configuration from which each of two regions has a run that does not leave it, and the two regions are not kept together;

clauses.zh: 于此变，无一函，于每状皆以二域各有无不离之行定其得兼与否也。
clauses.en: for this process there is no function that, at every configuration, fixes whether the two regions are kept together from whether each of the two regions has a run that does not leave it.

clauses.zh: 方，评之所从起者也。
clauses.en: A standpoint is where an evaluation starts from.

clauses.zh: 我，一方所在之物也。
clauses.en: The center is the relatum where a standpoint is.

clauses.zh: 己，一方之自身之域也：此方所持之辞。
clauses.en: Own region is the region of a standpoint itself: the claims belonging to this standpoint.

clauses.zh: 畛，沿一关系，含我，而沿此关系不出其外之域也。
clauses.en: The boundary of a self is a region that contains the center and that nothing along a given relation leads out of.

clauses.zh: 凡关系与物：此物沿此关系之域为畛，凡畛皆含此域；
clauses.en: For every relation and every relatum: the region of this relatum along this relation is a boundary of a self, and every boundary of a self contains this region;

clauses.zh: 兼为畛；
clauses.en: the whole of the unfolding is a boundary of a self;

clauses.zh: 凡物皆在此物沿此关系之域内者，兼为其唯一之畛。
clauses.en: where every relatum lies within this relatum's region along this relation, the whole of the unfolding is its only boundary of a self.

clauses.zh: 以诸物为方、己为其沿此关系之域，则己即最小之畛。
clauses.en: Taking the relata as standpoints and own region as a relatum's region along this relation, own region is the least boundary of a self.

clauses.zh: 顾，评之唯一所给者也：于一方、一步、一物，言自此方，此物于此步之续有顾与否。
clauses.en: Significance is the one given parameter of evaluation: for a standpoint, a step and a relatum, it says whether, from this standpoint, the continuation of this relatum at this step has significance.

clauses.zh: 顾唯分有无。
clauses.en: Significance distinguishes only having from not having.

clauses.zh: 无丧，自一方，此积之历容彼历所容之每一有顾之续也。
clauses.en: Retains is where, from a standpoint, this level history admits every continuation with significance that that history admits.

clauses.zh: 有得，自一方，此历容一有顾之续而彼历不容也。
clauses.en: Adds is where, from a standpoint, this history admits a continuation with significance that that history does not admit.

clauses.zh: 凡顾，无丧自反而可传；
clauses.en: For every significance, retains is reflexive and transitive;

clauses.zh: 此于彼无丧，则彼于此无得；
clauses.en: if this retains with respect to that, then that does not add with respect to this;

clauses.zh: 赅则无丧，有得则有所长。
clauses.en: includes implies retains, and adds implies exceeds.

title: 无丧、有得以余地为界
title_en: Retains and adds are bounded by the margin

clauses.zh: 凡流与待网，取一体，偏去此体之积之历存；
clauses.en: For every flow and web and any part taken, the level history with this part withheld exists;

clauses.zh: 自一方，所较之诸有顾之续，其所待于其前诸步皆衡：则有此体之积之历于偏去之积之历无丧，恰当偏去之积所容之每一有顾之续，于其所待之每一所待，需加此体之累取，不过偏去之积加此体之累与（累取、累与皆计其步之前诸步）；
clauses.en: from a standpoint, where the conditions of the continuations with significance being compared balance at the steps before them: the level history with this part retains with respect to the level history with it withheld exactly where, for every continuation with significance admitted by the withheld levels, at every condition it depends on, the need plus this part's cumulative taking is at most the withheld level plus this part's cumulative giving (the cumulative taking and giving both counting the steps before its step);

clauses.zh: 偏去之积之历于有此体之积之历有得，恰当偏去之积所容之某一有顾之续，非于其所待之每一所待皆然；
clauses.en: the level history with it withheld adds with respect to the level history with this part exactly where, for some continuation with significance admitted by the withheld levels, this does not hold at every condition it depends on;

clauses.zh: 有此体之积之历于偏去之积之历有得，恰当偏去之积所不容之某一有顾之续，于其所待之每一所待，需加此体之累取不过偏去之积加此体之累与。
clauses.en: the level history with this part adds with respect to the level history with it withheld exactly where, for some continuation with significance not admitted by the withheld levels, at every condition it depends on, the need plus this part's cumulative taking is at most the withheld level plus this part's cumulative giving.

clauses.zh: 流处处衡者，亦然。
clauses.en: Where the flow balances everywhere, the same holds.

clauses.zh: 顾为任何者皆然。
clauses.en: This holds whatever the significance.

clauses.zh: 顾式，于诸辞并给活、辞间之关系、己与顾者也。
clauses.en: A valuation gives together, over the claims, living, a relation among claims, own region and significance.

clauses.zh: 活，逐步读之：一物于一步运而不剥也。
clauses.en: Living, read step by step, is a relatum active at a step and not undermined.

title: 活与屡作、屡已相交
title_en: Living crosses recurring arising and recurring ceasing

clauses.zh: 物有穷之宇，屡有作者与不屡有作者，各有凡事皆活之例，亦各有非凡事皆活之例；
clauses.en: Among worlds with finitely many relata, those where arising recurs and those where it does not each have instances where every event is living and instances where not every event is living;

clauses.zh: 屡有已者与不屡有已者，亦各有此二例。
clauses.en: those where ceasing recurs and those where it does not also each have these two instances.

clauses.zh: 物有穷而运定然否之宇，屡有已恰当屡有作（三·五）。
clauses.en: In a world with finitely many relata in which activity is decided, ceasing recurs exactly where arising recurs (3.5).

clauses.zh: 故于物有穷之宇，凡事皆活与否不随屡作、屡已而定，屡作、屡已与否亦不随凡事皆活而定。
clauses.en: So in worlds with finitely many relata, whether every event is living is not fixed by whether arising and ceasing recur, and whether arising and ceasing recur is not fixed by whether every event is living.

clauses.zh: 自顾，一方之己中凡活之辞自此方皆有顾也。
clauses.en: Self-significance is where every living claim in a standpoint's own region has significance from this standpoint.

clauses.zh: 萌，有一活之辞自某方有顾也。
clauses.en: A seed is where some living claim has significance from some standpoint.

clauses.zh: 皆在己，凡活之辞皆在某方之己中也。
clauses.en: Held is where every living claim lies in some standpoint's own region.

clauses.zh: 凡一方自顾，其己中有一活之辞，则有萌。
clauses.en: If a standpoint has self-significance and its own region has a living claim, then there is a seed.

clauses.zh: 以诸物为方、己为沿任一关系之域，逐步读之，则皆在己。
clauses.en: Taking the relata as standpoints and own region as the region along any relation, read step by step, every living claim is held.

title: 尽、畛内皆然、无亲、无方
title_en: Boundary neutrality, bounded rule, relational neutrality, standpoint neutrality

clauses.zh: 尽，一规则于其每一例皆然也。
clauses.en: Boundary neutrality is a rule holding in every one of its instances.

clauses.zh: 畛内皆然，一规则于一既成之界内皆然也。
clauses.en: A bounded rule is a rule holding within a formed boundary.

clauses.zh: 凡尽者，于任何界内皆然。
clauses.en: Whatever has boundary neutrality holds within any boundary.

clauses.zh: 无亲，“自一方有顾之辞，与之有辞间之关系之活辞，自此方亦有顾”，此规则之尽也。
clauses.en: Relational neutrality is the boundary neutrality of the rule "a living claim related to a claim with significance from a standpoint also has significance from this standpoint".

clauses.zh: 无方，“活之辞自一方有顾，则自每方有顾”，此规则之尽也；
clauses.en: Standpoint neutrality is the boundary neutrality of the rule "a living claim with significance from one standpoint has significance from every standpoint";

clauses.zh: 于延续之顾，自一方有顾者自每方有顾，亦曰无方。
clauses.en: for the significance of continuation, what has significance from one standpoint having significance from every standpoint is also called standpoint neutrality.

clauses.zh: 以交或所出（两向）为辞间之关系，若无亲（十五·九）：自一方，一物之任一事有顾，则出于此物者之每一活事亦有顾；
clauses.en: With interacting or descent (in both directions) as the relation among claims, if there is relational neutrality (15.9): from a standpoint, if any event of a relatum has significance, then every living event of what descends from this relatum also has significance;

clauses.zh: 一物之任一事有顾，则此物之所出之每一活事亦有顾。
clauses.en: if any event of a relatum has significance, then every living event of what this relatum descends from also has significance.

clauses.zh: 活皆有顾，凡活之辞自每方皆有顾也。
clauses.en: Living significance is where every living claim has significance from every standpoint.

title: 待网之律不蕴含活皆有顾
title_en: The laws of the web do not imply living significance

clauses.zh: 凡待网，有一方，有一物于一步活：于此待网，以无所不顾之顾，则活皆有顾；
clauses.en: For every web with a standpoint and a relatum living at a step: on this web, with the significance that holds of everything, there is living significance;

clauses.zh: 以无所顾之顾，则活皆有顾不然，且凡二积之历皆此于彼无丧、此于彼无得。
clauses.en: with the significance that holds of nothing, living significance does not hold, and for every two level histories the one retains with respect to the other and does not add with respect to it.

clauses.zh: 诸活辞连属，凡二活辞，自其一，每步沿辞间之关系至一活辞，能至其二也。
clauses.en: Living claims are connected where, for every two living claims, from the one, moving at each step along the relation among claims to a living claim, the other can be reached.

clauses.zh: 凡顾式，有一方，有一活辞，诸活辞连属：则活皆有顾，恰当有萌且无亲、无方。
clauses.en: For every valuation with a standpoint and a living claim whose living claims are connected: there is living significance exactly where there is a seed, relational neutrality and standpoint neutrality.

clauses.zh: 去萌、去无亲、去无方、去连属，各有一顾式，他三者皆具而活皆有顾不然。
clauses.en: Without the seed, without relational neutrality, without standpoint neutrality, or without connection, there is in each case a valuation that has the other three and in which living significance does not hold.

clauses.zh: 以“于同一所待或待或资”为辞间之关系：凡活事皆于一所待或待或资，则诸活事连属；
clauses.en: With "depends on or draws from one and the same condition" as the relation among claims: if every living event depends on or draws from one condition, then the living events are connected;

clauses.zh: 又有一方、有一活事，则活皆有顾，恰当有萌且无亲、无方。
clauses.en: if moreover there are a standpoint and a living event, then there is living significance exactly where there is a seed, relational neutrality and standpoint neutrality.

clauses.zh: 以交为辞间之关系（二·十四）：增一凡物皆以零需待之、无物资之之所待，诸活事不改，以前者之关系则凡待网之诸活事皆连属，以交则连属与否如故；
clauses.en: With interacting as the relation among claims (2.14): adding a condition that every relatum depends on with need zero and that nothing draws from leaves the living events unchanged; with the former relation the living events of every web are then connected, and with interacting whether they are connected is as before;

clauses.zh: 增一积每步为一、凡物皆以一之需待之、唯一活事之物于此事之步资之之所待，此所待恒持，诸活事不改，以交则凡待网之诸活事皆连属。
