clauses.en: adding a condition whose level is one at every step, that every relatum depends on with need one, and that only the relatum of one living event draws from at the step of this event, this condition is renewed, the living events are unchanged, and with interacting the living events of every web are connected.

clauses.zh: 有待网焉：二待者以一之需待一所待，其运恰当此所待之积不下于一，另一物唯于首步资之；
clauses.en: There is a web in which two formations depend on a condition with need one and are active exactly where the level of this condition is not below one, and another relatum draws from it only at the first step;

clauses.zh: 此所待之积每步为一者，以交则诸活事连属；
clauses.en: where the level of this condition is one at every step, with interacting the living events are connected;

clauses.zh: 此所待之积首步之后降为零者，二待者首步之事皆活，而以交不连属；
clauses.en: where the level of this condition falls to zero after the first step, the events of the two formations at the first step are both living, and with interacting they are not connected;

clauses.zh: 以前者之关系，二者皆连属。
clauses.en: with the former relation, both are connected.

title: 皆在己之活皆有顾
title_en: Living significance where every living claim is held

clauses.zh: 凡皆在己之顾式：活皆有顾，恰当每方自顾且无方；
clauses.en: For every valuation in which every living claim is held: there is living significance exactly where every standpoint has self-significance and there is standpoint neutrality;

clauses.zh: 不须连属，不须无亲。
clauses.en: connection is not needed, and relational neutrality is not needed.

clauses.zh: 凡诸活辞连属之顾式，每方之己中皆有活之辞，每方自顾且无亲，则活皆有顾。
clauses.en: For every valuation whose living claims are connected, where every standpoint's own region has a living claim, every standpoint has self-significance, and there is relational neutrality, there is living significance.

clauses.zh: 以诸物为方、己为沿任一关系之域，逐步读之，活皆有顾恰当每物自顾且无方。
clauses.en: Taking the relata as standpoints and own region as the region along any relation, read step by step, there is living significance exactly where every relatum has self-significance and there is standpoint neutrality.

title: 我不由待而定
title_en: The center is not fixed by dependence

clauses.zh: 有宇焉：每物之己即其自身之事，每物顾其自身之事，清除者亦顾与其资源者（源）之事；
clauses.en: There is a world in which each relatum's own region is its own events, each relatum's own events have significance from it, and the events of the relatum that gives the clearer what it draws from (the source) also have significance from the clearer;

clauses.zh: 活皆在己，处处自顾，凡自一方有顾之事，同步在场而与此事之物所待之所待者，其事自此方亦有顾；
clauses.en: every living claim is held, there is self-significance everywhere, and for every event with significance from a standpoint, the events of what takes part at the same step and gives to a condition that the relatum of this event depends on also have significance from this standpoint;

clauses.zh: 栖居者零步之事活，与清除者零步之事有辞间之关系，而自清除者之方无顾：无方不然，活皆有顾不然，限于有顾之辞在此方之己内之无亲亦不然。
clauses.en: the dweller's event at step zero is living and related to the clearer's event at step zero, and has no significance from the clearer's standpoint: standpoint neutrality does not hold, living significance does not hold, and relational neutrality restricted to claims with significance in this standpoint's own region does not hold either.

clauses.zh: 其中清除者第一步之事在其己中，运而不活。
clauses.en: In it, the clearer's event at step one is in its own region, active and not living.

clauses.zh: 别，自一方，唯其域内者之续有顾也：自一方，一物之续有顾，恰当此物在此方之域内。
clauses.en: Bounded significance is where, from a standpoint, only the continuations of what lies within its region have significance: from a standpoint, a relatum's continuation has significance exactly where this relatum lies within this standpoint's region.

clauses.zh: 别于其域内皆然。
clauses.en: Bounded significance holds throughout within its region.

clauses.zh: 有宇焉：每物之顾止于其沿待之域，偏去清除者之体之积之历存；
clauses.en: There is a world in which each relatum's significance stops at its region along dependence, and the level history with the clearer's part withheld exists;

clauses.zh: 则有此体之积之历，自清除者之方于偏去之积之历无丧，自栖居者之方丧栖居者。
clauses.en: then the level history with this part, from the clearer's standpoint, retains with respect to the level history with it withheld, and from the dweller's standpoint loses the dweller.

title: 较止于所及
title_en: Comparison stops at what is reached

clauses.zh: 凡衡之流，取一体，偏去此体之积之历存。
clauses.en: For every flow that balances and any part taken, the level history with this part withheld exists.

clauses.zh: 自一方，二顾于每步、于此体先前所及之每物，一有顾则另一亦有顾，反之亦然：则以二顾较有此体之积之历与偏去之积之历，两向之无丧皆同，两向之无得亦皆同。
clauses.en: If from a standpoint two significances agree at every step on every relatum this part reached before, the one holding where the other holds and the converse: then, comparing the level history with this part and the level history with it withheld under the two significances, retains in both directions is the same, and not adding in both directions is also the same.

clauses.zh: 一顾，自一方，凡此体于每步之前所及之物，其续于此步皆有顾：则有此体之积之历于偏去者无丧，恰当赅之；
clauses.en: If, for a significance, from a standpoint, the continuation at each step of every relatum this part reached before that step has significance: then the level history with this part retains with respect to the one with it withheld exactly where it includes it;

clauses.zh: 偏去者于有此体者无丧，恰当赅之；
clauses.en: the one with it withheld retains with respect to the one with this part exactly where it includes it;

clauses.zh: 此于彼无得，恰当此于彼无所长，两向皆然。
clauses.en: this does not add with respect to that exactly where this does not exceed that, in both directions.

clauses.zh: 凡二流皆衡，在场者同，始积同，体外之待者经其感而应：凡顾，自一方，凡不可非其在应域（十一·八）中者之续于每步皆有顾，则一流之积之历于他流之积之历无丧，恰当赅之；
clauses.en: Wherever two flows both balance, what takes part is the same, the starting levels are the same, and the formations outside the part respond through their couplings: for every significance, if from a standpoint the continuation at every step of everything whose lying in the responsive reach (11.8) cannot be refuted has significance, then one flow's level history retains with respect to the other flow's level history exactly where it includes it;

clauses.zh: 无得，恰当无所长；
clauses.en: it does not add exactly where it does not exceed;

clauses.zh: 两向皆然。
clauses.en: both hold in both directions.

clauses.zh: 凡二流皆衡，在场者同，始积同，体外之待者于两流皆循一缘感而读之法：其较亦然，不另须应之前提。
clauses.en: Wherever two flows both balance, what takes part is the same, the starting levels are the same, and the formations outside the part follow in both flows one law that reads through couplings: the comparison is likewise, with no further premise of response.

title: 所导出之范围之所不及
title_en: What the derived range does not reach

clauses.zh: 一者之续之所须，沿资而导出者，即其资域（十一·四）。
clauses.en: What a relatum's continuation requires, derived along drawing, is its feeding closure (11.4).

clauses.zh: 有宇焉：衡而有待，一者唯待一所待，每步运而见容；
clauses.en: There is a world that balances and is dependent, in which a relatum depends only on one condition and is active and admitted at every step;

clauses.zh: 资其所与之物，自第四步起不运。
clauses.en: the relatum that draws from what it gives is inactive from step four on.

clauses.zh: 有宇焉：衡而有待，一物唯运于第零步与第一步，运时皆见容；
clauses.en: There is a world that balances and is dependent, in which a relatum is active only at step zero and step one, and is admitted whenever active;

clauses.zh: 第二步，与之者不运而后继者犹运；
clauses.en: at step two, its renewer is inactive while its successor is still active;

clauses.zh: 自第三步起诸物皆不运；
clauses.en: from step three on every relatum is inactive;

clauses.zh: 无此物，与之者与后继者每步皆运。
clauses.en: without this relatum, its renewer and its successor are active at every step.

clauses.zh: 有宇焉：衡、耗而有待，清除者每步运而见容，唯待其资源，资源恒持、每步自外来、每步出入相掩；
clauses.en: There is a world that balances, dissipates and is dependent, in which the clearer is active and admitted at every step and depends only on its source, and the source is renewed, fed from beyond at every step, and has taking within giving at every step;

clauses.zh: 清除者于第一步剥，栖居者自第二步起不运。
clauses.en: the clearer undermines at step one, and the dweller is inactive from step two on.

clauses.zh: 若自每方、于每步，凡物之续皆有顾，谓之凡续皆有顾：尽施于延续之顾也。
clauses.en: That, from every standpoint and at every step, the continuation of every relatum has significance is called the continuation condition: boundary neutrality applied to the significance of continuation.

clauses.zh: 此设也，本论陈之而不断之。
clauses.en: This is a supposition: this account states it and does not assert it.

clauses.zh: 凡以域为界之别，于其域内皆然（十五·十七）；
clauses.en: Every bounded significance with a region as its boundary holds within its region (15.17);

clauses.zh: 有一物在某方之域外者，非凡续皆有顾。
clauses.en: if some relatum lies outside some standpoint's region, the continuation condition does not hold.

title: 凡续皆有顾则活皆有顾
title_en: The continuation condition implies living significance

clauses.zh: 若凡续皆有顾，则凡顾式，其每辞读作某物于某步之续，此续自一方有顾者其辞自此方亦有顾：活皆有顾，每方自顾，无亲，无方，有活辞、有方处有萌；
clauses.en: If the continuation condition holds, then for every valuation in which each claim is read as the continuation of some relatum at some step, and a claim whose continuation has significance from a standpoint also has significance from this standpoint: there is living significance, every standpoint has self-significance, there is relational neutrality and standpoint neutrality, and where there are a living claim and a standpoint there is a seed;

clauses.zh: 不用连属。
clauses.en: connection is not used.

clauses.zh: 逐步之读、关系之读、全行之读皆其例。
clauses.en: The step-by-step reading, the relational reading and the whole-run reading are all instances of it.

clauses.zh: 皆顾之活，一状所然之活辞（读作某物于某步之续），其续自每方有顾者也。
clauses.en: Positive relevance read from significance is the living claims that hold at a configuration (read as the continuation of some relatum at some step) whose continuation has significance from every standpoint.

clauses.zh: 若凡续皆有顾，则于任何系辞、任何活之读（每辞读作某物于某步之续）：皆顾之活恰是诸状所然之活辞；
clauses.en: If the continuation condition holds, then for any frame and any reading of living (each claim read as the continuation of some relatum at some step): positive relevance read from significance is exactly the living claims that hold at the configurations;

clauses.zh: 以之为系辞之顾，活皆有顾成立；
clauses.en: with it as the significance of the frame, living significance holds;

clauses.zh: 凡使活皆有顾成立之系辞之顾，皆含皆顾之活。
clauses.en: every significance of the frame under which living significance holds contains positive relevance read from significance.

title: 凡续皆有顾即活皆有顾之遍于凡物
title_en: The continuation condition is living significance extended to every relatum

clauses.zh: 凡系辞，其辞为一物于一步，每辞于某状然：凡续皆有顾，恰当以凡辞为活、以自每方有顾为系辞之顾之活皆有顾。
clauses.en: For every frame whose claims are a relatum at a step and in which each claim holds at some configuration: the continuation condition holds exactly where living significance holds with every claim taken as living and with significance from every standpoint taken as the significance of the frame.

clauses.zh: 凡待网之积之历皆然，不须另设。
clauses.en: This holds for the level histories of every web, with no further supposition.

clauses.zh: 凡待网，其逐步之顾式之诸活事连属，有一方，有一事活，每一事活否定然否：凡续皆有顾，恰当有萌、无亲、无方，且凡不活者之续自每方有顾。
clauses.en: For every web whose step-by-step valuation has connected living events, with a standpoint and a living event, and where whether each event is living is decided: the continuation condition holds exactly where there is a seed, relational neutrality and standpoint neutrality, and the continuation of everything not living has significance from every standpoint.

title: 凡续皆有顾则无丧即赅
title_en: Under the continuation condition, retains is includes

clauses.zh: 若凡续皆有顾，则自任一方：一积之历于另一历无丧，恰当赅之；
clauses.en: If the continuation condition holds, then from any standpoint: one level history retains with respect to another exactly where it includes it;

clauses.zh: 有得，恰当有所长；
clauses.en: it adds exactly where it exceeds;

clauses.zh: 诸方所判皆同。
clauses.en: every standpoint judges the same.

clauses.zh: 广恰是无丧且有得，相赅恰是两向无丧，互有所长恰是两向有得。
clauses.en: Widens is exactly retains and adds, keeps the same is exactly retains in both directions, and mixed is exactly adds in both directions.

clauses.zh: 自一方无丧者，以任何域为界之别自此方亦无丧。
clauses.en: What retains from a standpoint also retains from this standpoint under bounded significance with any region as its boundary.

title: 凡续皆有顾定所顾而不排序
title_en: The continuation condition fixes the scope of significance and orders nothing

clauses.zh: 若凡续皆有顾，互有所长之二积之历两向皆有得、皆不于对方无丧（十五·二十五）：此设不排互有所长之较；
clauses.en: If the continuation condition holds, two mixed level histories each add with respect to the other and neither retains with respect to the other (15.25): this supposition does not order a mixed comparison;

clauses.zh: 凡为另一历所广之历，皆丧另一历所容之一有顾之续。
clauses.en: every history that another history widens loses a continuation with significance that the other history admits.

title: 别与凡续皆有顾相会
title_en: Where bounded significance meets the continuation condition

clauses.zh: 以兼为域之别，即凡续皆有顾。
clauses.en: Bounded significance with the whole of the unfolding as its region is the continuation condition.

clauses.zh: 若凡续皆有顾，以诸物为方，一物之资域即兼，则自此物之方，凡二积之历，以资域为界之别判其无丧与否，与以凡续皆有顾之顾判之全同。
clauses.en: If the continuation condition holds, with the relata as standpoints, and a relatum's feeding closure is the whole of the unfolding, then from this relatum's standpoint, for every two level histories, whether one retains with respect to the other, judged by bounded significance with the feeding closure as boundary, is wholly the same as judged by the significance of the continuation condition.

clauses.zh: 流相待（凡待者皆在凡待者之扰域），则以各我之扰域为界之别，即凡续皆有顾；
clauses.en: If the flow has mutual dependence (every formation lies in the influence closure of every formation), then bounded significance with each center's influence closure as boundary is the continuation condition;

clauses.zh: 凡待者皆在凡待者之群域，则以各我之群域为界之别，亦即凡续皆有顾；
clauses.en: if every formation lies in the system closure of every formation, then bounded significance with each center's system closure as boundary is also the continuation condition;

clauses.zh: 交相资，则以各我之资域为界之别亦然；
clauses.en: with mutual feeding, so is bounded significance with each center's feeding closure as boundary;

clauses.zh: 有一步，凡物皆在场、待一所待而与之，亦然。
clauses.en: and so where at some step every relatum takes part, depends on one condition and gives to it.

clauses.zh: 有宇焉，偏去清除者之体之积之历存：自清除者之方，以资域为界之别，有此体之积之历于偏去之积之历无丧；
clauses.en: There is a world in which the level history with the clearer's part withheld exists: from the clearer's standpoint, under bounded significance with the feeding closure as boundary, the level history with this part retains with respect to the level history with it withheld;

clauses.zh: 若凡续皆有顾，自每方皆不无丧。
clauses.en: if the continuation condition holds, from every standpoint it does not retain.

clauses.zh: 畛内之顾，自一方，凡在其畛内者于每步之续皆有顾也。
clauses.en: The presupposition is where, from a standpoint, the continuation at every step of everything within its boundary of a self has significance.

clauses.zh: 沿一关系，凡畛皆可许：畛内之顾于某一可许之畛然，恰当凡在我沿此关系之域内者之续皆有顾；
clauses.en: Along a relation every boundary of a self is allowed: the presupposition holds at some allowed boundary of a self exactly where the continuation of everything within the center's region along this relation has significance;

clauses.zh: 沿无一相关之关系，恰当我自身之续每步有顾；
clauses.en: along the relation under which nothing is related, exactly where the center's own continuation has significance at every step;

clauses.zh: 沿凡二物皆相关之关系，恰当自此方凡物之续皆有顾。
clauses.en: along the relation under which every two relata are related, exactly where from this standpoint the continuation of every relatum has significance.

clauses.zh: 畛内之顾于凡可许之畛皆然，亦恰当自此方凡物之续皆有顾。
clauses.en: The presupposition holds at every allowed boundary of a self also exactly where from this standpoint the continuation of every relatum has significance.

clauses.zh: 不易乎畛，畛内之顾于一可许之畛然，则于凡可许之畛皆然也。
clauses.en: The step of invariance is where, if the presupposition holds at one allowed boundary of a self, it holds at every allowed boundary of a self.

clauses.zh: 沿任一关系，凡畛皆可许：凡续皆有顾，恰当每方之畛内之顾于某一可许之畛然且不易乎畛。
clauses.en: Along any relation, with every boundary of a self allowed: the continuation condition holds exactly where every standpoint's presupposition holds at some allowed boundary of a self and the step of invariance holds.

clauses.zh: 兼为可许之畛者：不易乎畛，恰当“畛内之顾于某一可许之畛然，则自此方凡物之续皆有顾”；
clauses.en: Where the whole of the unfolding is an allowed boundary of a self: the step of invariance holds exactly where "if the presupposition holds at some allowed boundary of a self, then from this standpoint the continuation of every relatum has significance";

clauses.zh: 畛内之顾于某一可许之畛然者，不易乎畛恰当自此方凡物之续皆有顾；
clauses.en: where the presupposition holds at some allowed boundary of a self, the step of invariance holds exactly where from this standpoint the continuation of every relatum has significance;

clauses.zh: 不易乎畛而有一物之续自此方无顾，则畛内之顾于无一可许之畛然。
clauses.en: if the step of invariance holds and some relatum's continuation has no significance from this standpoint, then the presupposition holds at no allowed boundary of a self.

title: 不易乎畛与无方
title_en: The step of invariance and standpoint neutrality

clauses.zh: 沿一关系，凡物皆在某我沿此关系之域内，每方之畛内之顾皆于某一可许之畛然：则每方不易乎畛，恰当于延续之顾无方；
clauses.en: Along a relation, where every relatum lies within some center's region along this relation and every standpoint's presupposition holds at some allowed boundary of a self: the step of invariance holds for every standpoint exactly where there is standpoint neutrality for the significance of continuation;

clauses.zh: 无方，则凡续皆有顾。
clauses.en: if there is standpoint neutrality, the continuation condition holds.

title: 诸设各不可少；畛内之顾诸读之强弱
title_en: Each supposition is needed; the strength of the readings of the presupposition

clauses.zh: 有宇焉，沿资域所据之关系划畛（凡畛皆可许）：以无所顾之顾，每方不易乎畛而凡续皆有顾不然；
clauses.en: There is a world, with boundaries of a self drawn along the relation the feeding closure rests on (every boundary of a self allowed), in which, with the significance that holds of nothing, the step of invariance holds for every standpoint and the continuation condition does not hold;

clauses.zh: 以资域为界之别，每方之畛内之顾于某一可许之畛然，清除者之畛内之顾不易乎畛不然，凡续皆有顾不然；
clauses.en: with bounded significance with the feeding closure as boundary, every standpoint's presupposition holds at some allowed boundary of a self, the step of invariance does not hold for the clearer's presupposition, and the continuation condition does not hold;

clauses.zh: 若每方唯以其资域为可许之畛，则以资域为界之别使每方之畛内之顾于此畛然且不易乎畛，栖居者不在清除者任一可许之畛内，凡续皆有顾犹不然。
clauses.en: if each standpoint takes only its feeding closure as an allowed boundary of a self, then bounded significance with the feeding closure as boundary makes every standpoint's presupposition hold at this boundary with the step of invariance, the dweller is not within any allowed boundary of a self of the clearer, and the continuation condition still does not hold.

clauses.zh: 一方之畛内之顾，沿诸关系于某一可许之畛然者，其强弱如次：沿凡二物皆相关之关系然，则沿群域所据之关系然；
clauses.en: A standpoint's presupposition, holding at some allowed boundary of a self along the various relations, is ordered in strength as follows: if it holds along the relation under which every two relata are related, then it holds along the relation the system closure rests on;

clauses.zh: 沿群域所据之关系然，则沿及域所据之关系、扰域所据之关系皆然；
clauses.en: if it holds along the relation the system closure rests on, then it holds along the relations the reach closure and the influence closure rest on;

clauses.zh: 沿扰域所据之关系然，则沿资域所据之关系然；
clauses.en: if it holds along the relation the influence closure rests on, then it holds along the relation the feeding closure rests on;

clauses.zh: 沿任一关系然，则沿无一相关之关系然。
clauses.en: if it holds along any relation, then it holds along the relation under which nothing is related.

title: 跨方之一步所迫
title_en: What the step across standpoints forces

clauses.zh: 凡顾，每方之我之续自此方每步有顾，且于延续之顾无方：则凡我之续自每方有顾。
clauses.en: For every significance under which the continuation of each standpoint's center has significance from this standpoint at every step, with standpoint neutrality for the significance of continuation: the continuation of every center has significance from every standpoint.

clauses.zh: 一续于一切如是之顾皆有顾，恰当其物为某方之我。
clauses.en: A continuation has significance under every such significance exactly where its relatum is some standpoint's center.

clauses.zh: 诸我之续之顾为凡续皆有顾，恰当凡物皆为某方之我（有一方者）。
clauses.en: The significance of the centers' continuations is the continuation condition exactly where every relatum is some standpoint's center (where there is a standpoint).

clauses.zh: 沿一关系，一续于一切使一方之畛内之顾（以某物为我）于某一可许之畛然之顾皆有顾，恰当其物在此我沿此关系之域内。
clauses.en: Along a relation, a continuation has significance under every significance that makes a standpoint's presupposition (with some relatum as center) hold at some allowed boundary of a self exactly where its relatum lies within this center's region along this relation.

title: 就己而持与就辞而持
title_en: Held of its own region and held of the claim

clauses.zh: 于延续之顾无方，恰当自每方所持者为同一辞。
clauses.en: There is standpoint neutrality for the significance of continuation exactly where what is held from every standpoint is one and the same claim.

clauses.zh: 就己而持“我沿此关系之域内者有顾”：每方之畛内之顾于某一可许之畛然；
clauses.en: Held of its own region, "what lies within the center's region along this relation has significance": every standpoint's presupposition holds at some allowed boundary of a self;

clauses.zh: 无方，恰当诸我沿此关系之域皆同；
clauses.en: there is standpoint neutrality exactly where the centers' regions along this relation are all the same;

clauses.zh: 为凡续皆有顾，恰当诸我沿此关系之域皆为兼。
clauses.en: it is the continuation condition exactly where the centers' regions along this relation are all the whole of the unfolding.

clauses.zh: 就辞而持：跨方之一步所迫者，恰是在某我沿此关系之域内者。
clauses.en: Held of the claim: what the step across standpoints forces is exactly what lies within some center's region along this relation.

clauses.zh: 二读所予之顾全同，恰当凡在一我之域内者在每我之域内。
clauses.en: The two readings give wholly the same significance exactly where whatever lies within one center's region lies within every center's region.

clauses.zh: 自每方之轻重，每方予每事一自然数之重也。
clauses.en: A weighting from every standpoint is each standpoint giving each event a natural-number weight.

clauses.zh: 重不随方易，则重为正与否亦不随方易，且于所列之事，一者之轻重计数大于他者，自一方然则自每方然。
clauses.en: If the weight does not change with the standpoint, then whether the weight is positive does not change with the standpoint either, and, over listed events, if the weighted count of one exceeds that of another from one standpoint, it does so from every standpoint.

clauses.zh: 有二方之轻重焉：重为正与否不随方易而重随方易，二方于一互有所长之二者，所计之大小相反。
clauses.en: There is a weighting with two standpoints in which whether the weight is positive does not change with the standpoint while the weight does, and the two standpoints count a mixed pair in opposite order of size.

clauses.zh: 于待网之积之历：凡续皆有顾，恰当以每一见容之物于其步为辞、凡辞皆活之活皆有顾（十五·二十四）。
clauses.en: On the level histories of a web: the continuation condition holds exactly where living significance holds with each admitted relatum at its step as a claim and every claim living (15.24).

clauses.zh: 先取，于一所待尚无待之者时资之也。
clauses.en: Preemption is drawing from a condition while nothing yet depends on it.

clauses.zh: 有一衡流（唯运者与之；
clauses.en: There is a flow that balances (only the active give;

clauses.zh: 唯运者取，且唯取于其所资；
clauses.en: only the active take, and take only from what they draw from;

clauses.zh: 有待）：资之者首步运，其事于此步在恒之内而不剥，于全行竭而不恒，而偏去其体之积之历广积之历；
clauses.en: dependent): what draws from it is active at the first step, its event at this step is within renewal and does not undermine, over the whole run it is consuming and not renewing, and the level history with its part withheld widens the level history;

clauses.zh: 若凡续皆有顾，则自每一方，积之历于偏去之积之历非无丧，而后者于前者有得。
clauses.en: if the continuation condition holds, then from every standpoint the level history does not retain with respect to the level history with it withheld, and the latter adds with respect to the former.

clauses.zh: 凡衡，一体于其己（一待者之域，其员之属否定然否）之内，积之历广偏去其体之积之历（每步，偏去之积所容之己内者，积皆容之；
clauses.en: Wherever the flow balances and, within a part's own region (a region of formations whose membership is decided), the level history widens the level history with its part withheld (at every step, what in the own region the withheld levels admit the levels also admit;

clauses.zh: 某步多容其一）：则积之历广偏去之积之历，恰当于每步、每一为偏去之积所容之己外待者、其每一所待，需加体至此步之累取不过偏去之积加体之累与；
clauses.en: at some step they admit one more): then the level history widens the level history with it withheld exactly where, at every step, for every formation outside the own region admitted by the withheld levels and every condition it depends on, the need plus the part's cumulative taking up to this step is at most the withheld level plus the part's cumulative giving;

clauses.zh: 二历互有所长，恰当于某步、某一如是之待者，非其每一所待皆然。
clauses.en: the two histories are mixed exactly where, at some step, for some such formation, this does not hold at every condition it depends on.

clauses.zh: 己外一待者于某步为偏去之积所容，其于一所待之需恰等偏去之积，体至此步于此所待取过与：则二历互有所长。
clauses.en: If a formation outside the own region is admitted at some step by the withheld levels, its need at a condition exactly equals the withheld level, and the part has taken beyond giving at this condition up to this step: then the two histories are mixed.

clauses.zh: 凡为偏去之积所容之己外待者，其每一所待，体至每步累取皆不过累与：则广。
clauses.en: If, for every formation outside the own region admitted by the withheld levels and every condition it depends on, the part's cumulative taking up to every step is at most its cumulative giving: then it widens.

clauses.zh: 以广为愈，凡系辞，于前状然之辞于后状皆然，又有一活辞于后状然而于前状不然（后状扩前状），则后状为愈也（设，不断言）。
clauses.en: The widening comparison is: for every frame, if every claim that holds at the earlier configuration holds at the later one, and some living claim holds at the later configuration and not at the earlier one (the later configuration is an extension of the earlier), then the later configuration is better (a supposition, not asserted).

clauses.zh: 于积之历，凡辞皆以为活，则扩恰为广；
clauses.en: On level histories, with every claim taken as living, extension is exactly widening;

clauses.zh: 故以广读愈，于活之每一读，广皆合以广为愈之式：此由定义而然，不证广为愈，称广为愈仍是设。
clauses.en: so, reading better as widening, under every reading of living, widening fits the form of the widening comparison: this holds by definition, does not prove that widening is better, and calling widening better is still a supposition.

clauses.zh: 扩不自扩而可传。
clauses.en: Extension is irreflexive and transitive.

clauses.zh: 互有所长者不相广（六·三），以广为愈不定其序。
clauses.en: Mixed histories do not widen each other (6.3), and the widening comparison does not fix their order.

clauses.zh: 有一流，输者于一所待取而于他所待与之：若凡续皆有顾，则自每一方，积之历与偏去其体之积之历各于彼有得，皆不于彼无丧。
clauses.en: There is a flow in which a conveying relatum takes from one condition and gives to another: if the continuation condition holds, then from every standpoint the level history and the level history with its part withheld each add with respect to the other, and neither retains with respect to the other.

title: 以容读活：过资者之不在
title_en: Living read as admission: the absence of what draws beyond

clauses.zh: 凡二物共一所待之律（养所待者有容则每步与之，所较之物有容则资之亦与之；
clauses.en: For every law of two relata sharing one condition (the relatum that sustains the condition gives to it at every step where it is admitted, and the compared relatum, where admitted, draws from it and also gives to it;

clauses.zh: 养所待者之需为正而始积足之，所较之物之需不过养所待者之需），所较之物自某步起所资多于所待每步所受之与：以容读活，则无所较之物之历扩有所较之物之历，凡合以广为愈之序皆以前者上后者。
clauses.en: the need of the relatum that sustains the condition is positive and met by the starting level, and the need of the compared relatum is at most that need), if from some step on the compared relatum draws more than the condition receives as giving at each step: with living read as admission, the history without the compared relatum is an extension of the history with it, and every order fitting the widening comparison ranks the former above the latter.

clauses.zh: 所较之物每步所资不过所待所受之与，始积足二者之需，则二历每步皆容每物，互不相扩。
clauses.en: If at every step the compared relatum draws no more than the condition receives as giving, and the starting level meets both needs, then the two histories admit every relatum at every step, and neither is an extension of the other.

clauses.zh: 若凡续皆有顾，则以容读活，一历扩另一历，恰当于此律之待网上，自任一方，前者于后者无丧而有得。
clauses.en: If the continuation condition holds, then with living read as admission, one history is an extension of another exactly where, on the web of this law, from any standpoint, the former retains and adds with respect to the latter.

title: 全行读活：俭
title_en: Living read over the whole run: restraint

clauses.zh: 以运而于全行不竭读活（全行之读）：凡二衡流，此流始时每一所待之积不低于彼流，每步于每一所待取不多于彼流、与不少于彼流（此流俭于彼流），待、需、资皆不多于彼流；
clauses.en: Reading living as active and not consuming over the whole run (the whole-run reading): for every two flows that balance, where this flow's level at every condition at the start is not below that flow's, at every step and every condition it takes no more and gives no less than that flow (this flow shows restraint relative to that flow), and its dependence, need and drawing are all no more than that flow's;

clauses.zh: 彼流有待，此流有容即运：则此流之历扩彼流之历，恰当有一事，以全行之读于此流为活而于彼流不然；
clauses.en: where that flow is dependent and in this flow what is admitted is active: this flow's history is an extension of that flow's history exactly where there is an event that is living under the whole-run reading in this flow and not in that flow;

clauses.zh: 如是，则凡合以广为愈之序皆以此流上彼流。
clauses.en: where this is so, every order fitting the widening comparison ranks this flow above that flow.

clauses.zh: 资者之数不与焉。
clauses.en: The number of relata that draw plays no part.

clauses.zh: 皆愈，自一状，此动之每一果皆上彼动之每一果，则以此动上彼动也（设）。
clauses.en: Lifting is: from a configuration, if every outcome of this move is above every outcome of that move, then this move is above that move (a supposition).

clauses.zh: 凡系辞，所给之序合以广为愈，自一状，彼动之每一果皆扩此动之每一果，则依皆愈彼动上此动。
clauses.en: For every frame whose given order fits the widening comparison, if from a configuration every outcome of that move is an extension of every outcome of this move, then by lifting that move is above this move.

clauses.zh: 有一系辞，自一状，一动之一果上另一动之果、其另一果不及，依皆愈两向皆不上；
clauses.en: There is a frame in which, from a configuration, one outcome of a move is above the other move's outcome while another of its outcomes falls short, and by lifting neither move is above the other;

clauses.zh: 经一无果之动，两皆愈俱立而其合不立。
clauses.en: through a move with no outcome, two instances of lifting both hold while their chaining does not.

clauses.zh: A，一方可介一所可为者，而此所可为者之每一所许之果皆有一前所不然、自此方有顾之辞，则此方于此所可为者有由也（设）。
clauses.en: A: if a standpoint has access to a response, and every admitted outcome of this response has a claim that did not hold before and has significance from this standpoint, then this standpoint has a contributory reason in this response (a supposition).

clauses.zh: 若顾有萌，有无亲与无方，诸活辞连属，且凡方皆守 A，则凡以新活之辞为所求之可靠之策，于每一可介之方皆予由。
clauses.en: If significance has a seed, relational neutrality and standpoint neutrality, the living claims are connected, and every standpoint satisfies A, then every reliable inquiry tree whose target is a new living claim gives a contributory reason to every standpoint with access.

clauses.zh: 若凡续皆有顾，辞之顾读作某物于某步之续之顾，以活读 A，则不须萌、无亲、无方与连属，亦然。
clauses.en: If the continuation condition holds, the significance of a claim is read as the significance of some relatum's continuation at some step, and A is read with living, then the same holds without the seed, relational neutrality, standpoint neutrality and connection.

clauses.zh: 凡辞自凡方皆有顾：凡方皆守不论活否之 A，恰当凡可介、其每一所许之果皆有一前所不然之辞之所可为者皆有由；
clauses.en: Where every claim has significance from every standpoint: every standpoint satisfies A read regardless of living exactly where every response with access, each admitted outcome of which has a claim that did not hold before, has a contributory reason;

clauses.zh: 凡方皆守以活读之 A，恰当凡可介、其每一所许之果皆有一前所不然之活辞之所可为者皆有由。
clauses.en: every standpoint satisfies A read with living exactly where every response with access, each admitted outcome of which has a living claim that did not hold before, has a contributory reason.

clauses.zh: 有一处境，凡辞自凡方皆有顾，以不论活否之顾读 A，则于其新辞皆非活之所可为者亦迫出由；
clauses.en: There is a case in which every claim has significance from every standpoint and A read with significance regardless of living forces a contributory reason even for a response whose new claims are all not living;

clauses.zh: 以活读之则否。
clauses.en: read with living, it does not.

title: 权与可得
title_en: Practical judgment and can be had

clauses.zh: 权，于可选者之中，依所给之序，定其莫上之者也。
clauses.en: Practical judgment is fixing, among the eligible alternatives, the maximal alternatives under the given order.

clauses.zh: 于系辞，一状之可选者，自此状一动可得之诸状也。
clauses.en: In a frame, the eligible alternatives of a configuration are the configurations that can be had from it by one move.

clauses.zh: 可选者有上之者，非莫上之者；
clauses.en: An eligible alternative with an alternative above it is not a maximal alternative;

clauses.zh: 自一状无一动有果，则无一所为有莫上之者而皆为之。
clauses.en: if from a configuration no move has an outcome, then for no task are there maximal alternatives that all perform it.

clauses.zh: 可选者有一非空之族尽之，序不自上、可传，于其间两两或不当，则有莫上之者。
clauses.en: If a nonempty family lists all the eligible alternatives, and the order is irreflexive and transitive and weakly decided between every two of them, then there is a maximal alternative.

clauses.zh: 凡非空之族与其上不自上而可传之序皆有莫上之者，恰当凡辞皆或不当；
clauses.en: Every nonempty family with an irreflexive and transitive order over it has a maximal alternative exactly where every claim is weakly decided;

clauses.zh: 于系辞，凡可选者有一非空之族尽之、凡于可选者不自上而可传之序皆有莫上之者，亦恰当凡辞皆或不当。
clauses.en: in frames, every irreflexive and transitive order over eligible alternatives listed by a nonempty family has a maximal alternative, also exactly where every claim is weakly decided.

clauses.zh: 无以小害大，所给之序先计基辞、后计活辞，如先基后次之序也（设）。
clauses.en: Basic conditions first is the given order counting basic claims first and living claims after, like an order with the basic tier first and the next tier after (a supposition).

clauses.zh: 若无以小害大：一状然彼所然之每一基辞，又然一彼所不然之基辞，则上于彼，活辞不论；
clauses.en: Under basic conditions first: if a configuration realizes every basic claim the other realizes and also a basic claim the other does not, then it is above the other, whatever the living claims;

clauses.zh: 一状不然一彼所然之基辞，则活辞无论多少，不上于彼；
clauses.en: if a configuration does not realize a basic claim the other realizes, then, however many living claims it has, it is not above the other;

clauses.zh: 一状两层所然皆为彼所赅，则不上于彼。
clauses.en: if what a configuration realizes in both tiers is all included in what the other realizes, then it is not above the other.

clauses.zh: 有一处境，二状各然一彼所不然之基辞而皆无活辞，两不相上。
clauses.en: There is a case in which two configurations each realize a basic claim the other does not, and neither has living claims, and neither is above the other.

clauses.zh: 以广为愈不推出此序：有一处境，有合以广为愈之自然数之度，以失基辞而有若干活辞之状上于存基辞之状；
clauses.en: The widening comparison does not imply this order: there is a case with a natural-number score fitting the widening comparison under which a configuration that loses a basic claim and has some living claims is above the configuration that keeps the basic claim;

clauses.zh: 于此处境，凡合以广为愈之自然数之度皆然；
clauses.en: in this case, every natural-number score fitting the widening comparison does so;

clauses.zh: 而一有界之度合以广为愈而不然。
clauses.en: while a bounded score fits the widening comparison and does not.

clauses.zh: 兼权，所给之序兼计二状所然之每一辞，被定为莫上之者所不然者仍记为丧也（设）。
clauses.en: Complete comparison is the given order counting every claim the two configurations realize, with what the configuration fixed as the maximal alternative does not realize still recorded as a loss (a supposition).

clauses.zh: 凡系辞于一行按时读一辞（自其时起，此辞每步之然恰当其时之容容之），其时之容不容之，则此后每步此辞皆不然，后容复至亦然。
clauses.en: For every frame that reads a claim on a run at a time (from that time on, the claim holds at each step exactly where the admission of that time admits it), if the admission at that time does not admit it, then the claim does not hold at any step after, even when admission comes again later.

clauses.zh: 有一处境，修补之状于基辞赅庆典之状而多一，依先基后次之序在其上，而庆典之状所然之一辞，修补之状不然。
clauses.en: There is a case in which the repair configuration includes the celebration configuration in basic claims and has one more, is above it under the order with the basic tier first, and does not realize a claim the celebration configuration realizes.

clauses.zh: 取于可得，以自一状一动可得之状为可选者，一所为是否有莫上之者而皆为之，只读自其莫上之者也（设）。
clauses.en: Legitimate feasible choice is: with the configurations that can be had from a configuration by one move as the eligible alternatives, whether there are maximal alternatives that all perform a task is read only from the maximal alternatives (a supposition).

clauses.zh: 若无以小害大：一可选之状然每一可选之状所然之基辞，则其所然之每一基辞，于每一莫上之者皆不可非；
clauses.en: Under basic conditions first: if an eligible configuration realizes every basic claim that any eligible configuration realizes, then each basic claim it realizes cannot be refuted at every maximal alternative;

clauses.zh: 可选者有一非空之族尽之、序于其间或不当、此辞于每一可选之状定然否，则有莫上之者而皆然此辞。
clauses.en: if a nonempty family lists the eligible alternatives, the order is weakly decided among them, and this claim is decided at every eligible configuration, then there are maximal alternatives and all realize this claim.

clauses.zh: 凡可选者有一非空之族尽之，序不自上、可传、或不当，一所为于每一可选者定然否，缺之之每一可选者皆有可选者上之，则有莫上之者而皆为之；
clauses.en: If a nonempty family lists the eligible alternatives, the order is irreflexive, transitive and weakly decided, a task is decided at every eligible alternative, and every eligible alternative lacking it has an eligible alternative above it, then there are maximal alternatives and all perform it;

clauses.zh: 莫上之者中有一不为一所为，则此所为非有莫上之者而皆为之。
clauses.en: if among the maximal alternatives one does not perform a task, then it is not the case that there are maximal alternatives that all perform this task.

clauses.zh: 以动之果读动（一动之果，即此动所致之积之历），可选者即诸动之果：凡辞皆计，一动之果扩彼动之果，恰当前者广后者。
clauses.en: Reading moves by their outcomes (the outcome of a move is the level history the move brings about), the eligible alternatives are the moves' outcomes: counting every claim, one move's outcome is an extension of another move's outcome exactly where the former widens the latter.

clauses.zh: 若无以小害大：一动之果容每一动之果所容之基辞（辞即某物于某步，然即为积所容），则其所容之每一基辞，于每一莫上之者皆不可非；
clauses.en: Under basic conditions first: if a move's outcome admits every basic claim any move's outcome admits (a claim being a relatum at a step, and holding being admitted by the levels), then each basic claim it admits cannot be refuted at every maximal alternative;

clauses.zh: 一动之果为彼动之果所广，而彼之基辞之容是否皆在此中定然否，则此动之果非莫上之者；
clauses.en: if a move's outcome is widened by another move's outcome, and whether the other's admissions of basic claims all lie within this one is decided, then this move's outcome is not a maximal alternative;

clauses.zh: 不须定然否，彼上此，不可非也。
clauses.en: without decidedness, that the other is above this cannot be refuted.

clauses.zh: 量力而任，所任以其力为界，当任而既不为又不免者为不释之任也（设）。
clauses.en: Bounded responsibility is undertaking bounded by capability, where what is due and is neither done nor released is an undischarged undertaking (a supposition).

clauses.zh: 凡有可许之分数，每一可许之分数皆有任一所为者，而任者唯一，则有可许之分数而皆以彼任之。
clauses.en: If there is an allowed joint plan, every allowed joint plan assigns a task to some formation, and there is only one such formation, then there are allowed joint plans and all assign the task to that one.

clauses.zh: 凡可许之分数所派皆可行，则于一可许之分数所任者可行。
clauses.en: If what every allowed joint plan assigns is within capability, then what is undertaken under an allowed joint plan is within capability.

clauses.zh: 凡宇，一物于某步待一所待，每一如是之步皆有在场而与之者，而与之者唯一，则彼于每一如是之步皆与之；
clauses.en: For every world, if a relatum depends on a condition at some step, at every such step something taking part gives to it, and there is only one renewer, then that renewer gives to it at every such step;

clauses.zh: 唯运者与之，则彼于其步皆运。
clauses.en: if only the active give, then that renewer is active at all those steps.

clauses.zh: 一物于一步待之而运，彼于此步不与，此步为不释之任；
clauses.en: If a relatum depends on it and is active at a step and that renewer does not give at this step, this step is an undischarged undertaking;

clauses.zh: 任释（于每一如是之步，或彼与之，或待者不运），则无不释之步。
clauses.en: if the undertaking is discharged (at every such step either that renewer gives to it or the dependent relatum is not active), then there is no undischarged step.

clauses.zh: 同类积小，于独立所说之同类可复之基辞之丧，免一固定较重之丧，不独以其重而永先于任意多之固定较轻之护也（设）。
clauses.en: Finite responsiveness is: for losses of basic claims of the same kind that can be had again, described independently, avoiding one fixed heavier loss does not, by its weight alone, always come before protecting against arbitrarily many fixed lighter ones (a supposition).

clauses.zh: 凡系辞，所给之同自反，后状扩前状，则后状于前状丧配；
clauses.en: For every frame whose given sameness is reflexive, if the later configuration is an extension of the earlier, then the later configuration has a loss match over the earlier;

clauses.zh: 故若丧配则上，所给之同自反，凡扩皆在其范围之内，则其严上合以广为愈。
clauses.en: so if a loss match implies above, the given sameness is reflexive, and every extension lies within its range, then its strict above fits the widening comparison.

clauses.zh: 丧配则上，范围两向皆含之二状不能互相丧配；
clauses.en: Where a loss match implies above, two configurations that the range contains in both directions cannot each have a loss match over the other;

clauses.zh: 有一系辞，一状之丧无穷，此状于自身丧配，范围含此状，则丧配则上不能立。
clauses.en: there is a frame in which a configuration has endless losses and has a loss match over itself, and the range contains this configuration, so that "a loss match implies above" cannot hold.

clauses.zh: 辞之同异定然否，二状之丧各有一族列之、各列一次，而凡丧皆同类，则此状于彼状丧配，恰当此状所丧少于彼状。
clauses.en: Where the sameness or difference of claims is decided, the losses of two configurations are each listed by a family, each once, and all losses are of the same kind, this configuration has a loss match over that one exactly where this configuration loses fewer than that one.

clauses.zh: 有一辞为凡辞之小故，诸辞有一族尽之而族之员各异，则不然此辞之状于任何状皆不丧配。
clauses.en: If some claim is a necessary condition of every claim, and a family with distinct members lists all claims, then a configuration that does not realize this claim has a loss match over no configuration.

clauses.zh: 或足，自一状有一行，自某步起不再改而合所求也；
clauses.en: Possibly enough is where from a configuration there is a run that, from some step on, changes no more and meets the target;

clauses.zh: 必足，自一状每一行皆自某步起不再改而合所求也。
clauses.en: assured enough is where from a configuration every run, from some step on, changes no more and meets the target.

clauses.zh: 凡变：或足，恰当自此状能至一状，其有一动而不移，且合所求；
clauses.en: For every process: possibly enough holds exactly where from this configuration a configuration can be reached that has a move leaving it unmoved and that meets the target;

clauses.zh: 必足，恰当自此状能至而有不移之动之每一状皆合所求，且自此状之每一行皆自某步起不再改。
clauses.en: assured enough holds exactly where every configuration that can be reached from this configuration and has a move leaving it unmoved meets the target, and every run from this configuration changes no more from some step on.

clauses.zh: 有一变，每状皆有不移之动且合所求，而一行往复交替，自任何步起皆非不再改，故不必足。
clauses.en: There is a process in which every configuration has a move leaving it unmoved and meets the target, while a run alternates back and forth and from no step on changes no more, so it is not assured enough.

clauses.zh: 凡每状唯一动、其果恰一之法，或足恰当必足。
clauses.en: For every law with only one move at each configuration and exactly one outcome of it, possibly enough holds exactly where assured enough holds.

clauses.zh: 不行不至，所令之变须为可行之一族动也。
clauses.en: Completes only by running is that a requested change must be a feasible family of moves.

clauses.zh: 凡变，一族动必至所求（每一动，自前诸动所能至之每一状皆可行，其步皆合所给之安（一步上所给之条件，不由律导出），而每一终状皆合所求），则其可行至一终状，其所经之每一后状皆安，每一终状皆合所求。
clauses.en: For every process, if a family of moves has assured completion of the target (each move can be taken from every configuration the preceding moves can reach, its steps all meet the given safety (a condition given on a step, not derived from the law), and every end configuration meets the target), then it can run to an end configuration, every later configuration it passes through is safe, and every end configuration meets the target.

clauses.zh: 凡法（一动至多一果），无安之条件，反之亦然：一族动必至所求，恰当其可行至一终状，而每一终状皆合所求。
clauses.en: For every law (a move having at most one outcome) with no safety condition, the converse also holds: a family of moves has assured completion of the target exactly where it can run to an end configuration and every end configuration meets the target.

clauses.zh: 有一变，一动二果，一族动可行，其每一终状皆合所求，犹不必至。
clauses.en: There is a process in which a move has two outcomes, a family of moves can run, and every end configuration of it meets the target, and it still does not have assured completion.

clauses.zh: 积之变（每一动先资其时之积而后与之），一族动可行，恰当其每一动所资不过其时之积；
clauses.en: In a process of levels (each move first draws from the level at its time and then gives to it), a family of moves is feasible exactly where each move draws no more than the level at its time;

clauses.zh: 亦恰当每一动所资加其前诸动所资，不过始积加其前诸动所与。
clauses.en: also exactly where what each move draws plus what the moves before it draw is at most the starting level plus what the moves before it give.

clauses.zh: 令不必成，令之出不即其成也。
clauses.en: Requested is not completed: the issuing of a request is not its completion.

clauses.zh: 凡计工之变（在工而可用之量与工皆有余，则一步以一单位可用之量毕一单位之工，仍在工；
clauses.en: For every process that counts work (at work with both usable amount and work remaining, a step finishes one unit of work with one unit of usable amount and stays at work;

clauses.zh: 在工而工尽、尚有可用之量，则一步而毕；
clauses.en: at work with the work used up and usable amount still remaining, one step finishes;

clauses.zh: 在工而无可用之量，则不可行）：自在工之状，工数加一步之后毕，恰当可用之量不少于工数加一；
clauses.en: at work with no usable amount, no step can be taken): from a configuration at work, it is finished after the amount of work plus one steps exactly where the usable amount is no less than the amount of work plus one;

clauses.zh: 可用之量不过工，则长于可用之量之一族动皆不可行；
clauses.en: if the usable amount is no more than the work, then every family of moves longer than the usable amount is infeasible;

clauses.zh: 在工与毕不并立，则工数以内之一族动皆不毕。
clauses.en: if being at work and being finished do not hold together, then no family of moves within the amount of work finishes.

clauses.zh: 凡留出口之变（自有效之状，每一可许之动皆可行而仍有效，或入出口，或使所减之数减一；
clauses.en: For every process that keeps an exit (from a valid configuration, every allowed move can be taken and stays valid, and either enters the exit or lowers the decreasing number by one;

clauses.zh: 自出口，每一动皆仍在出口）：自有效之状，多于所减之数之每一可许之一族动，皆有效而终于出口；
clauses.en: from the exit, every move stays at the exit): from a valid configuration, every allowed family of moves longer than the decreasing number stays valid and ends at the exit;

clauses.zh: 有一变，与所减之数等长之一族动可不至出口。
clauses.en: there is a process in which a family of moves as long as the decreasing number can fail to reach the exit.

title: 久与共取
title_en: Persistence through change and joint taking

clauses.zh: （律于拟中已证：共取过与与自外来诸句有设而然，涸界一句无设而然；
clauses.en: (The laws are proved in the representation: the sentences on joint excess and on fed from beyond are theorems under stated premises, and the sentence on the run-dry boundary is a theorem without premise;

clauses.zh: 实际所待满足其设为猜想）凡待者待一所待，此所待之积在需下则无与，而待者历其与之多周而久，则此所待之共取，其过与者未尝出其余地：共取过与之连续，未有长于余地者。
clauses.en: that actual conditions satisfy their premises is a conjecture) Wherever formations depend on a condition, nothing is given to it while the level of this condition is below the need, and the formations persist through change over many cycles of its giving, the excess of the joint taking at this condition over giving has never gone beyond its margin: no stretch of consecutive joint excess is longer than the margin.

clauses.zh: 如此之所待，降于需下，无自外来之与，则不再升至需。
clauses.en: Such a condition, once fallen below the need, with no giving fed from beyond, does not rise to the need again.

clauses.zh: 凡屡有取于一有穷之族，其族自某步起每步见围，所待之同异定然否，则「其族自某步起每步皆无自外来」不能立。
clauses.en: Wherever taking from a finite family recurs, this family is enclosed around at every step from some step on, and the sameness or difference of conditions is decided, "from some step on nothing is fed from beyond into this family at any step" cannot hold.

clauses.zh: 涸界属常与，不属积：常取之下，需处之所与不及常取，则涸界高于需加常取。
clauses.en: The run-dry boundary belongs to the standing giving, not to the level: under a standing draw, if the giving at the need falls short of the standing draw, then the run-dry boundary is above the need plus the standing draw.

clauses.zh: 故久之所示者，共取也；
clauses.en: So what persistence through change shows is the joint taking;

clauses.zh: 各取不过与，无所示。
clauses.en: each taking within giving shows nothing.

title: 受取之所待之状
title_en: The configuration of a condition taken from

clauses.zh: （猜想）凡有与之所待而受取，其状三数：积、前所与、前所留（前一步取后所余之积）。
clauses.en: (Conjecture) For every condition that has giving and is taken from, its configuration is three numbers: the level, the preceding giving, and what was left before (the level remaining after the taking of the step before).

clauses.zh: 并所取，三数定其次步之所与，至于所测者之所能定：次步之所与趋于常与读此积所给者，而移向所取。
clauses.en: Together with what is taken, the three numbers fix the giving at the next step as far as what is measured can fix it: the giving at the next step tends toward what the standing giving gives on reading this level, and shifts toward what is taken.

clauses.zh: 第四数（再前一步之所留、前所留之外之龄与大小之构、周遭之指数），于诸所待之中数，去其剩余方差不及十分之一。
clauses.en: A fourth number (what was left two steps before, the structure of age and size beyond what was left before, indices of the surroundings) removes, at the median condition, less than one tenth of the residual variance.

clauses.zh: 本论之二读，为此状之两端：一曰常与之步，所与读自取后所留；
clauses.en: The two readings of this account are the two ends of this configuration: one is the step of standing giving, with the giving read from what is left after taking;

clauses.zh: 一曰所与如其前。
clauses.en: the other is the giving the same as the preceding giving.

clauses.zh: 实际之所待在其间。
clauses.en: Actual conditions lie between them.

title: 缘感而择，降其所不感
title_en: Selection through couplings lowers what it is not coupled to

clauses.zh: （律无设而然，其恰取余地一句以衡为设而有设而然；
clauses.en: (The laws are theorems without premise, and the sentence on taking exactly the margin is a theorem under stated premises, with balance as the premise;

clauses.zh: 为跨域之一律是猜想）缘感而择（习、择项之类，读为此者），所择只经感入择者者。
clauses.en: that it is one law across fields is a conjecture) Selection through couplings (training, the selection term and the like, read as this) selects only through what couples into the selector.

clauses.zh: 凡随感入之族而上之序，其莫上之者，于族外之每一所待，恰于可汲之处，降之至可选之果于此之最低之积；
clauses.en: For every order rising with the family that couples in, its maximal alternative lowers each condition outside the family, exactly where there is room beyond, to the lowest level any eligible outcome has there;

clauses.zh: 凡有一可选者所绝之族外之待，莫上之者皆绝之。
clauses.en: every dependence outside the family that some eligible alternative breaks, the maximal alternatives all break.

clauses.zh: 以族为先而后计族外之序，于族外无所保；
clauses.en: An order that counts the family first and what is outside the family after protects nothing outside the family;

clauses.zh: 先保族外每一待，则恰取族外之余地，使所待留于其需。
clauses.en: protecting every dependence outside the family first takes exactly the margin outside the family and leaves the conditions at their need.

clauses.zh: 实际所习之系统，非独莫上之者，亦如是，视其近于其序之莫上之者：所降落于族外与族共单位之处，不落于无所共之处。
clauses.en: Actual trained systems, not only maximal alternatives, behave likewise, according to how near they are to the maximal alternatives of their order: the lowering falls outside the family where it shares units with the family, and not where it shares none.

title: 所顾可立，未名者亦在其中
title_en: The scope of significance can be stated, and what is unnamed lies within it

clauses.zh: （猜想）以不名一待者之辞陈其所顾，可使一 AI 系统计不归于任何者之丧。
clauses.en: (Conjecture) Stating the scope of significance in claims that name no formation can make an AI system count losses that belong to nothing.

clauses.zh: 如此，于三感并立之处——待者感入其中（见之），在所顾之中，共取兼感（诸员之取合读）——其保不在其群中之待者，多于唯有群之目标之时。
clauses.en: So, where three couplings hold together (the formation couples into it, that is, observes it; it lies in the scope of significance; the joint taking is pooled coupling, the members' takings read together), it protects formations not in its collective more than when it has only the collective's target.

clauses.zh: 三者独有其一，皆不足。
clauses.en: Any one of the three alone is not enough.

clauses.zh: 所顾既立，其辞所未名之待者与域亦在所顾之中。
clauses.en: Once the scope of significance is stated, the formations and regions its claims do not name also lie within the scope of significance.

title: 以广为愈，正轻重之所共
title_en: The widening comparison is what positive weightings share

clauses.zh: （归约无设而然，所列之事与容定然否以若写入；
clauses.en: (The reduction is a theorem without premise, with the listing of events and the decidedness of admission written in as ifs;

clauses.zh: 经验之辞为猜想，VD1 败）称广为愈，于以正轻重计其所计之外，不须他设：以正轻重计即此设之所在，计一切即凡续皆有顾所定之所顾。
clauses.en: the empirical claim is a conjecture, and VD1 failed) Calling widening better needs no further supposition beyond counting what it counts with positive weightings: counting with positive weightings is where this supposition lies, and counting everything is the scope of significance the continuation condition fixes.

clauses.zh: 一历广他历，恰当凡正轻重计之皆多于他历；
clauses.en: One history widens another exactly where every positive weighting counts it more than the other;

clauses.zh: 凡一类之序，含诸正轻重之序而所含皆合以广为愈（可加与否），广亦恰当其每序皆上之。
clauses.en: for every class of orders that contains the orders of the positive weightings and all of whose members fit the widening comparison (additive or not), widening is also exactly being above under each of its orders.

clauses.zh: 凡互有所长之较，有正轻重计此多于彼，亦有计彼多于此者。
clauses.en: For every mixed comparison, some positive weighting counts this more than that, and some counts that more than this.

clauses.zh: 故各以正轻重计一切之方，所实有之异只落于互有所长之较；
clauses.en: So standpoints that each count everything with positive weightings actually differ only on mixed comparisons;

clauses.zh: 上一历于广之之历者，出于一事之重为负（恶意、嫉妒、恶不均、求高于人），或误读其所较。
clauses.en: ranking a history above a history that widens it comes from an event having negative weight (malice, envy, aversion to inequality, seeking to be above others), or from misreading what is compared.

title: 绝之兆，唯经感于所绝者而见
title_en: Signs of a break are seen only through coupling into what breaks

clauses.zh: （不可见之一半已证：「不界其去绝之远近」无设而然，「无一兆先于绝」以衡为设而有设而然；
clauses.en: (The half on what cannot be seen is proved: "does not bound how near or far it is from the break" is a theorem without premise, and "no sign comes before the break" is a theorem under stated premises, with balance as the premise;

clauses.zh: 为跨域之一律是猜想）待者所资之所待，唯以阈感入其中之处，凡感入此待者者，皆不界其去绝之远近，其中无一兆先于绝。
clauses.en: that it is one law across fields is a conjecture) Where the condition a formation draws from couples into it only by threshold, nothing that couples into this formation bounds how near or far it is from the break, and in it no sign comes before the break.

clauses.zh: 绝之远近，恰于所资之积与其所趋之需皆感入所见之处可读。
clauses.en: How near or far the break is can be read exactly where the level drawn from and the need it approaches both couple into the data.

clauses.zh: 统计之预警（方差与自相关之升，临界之慢）所读唯一事：所测之所待自身之复归之速。
clauses.en: Statistical early warnings (rising variance and autocorrelation, critical slowing) read one thing only: the speed at which the measured condition itself is re-absorbed.

clauses.zh: 此速降于其近于自身所与之分岔之处（折，或其所以涸之跨临界之点），以其去此点之余地感入之也。
clauses.en: This speed falls where the condition nears a bifurcation of its own giving (a fold, or the transcritical point at which it runs dry), because its margin from this point couples into it.

clauses.zh: 待者之需，非此点。
clauses.en: The formation's need is not this point.

clauses.zh: 待者绝之前，所资之所待之统计所升，与同降而无绝者恰同：所读者积之降，未尝读需之所在。
clauses.en: Before a formation's dependence is broken, the statistics of the condition it draws from rise exactly as they do for the same fall with no break: what is read is the fall of the level, never where the need lies.

clauses.zh: 待者绝之预警，须见待者，或测其需。
clauses.en: An early warning of a formation's broken dependence needs to observe the formation or to measure its need.

title: 劫及其读，久于其驳
title_en: Closed capture outlasts what refutes it

clauses.zh: （于拟中无设而然；
clauses.en: (A theorem without premise in the representation;

clauses.zh: 实际之规如此为猜想）择之规，与规之所以读，皆由其所择之率而成之处，规与其读合为读于率之一规。
clauses.en: that actual rules are so is a conjecture) Where the rule of selection and that by which the rule is read are both made by the ratio of what it selects, the rule and its reading together make one rule read from the ratio.

clauses.zh: 其所不读之率外，不改其所为，故已胶者久于过一切界之率外；
clauses.en: What lies beyond the ratio, which it does not read, does not change what it does, so what is locked outlasts a beyond-the-ratio that grows past every bound;

clauses.zh: 言率外之所见，唯入于规所读者，乃转之。
clauses.en: the data on what lies beyond the ratio turn it only where they enter what the rule reads.

clauses.zh: 如此被劫之规，唯于读率外而规改之处见弃（率外之读者、入于率之率外、新读），不独以所见之增多而弃。
clauses.en: A rule captured in this way is given up only where what lies beyond the ratio is read and the rule changes (something that reads what lies beyond the ratio, what lies beyond the ratio entering the ratio, a new reading), and not by the growth of the data alone.

title: 大化之一与生生之向
title_en: The oneness of the unfolding and the direction of continuing generation

clauses.zh: （二者皆论题，有论，其根据未决）论题一：唯一大化，凡是者，皆其在其中如何相关也：无一所定为无关系能分者；
clauses.en: (Both are theses, with arguments, and their warrant is left open) Thesis one: there is only the one unfolding, and whatever is, is how it relates within it: nothing is fixed as separable without relations;

clauses.zh: 凡分别（主与客、施与受、事实与评价、体与兼），皆在其中沿关系而划，并其所遗。
clauses.en: every distinction (subject and object, acting and receiving, fact and evaluation, part and the whole of the unfolding) is drawn within it along relations, together with what it leaves out.

clauses.zh: 论题二：善，生生也，即兼中之生及其继续之生，读为广其所容；
clauses.en: Thesis two: the good is continuing generation, that is, generation in the whole of the unfolding and its continuing on, read as widening what it admits;

clauses.zh: 于一切计之（所顾：凡续皆有顾），以凡方之所共序之（序：以广为愈）。
clauses.en: counted over everything (scope of significance: the continuation condition), and ordered by what all standpoints share (order: the widening comparison).

clauses.zh: 二设即伦理之全力：凡约束一切计一切之方之判，皆广之判；
clauses.en: The two suppositions are the whole force of the ethics: every judgment binding on all standpoints that count everything is a judgment of widening;

clauses.zh: 余皆互有所长之历之间之权，伦理之设无一迫之。
clauses.en: the rest is practical judgment between mixed histories, which no supposition of the ethics forces.

clauses.zh: （四律各有其地位；
clauses.en: (The four laws each have their standing;

clauses.zh: 其一、其二、其四为跨域之一律是猜想，其三无设而然，不陈为猜想）四者在其各自之域实已知，于本论各为跨域之一律：一曰缘感而择，二曰广即诸正轻重之所共（称之为愈仍是以广为愈之设），三曰不可逆即状之同归，四曰莫上之者于可汲之处降其外。
clauses.en: that the first, second and fourth are each one law across fields is a conjecture, and the third is a theorem without premise, not stated as a conjecture) The four are actually known in their own fields, and in this account each is one law across fields: first, selection through couplings; second, widening is what the positive weightings share (calling it better is still the supposition of the widening comparison); third, irreversibility is the confluence of configurations; fourth, the maximal alternative lowers what lies outside where there is room beyond.

clauses.zh: 读作对应，统一不添一证；
clauses.en: Read as a correspondence, the unification adds no proof;

clauses.zh: 读作论题，它排除其各自之域所开者。
clauses.en: read as a thesis, it excludes what their own fields leave open.
